  "title": "Philippine passport: requirements (part 1 of 2)",
  "content": "- Book a confirmed online appointment at passport.gov.ph. Appointments made anywhere else are not legitimate. Courtesy Lane applicants (seniors, PWDs, pregnant women, solo parents, OFWs, children 7 and below) may walk in. [1] [7]\n- Print the application form and e-receipt generated after booking and payment. [1]\n- New adult applicants: bring your PSA birth certificate on security paper (original and photocopy). [2]\n- New adult applicants: bring one acceptable valid ID with one photocopy, e.g. PhilID/ePhilID, UMID, SSS card, LTO driver's licence, PRC ID, voter's ID or certificate, postal ID. Pag-IBIG, TIN and PhilHealth IDs are not accepted. [5] [1]\n- Renewing: bring your current ePassport with a photocopy of the data page. [3]\n- Married women using the spouse's surname: bring your PSA marriage certificate. You do not need it if you keep your maiden name.   "id": "bg-guide-tin-before-you-start",
  "category": "requirements",
  "title": "TIN (Taxpayer Identification Number): requirements",
  "content": "- Check that you have never had a TIN. If you once had one, even from a past job, use it.  {
  "id": "bg-guide-itr-do-you-need-to-file-at-all",
  "category": "services",
  "title": "Annual ITR (BIR Form 1700): do you need to file at all?",
  "content": "You do not need to file Form 1700 if any of these apply (RR 4-2024):\n- Your taxable compensation income is ₱250,000 or less.\n- You had only one employer for the whole year and it withheld your tax correctly. This is \"substituted filing\": your employer's BIR Form 2316 stands in for your return.\n- All of your income was already subject to final tax.\n- You are a minimum wage earner.\n- You are an overseas Filipino worker (OFW) for your income earned abroad.\nYou must file if you worked for two or more employers during the year, at the same time or one after another. RR 4-2024 says such earners \"are not qualified for substituted filing\" (RR 4-2024).\nWhat is BIR Form 2316? It is the Certificate of Compensation Payment/Tax Withheld that your employer gives you. It shows what you earned and how much tax was withheld. Under substituted filing, it serves as your return.  {
  "id": "bg-guide-bir-1701-which-rate-are-you-on",
  "category": "services",
  "title": "BIR Form 1701A: which rate are you on?",
  "content": "- 8% flat rate: Only available if your gross sales/receipts plus other non-operating income do not exceed the ₱3,000,000 VAT threshold, and you are not VAT-registered (RR 8-2018).\n- Choosing it: You must elect the 8% rate in your first-quarter income or percentage tax return, or in the first quarterly return after you start your business. Otherwise you are placed on graduated rates. The choice cannot be changed for that year (RR 8-2018).\n- If you pass ₱3M during the year: You automatically move to graduated rates for the whole year. Your 8% quarterly payments are credited (RR 8-2018).\n- Graduated rates + OSD: You deduct a flat 40% of gross sales/receipts instead of listing expenses (TRAIN Sec. 34(L)). You then pay graduated income tax plus 3% percentage tax if you are non-VAT (TRAIN Sec. 116).\n- Micro and small taxpayers (gross sales below ₱3M is \"micro\") may instead use the simplified Form 1701-MS. It was added to eBIRForms v7.9.6.0 (RR 8-2024; RMC 20-2026; RMC 36-2026).\nSource: https://bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/local/pdf/RR%20No.%208-2018.pdf (checked 2026-10-09).",

  "id": "bg-guide-vat-steps",
  "category": "services",
  "title": "VAT registration: steps",
  "content": "1. Fill out BIR Form 1905 to add \"Value-Added Tax\" as a tax type (RMC 97-2025).\n2. File it with your RDO, electronically (ORUS) or in person (EOPT Sec. 236).\n3. Get your updated Certificate of Registration showing VAT. Pay ₱30 DST if a new COR is issued (RR 7-2024).\n4. Apply for new invoices (Authority to Print, or a permit for loose-leaf or computerized invoices) that show VAT details (RR 7-2024). Each VAT invoice must show:\n\t- The words \"VAT Reg TIN\" followed by your TIN and branch code.\n\t- The VAT amount as a separate item.\n5. Stop using your old non-VAT invoices.\n6. Charge 12% VAT on every sale and issue an invoice for every sale, whatever the amount (RR 7-2024).\n7. Record your sales and purchases separately so you can claim input VAT.\n8. File BIR Form 2550Q (April 2024 version) and pay within 25 days after the end of each quarter (TRAIN/EOPT Sec. 114; RMC 68-2024).\nSource: https://bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/BIR/pdf/RMC%20No.%2097-2025.pdf (checked 2026-10-09).",

  "id": "bg-guide-vat-what-changes-for-your-invoices-and-books",
  "category": "services",
  "title": "VAT registration: what changes for your invoices and books",
  "content": "- Invoices replace official receipts. Under EOPT, the \"Invoice\" is now the main sales document for both goods and services. An Official Receipt is only a supplementary document (RR 7-2024).\n- Services are taxed on gross sales. VAT on services is now based on \"gross sales\", the same as goods, rather than on cash received (RR 3-2024).\n- No more monthly 2550M. VAT returns are quarterly only, starting 1 January 2023. This change came from the TRAIN law, not EOPT (RA 10963 Sec. 114).\n- Threshold will be updated. The ₱3M threshold is adjusted for inflation every 3 years (EOPT Sec. 109(CC); RR 3-2024). Check current BIR issuances when determining whether you must register.\nSource: https://bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/BIR/pdf/RR%20No.%207-%202024.pdf (checked 2026-10-09).",

  "id": "bg-guide-vat-deadlines-and-penalties",
  "category": "services",
  "title": "VAT registration: deadlines and penalties",
  "content": "- If you should have registered but didn't: You must pay VAT as if registered, but you cannot claim input tax credits for that period (EOPT Sec. 236(F)(2)).\n- Registration deadline: Contact your RDO as soon as your sales reach the registration threshold to confirm when you must file your registration update.\n- Late filing or payment:\n\t- 25% surcharge (NIRC Sec. 248).\n\t- 12% a year interest (TRAIN Sec. 249).\n\t- Micro and small taxpayers pay a reduced 10% surcharge and 6% interest instead (RR 6-2024).\n- Cancelling VAT registration: Possible if you expect sales over the next 12 months to stay at or below the threshold, or if you close the business.   "title": "Real property tax (amilyar): penalties if you miss a payment",
  "content": "- Interest: Unpaid RPT earns interest of 2% a month, for a maximum of 36 months, so up to 72% of the unpaid amount (RA 7160 Sec. 255).   "content": "Historical marker \"Ang Bayan ng Taal (1572)\" in Taal Municipal Hall, Calle Marcela Mariño Agoncillo, Taal, Batangas, installed by the National Historical Commission (NHC) in 1972. Marker text:\nANG BAYAN NG TAAL\n(1572)\nUNANG ITINATAG SA POOK NG BALANGON NOONG 1572.\nDAHIL SA MADALAS NA PAGPUTOK NG BULKAN AY INILIPAT ANG BAYAN SA KASALUKUYANG POOK.\nNAGING KABISERA NOONG 1732 KAYA’T TAAL ANG IPINANGALAN SA BUONG LALAWIGAN.\nNANG MULING MASIRA ANG BAYAN DAHIL SA PAGPUTOK NG BULKAN NOONG 1754, ANG KABISERA AY INILIPAT SA BATANGAN AT ISINUNOD DITO ANG PANGALAN NG LALAWIGAN.\nANG BULKAN NG TAAL, NA PINAKAMALIIT SA BUONG DAIGDIG, AT NASA GITNA NG LAWA NG BONBON AT SA BUNGANGA NG BULKAN AY MAY ISANG PULONG NASA ISA PANG MALIIT NA LAWA.\nPUMUTOK ANG BULKAN NOONG 1634, 1635, 1641, 1709, 1718, 1723, 1731, 1749, 1754, 1867, 1874, 1880, 1911 AT 1965.\nANG NGAYO’Y MGA BAYAN NG LEMERY, SAN LUIS, AGONCILLO, SAN NICOLAS, AT STA.\nTERESITA AY DATING SAKOP NG TAAL.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/ang-bayan-ng-taal-1572/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Manila High School\" in Ermita, Manila (Region NCR), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 26 February 1982. Marker text:\nMANILA HIGH SCHOOL\nANG PAARALANG ITO AY NAITATAG NG MGA KASTILA SA UTOS NG AYUNTAMIENTO DE MANILA SA DAANG VICTORIA, INTRAMUROS NOONG 1892.\nPINANGALANANG ESCUELA MUNICIPAL DE MANILA.\nDITO RIN ITINATAG NG MGA AMERIKANO ANG KAUNA-UNAHANG PAARALANG BAYAN SA ILALIM NG KANILANG PAMAMAHALA NOONG HUNYO 11, 1906 SA PANGALANG MANILA HIGH SCHOOL.\nITO ANG UNA AT TANGING MATAAS NA PAARALANG BAYAN ISINUNOD SA PANGALAN NG PUNONG LUNGSOD SA BANSA.\nANG UNANG GUSALI AY NAGIBA NOONG IKALAWANG DIGMAANG PANDAIGDIG.\nANG KASALUKUYANG GUSALING ITO AY PINASINAYAAN NONG PEBRERO 26, 1967.\nKABILANG SA MABUBUNYING NAGTAPOS SA PAARALANG ITO ANG TATLONG NAGING PANGULO NG PILIPINAS NA SINA JOSE P.\nLAUREL, MANUEL A.\nROXAS AT ELPIDIO QUIRINO, ANG BANTOG NA HENERAL CARLOS P.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/manila-high-school/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Carriedo Fountain, Quezon City\" in Balara, Quezon City (Region NCR), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 1982. Marker text:\nCARRIEDO FOUNTAIN\nITINAYO NOONG MAYO 1882 BILANG BAHAGI NG CARRIEDO WATER WORKS SYSTEM NA PINASIMULAN NI GOBERNADOR-HENERAL DOMINGO MORIONES NOONG 1878.\nPINASINAYAAN NI GOBERNADOR-HENERAL PRIMO DE RIVERA NOONG 24 HULYO 1882 AT IPINANGALAN KAY FRANCISCO CARRIEDO Y PEREDO, ANG KASTILANG PENINSULAR AT HENERAL NG GALYONG “SANTA FAMILIA” NA NAGKALOOB NG SAMPUNG LIBONG PISO UPANG IPAGAWA ANG PATUBIG.\nNILAGYAN NG MGA PALAMUTI NG PAMAHALAANG LUNGSOD NG MAYNILA NOONG 1891.\nORIHINAL NA ITINAYO SA ROTONDA DE SAMPALOC, YAON AY INALIS NOONG 1976 AT INILIPAT NG METROPOLITAN WATERWORKS AND SEWERAGE SYSTEM SA POOK NA ITO NOONG 1980 BILANG BAHAGI NG PAGGUNITA SA IKASANDAANG TAONG PAGKAKATAYO NOON.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/carriedo-fountain-quezon-city/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Jorge C. Bocobo\" in Gerona, Tarlac, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 19 October 1983. Marker text:\nJORGE C.\nBOCOBO\nISKOLAR, EDUKADOR, AWTOR, HURISTA, AT MAKABAYAN.\nISINILANG NOONG OKTUBRE 19, 1886 SA GERONA, TARLAC.\nNAGTAPOS NG BATAS SA PAMANTASAN NG INDIANA, ESTADOS UNIDOS, 1903-1907.\nPROPESOR AT DEKANO, KOLEHIYO NG BATAS, PAMANTASAN NG PILIPINAS, 1911-1934;\nIKALAWANG PANGULO, UP, 1934-1939;\nKALIHIM NG PAGTUTURO, 1939-1941;\nKATULONG NG MAHISTRADO, KATAASTAASANG HUKUMAN NG PILIPINAS, 1942-1944;\nTAGAPANGULO, KOMISYON NG KODIGO AT PUNONG TAGABALANGKAS NG KODIGO SIBIL NG PILIPINAS, 1948-1961.\nAWTOR NG NOBELANG HENRY AND LOLENG, DULANG RADIANT SYMBOL, SANAYSAY NA STREAMS OF LIFE AT TULANG FURROWS AND ARROWS.\nNAGSALIN SA INGLES NG NOLI AT FILI NI RIZAL.\nPINAGKALOOBAN NG TITULONG DOKTOR SA BATAS, HONORIS CAUSA, PAMANTASAN NG SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA, 1930, PAMANTASAN NG INDIANA, 1951, AT PAMANTASAN NG PILIPINAS, 1953, AT TUMANGGAP NG GAWAD RIZAL PRO-PATRIA, 1961.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/jorge-c-bocobo/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nGENEROSA DE LEON\n(1892–1962)\nISA SA MGA DAKILANG EDUKADOR NG KANYANG PANAHON.\nIPINANGANAK SA PANDAKAN, MAYNILA, HULYO 17, 1892.\nMAGKASABAY NA TINAPOS ANG EDUKASYONG SEKUNDARYA AT BATSILYER SA MGA SINING NANG MAY MARKANG SOBRESALIENTE, CENTRO ESCOLAR DE SENORITAS, 1910.\nPINAGKALOOBAN NG TITULONG DALUBHASA SA SINING NG PAGTUTURO.\nHONORIS CAUSA, 1949.\nITINATAG ANG COLLEGE OF PHARMACY, CEU, 1921 AT SANGAY SA PARAÑAQUE NG CEU, 1954.\nBANTOG SA KANYANG KAKAYAHAN BILANG REGISTRAR, INGAT-YAMAN AT TAGAPAMAHALA NG CEU AT SA KANYANG MGA PAGLILINGKOD SA MGA SAMAHANG MAPAGKAWANGGAWA AT SA EDUKASYON NG MGA KABATAAN.\nMAY-AKDA NG KILALANG YOUR COOKERY GUIDE.\nSI MAESTRA OSANG AY NAMATAY NOONG OKTUBRE 11, 1962.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/generosa-de-leon-1892-1962/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Eugenio Daza y Salazar (1870–1954)\" in Real Street, Borongan, Eastern Samar, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 1992. Marker text:\nEUGENIO DAZA Y SALAZAR\n(1870–1954)\nGURO, REBOLUSYONARYO, MAMBABATAS.\nIPINANGANAK, NOBYEMBRE 15, 1870, BORONGAN, EASTERN SAMAR.\nNAGKAMIT NG TITULO SA EDUKASYON, ESCUELA NORMAL DE MAESTRO, MAYNILA, 1888.\nMAKARAANG MAKATAPOS NG EDUKASYON, SIYA AY NAGTURO SA BORONGAN MUNICIPAL SCHOOL AT PAGKARAAN NG LIMANG TAON AY NAGTATAG NG SARILING PAARALAN SA ILALIM NG PAMAMAHALA NG MGA KASTILA.\nSUMAPI SA KILUSANG HIMAGSIKAN SA SAMAR SA PAGSIKLAB NG HIMAGSIKANG PILIPINO.\nITINALAGA NI HENERAL VICENTE LUKBAN NA MAGING PANGKALAHATANG PUNONG-HUKBO NG SILANGANG SAMAR.\nISA SA MGA NAGING KASANGKAPAN SA TAGUMPAY NG ISANG MAKASAYSAYANG PANGYAYARING NAGANAP SA BALANGIGA NOONG SETYEMBRE 28, 1901.\nNAHALAL NA KINATAWAN NG IKATLONG DISTRITO NG SAMAR SA UNANG ASEMBLEA NG PILIPINAS, 1907.\nNAMATAY DISYEMBRE 16, 1954, CALAMBA, LAGUNA.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/eugenio-daza-y-salazar-1870-1954/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Casino Español de Manila\" in Kalaw St., Ermita, Manila (Region NCR), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 1993. Marker text:\nCASINO ESPAÑOL DE MANILA\nITINATAG BILANG ISANG NATATANGING KLUB NG MGA KASTILANG (HIJOS DEL PAIS) NANINIRAHAN SA MAYNILA NOONG 1893.\nITINAYO ANG UNANG GUSALI AYON SA DISENYO NI ARKITEKTO JUAN ARELLANO, 1913;\nPINASINAYAAN, 1917.\nNASIRA NOONG LIBERASYON NG MAYNILA, 1945.\nPANSAMANTALANG NALIPAT ITO SA ISANG BAHAY SA PANULUKAN NG DAANG OREGON (NGAYO’Y APACIBLE) AT DAANG PEREZ, PACO.\nMULING ITINAYO SA KASALUKUYANG POCK SA PAMAMAGITAN NI IGNACIO PLANAS, 1951.\nDITO, GINAGANAP ANG MGA MAHAHALAGANG PAGDIRIWANG NG ESPANYA.\nSA KASALUKUYAN, ANG KLUB NA ITO AY ISANG BUHAY NA SAGISAG NG MAINIT AT MAGANDANG PAGSASAMAHAN NG PILIPINAS AT ESPANYA.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/casino-espanol-de-manila/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Beaterio-Kolehiyo ng Santa Catalina\" in Intramuros, Manila, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 26 July 1996. Marker text:\nBEATERIO-KOLEHIYO NG SANTA CATALINA\nSA POOK NA ITO DATING NAKATAYO ANG GUSALI NG NAKILALANG BEATERIO-KOLEHIYO NG SANTA CATALINA DE SENA NA ITINATAG NG KANYANG KADAKILAAN MADRE FRANCISCA DEL ESPIRITU SANTO, O.P., SA TULONG NI PADRE JUAN DE SANTO DOMINGO, O.P., HULYO 26, 1696.\nNAGING BEATERIO-KOLEHIYO, 1706;\nTINANGGAP ANG PORMAL NA PAGTATAGUYOD NG HARI NG ESPANYA, 1716;\nAT NAGING ISANG KONGREGASYON SA ILALIM NG PAMAMAHALA NG OBISPO NG MAYNILA, 1933.\nPANSAMANTALANG NATIGIL ANG MGA GAWAIN NITO NG SUMIKLAB ANG HIMAGSIKAN NOONG 1896 GAYUNDIN NOONG 1941.\nNANG BOMBAHIN NG MGA HAPON ANG GUSALING ITO.\nINILIPAT SA KALYE LEGARDA, NGAYO’Y POOK NA KINATATAYUAN NG KOLEHIYO NG SANTA CATALINA, MAKARAAN ANG IKALAWANG DIGMAANG PANGDAIGDIG.\nINILIPAT ANG BEATERIO SA KASALUKUYANG POOK NA KINATATAYUAN NITO SA LUNGSOD NG QUEZON, 1962.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/beaterio-kolehiyo-ng-santa-catalina/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Labanan sa Binakayan\" in Samala Street, Kawit, Cavite, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in November 11, 1996. Marker text:\nLABANAN SA BINAKAYAN\nSA POOK NA ITO, NOONG NOBYEMBRE 9–11, 1898, NAGANAP ANG ISA SA PINAKAMADUDUGONG LABANAN SA CAVITE.\nSA PAMUMUNO NI HENERAL EMILIO AGUINALDO, SINAGUPA NG MAGIGITING NA MANGHIHIMAGSIK NA PILIPINO ANG REHIMYENTO 73 NA SINUSUPORTAHAN NG MAY LIMANG BATALYON NG MGA KASTILANG CAZADORES AT IMPANTERIYA NG MGA MARINO NA PINANGUNGUNAHAN NAMAN NG GOBERNADOR HENERAL RAMON BLANCO.\nNAGWAGI ANG MGA MANGHIHIMAGSIK NA PILIPINO SA LABANANG ITO NGUNIT SINAMANG-PALAD NA MASAWI SINA HENERAL CANDIDO TRIA TIRONA, SI KAPITAN SIMEON ALCANTARA AT MARAMI SA KANILANG MAGIGITING NA MGA KASAMA.\nSA KARANGALAN NG MGA BAYANI NG LABANANG ITO, ANG PANANDANG PANGKASAYSAYANG ITO AY INIAALAY BILANG PAGKILALA SA KANILANG KATAPANGAN AT KABAYANIHAN.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/labanan-sa-binakayan/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Camilo Osias\" in Balaoan, La Union, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 17 March 1989. Marker text:\nCAMILO OSIAS\nMANUNULAT, EDUKADOR, AT ESTADISTA.\nISINILANG SA BALAOAN, LA UNION, MARSO 23, 1889.\nISA SA MGA PENSIONADO SA ESTADOS UNIDOS, 1905.\nNAGKAMIT NG TEACHER’S DIPLOMA, WESTERN ILLINOIS STATE NORMAL SCHOOL, 1908, A.B., B.S.E., AT GRADUATE DIPLOMA IN ADMINISTRATION AND SUPERVISION, PAWANG SA COLUMBIA UNIVERSITY, E.U., 1910.\nUNANG PILIPINONG SANGAY TAGAPAMAHALA NG MGA PAARALAN, 1915-16;\nUNANG KATULONG DIREKTOR NG EDUKASYON, 1919-21;\nKAGAWAD, UNANG MISYONG PANGKALAYAAN SA E.U., 1921., UNANG PANGULO, NATIONAL UNIVERSITY, 1921-34;\nNAHALAL NA SENADOR, 1925, 1947 AT 1961;\nNANINIRAHANG KOMISYONADO SA E.U., 1929-35;\nKINATAWAN, UNANG DISTRITO NG LA UNION, PAMBANSANG ASAMBLEA NG PILIPINAS AT KUMBENSYONG KONSTITUSYONAL, 1934;\nTAGPANGULO, PAMBANSANG LUPON NG EDUKASYON, 1941;\nTAGAPAGTATAG, OSISAS COLLEGES SA LA UNION AT TARLAC, 1945.\nMAY-AKDA NG ILANG AKLAT TUNGKOL KAY RIZAL;\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/camilo-osias/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Ang Labanan sa Alitao Tayabas, Quezon\" in Alitao, Tayabas, Quezon, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in October 26, 2001. Marker text:\nANG LABANAN SA ALITAO\nTAYABAS, QUEZON\nSA POOK NA ITO NAGANAP NOONG NOBYEMBRE 1, 1841 ANG MADUGONG LABANAN SA PAGITAN NG PANGKAT NG MGA KASTILA SA PAMUMUNO NI TINYENTE JOAQUIN HUET SA PANGKAT NI APOLINARIO DE LA CRUZ (HERMANO PULE), ANG TAGAPAGTATAG NG SAMHANG COFRADIA DE SAN JOSE.\nBUONG GITING NA NAKIPAGLABAN SI HERMANO PULE AT KANYANG MGA KAPANALIG NGUNIT ANG KANILANG KATAPANGAN AY HINDI NAGING SAPAT SA MALAKAS NA SANDATA NG MGA KASTILA.\nMARAMING KASAPI NG KAPATIRAN ANG NAMATAY SA LABANANG ITO, KABILANG NA YAONG MGA KABABAIHAN AT WALANG MALAY NA KABATAAN, SAMANTALANG ANG IBA AY SUGATAN AT NABIHAG.\nNATIGMAK NG DUGO ANG BANAL NA LUPANG ITO MULA SA MGA KASAPI AT ALAGAD NG COFRADIA NI HERMANO PULE.\nANG PANANDANG PANGKASAYSAYANG ITO AY INIALAY SA KANILANG KABAYANIHAN NG SAMBAYANANG PILIPINO NA SA KANILA AY PATULOY NA DUMADAKILA.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/ang-labanan-sa-alitao-tayabas-quezon/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Manuel S. Enverga (1909–1981)\" in Mauban, Quezon in 2009. Marker text:\nMANUEL S.\nENVERGA (1909–1981)\nMAKABAYAN AT LINGKOD-BAYAN.\nISINILANG SA MAUBAN, QUEZON, 1 ENERO 1909.\nNAGTAPOS NG ABOGASYA SA PHILIPPINE LAW SCHOOL, 1938.\nMASTER OF LAWS SA UNIVERSIDAD NG STO.\nTOMAS, 1948.\nGINAWARAN NG DOCTOR OF LAWS NG UNIVERSIDAD CENTRAL DE MADRID, 1950.\nNAGTATAG NG LUZONIAN COLLEGES, NGAYO’Y MANUEL S.\nENVERGA UNIVERSITY FOUNDATION, 11 PEBRERO 1947.\nNAHALAL NA KINATAWAN NG UNANG DISTRITO NG QUEZON, 1953–1969.\nNAGPANUKALA NG PAGTATATAG NG PHILIPPINE COCONUT ADMINISTRATION, 1954.\nNAGING TAGAPANGULO NG HOUSE COMMITTEE ON EDUCATION, 1958–1961, HOUSE COMMITTEE ON FOREIGN AFFAIRS, 1961–1969.\nNAPILING OUTSTANDING CONGRESSMAN NG MGA PAHAYAGAN SA PILIPINAS BILANG PANGUNAHING TAGAPAGMUNGKAHI NG PANUKALANG-BATAS PARA SA PAGBUBUKAS NG KALAKALAN SA PAGITAN NG PILIPINAS AT NG MGA BANSANG KOMUNISTA, 1966.\nYUMAO, 14 HUNYO 1981.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/manuel-s-enverga-1909-1981/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Jose Rizal (1861-1896)\" in Rizal Monument, Chipeco Avenue Extension, Calamba, Laguna, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 2011. Marker text:\nJOSE RIZAL\n(1861–1896)\nPAMBANSANG BAYANI NG PILIPINAS.\nDOKTOR, AGRIMENSOR, DALUBWIKA, MANUNULAT, MAKATA, ESKULTOR AT PINTOR.\nISINILANG SA CALAMBA, LAGUNA, 19 HUNYO 1861.\nMAY-AKDA NG NOLI ME TANGERE (1887) AT EL FILIBUSTERISMO (1891), MGA NOBELANG HIGIT PANG NAGPAALAB SA MGA FILIPINO NA MAGHIMAGSIK LABAN SA ESPANYA.\nDINAKIP AT IPINATAPON SA DAPITAN, HILAGANG MINDANAO, 6 HULYO, 1892.\nNAGBOLUNTARYO BILANG MANGGAGAMOT NG PUWERSANG ESPANYOL SA CUBA, 1896, NGUNIT MULING DINAKIP HABANG PATUNGONG ESPANYA SA BINTANG NA REBELYON.\nBINARIL SA BAGUMBAYAN (NGAYO’Y LIWASANG RIZAL), MAYNILA, 30 DISYEMBRE 1896.\nPATULOY NA INSPIRASYON PARA SA KALAYAN AT PAGKABANSANG FILIPINO.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/jose-rizal-1861-1896-9/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Aurelio Tolentino\" in Sen. Gil Puyat Avenue, Guagua, Pampanga, installed by the National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) in October 13, 2017. Marker text:\nAURELIO TOLENTINO\nREBOLUSYONARYO, MANDUDULA, NOBELISTA AT MAKATA.\nISINILANG SA STO.\nCRISTO, GUAGUA, PAMPANGA, 13 OKTUBRE 1867.\nKASAMA NINA ANDRES BONIFACIO, EMILIO JACINTO AT IBA PANG KATIPUNERO SA PULONG SA KWEBA NG PAMITINAN, MONTALBAN UPANG TALAKAYIN ANG REBOLUSYON, ABRIL 1895.\nDINAKIP MATAPOS SUMIKLAB ANG REBOLUSYON, SETYEMBRE 1896.\nISA SA MGA LUMAGDA SA MGA AMERIKANO SA PAMAMAGITAN NG PAGSUSULAT NG MGA SUBERSIBONG AKDA.\nILAN SA KANYANG MGA SINULAT AY ANG KAHAPON, NGAYON AT BUKAS, 1902;\nBAGONG KRISTO, 1907;\nBUHAY, 1909;\nAT NG LA PATRIA, EL LIBERAL, EL PUEBLO AT EL IMPARCIAL.\nNAGTATAG NG PAHAYAGANG PILIPINAS.\nISINULONG ANG KAPAKANAN NG MGA MAMAMAYAN SA PAMAMAGITAN NG PAGBUBUO NG SAMAHAANG KATIMAWAAN.\nITINATAG ANG EL PARNASO FILIPINO, ISANG SURIAN SA PAG-AARAL NG PANITIKANG TAGALOG, PANULAAN AT DEKLAMASYON.\nYUMAO, 5 HULYO 1915.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/aurelio-tolentino/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"The Code of Kalantiaw\" in Code of Kalantiaw Monument, Batan, Aklan, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1957. Marker text:\nTHE CODE OF KALANTIAW\nDATU BENDAHARA KALANTIAW, THIRD CHIEF OF PANAY BORN IN AKLAN, ESTABLISHED HIS GOVERNMENT IN THE PENINSULA OF BATANG, “AKLAN SAKUP.” CONSIDERED THE FIRST FILIPINO LAWGIVER, HE PROMULGATED ABOUT 1422 A PENAL CODE NOW KNOWN AS THE CODE OF KALANTIAW CONTAINING 18 ARTICLES.\nDON MARCELINO ORFILA OF ZARAGOZA, SPAIN, OBTAINED THE ORIGINAL MANUSCRIPT FROM AN OLD CHIEF OF PANAY AND WAS LATER TRANSLATED INTO SPANISH BY RAFAEL MURVIEDO Y ZAMANEY.\nTHIS MARKER IS ERECTED UPON THE REQUEST OF THE MUNICIPAL COUNCIL OF BATAN, AKLAN ON 1 JUNE 1956.\nCurrent status: Delisted\nBasis of delisting: Resolution No.\n12, S.\n2004 of the National Historical Institute (NHI) declared that the Code of Kalantiao has no valid historical basis.\nDelisted by: National Historical Institute (NHI)\nDate delisted: 25 November 2004\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/the-code-of-kalantiaw/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nMAGALANG\nESTABLISHED BY THE AUGUSTINIANS AT MACAPSA IN 1605.\nSCENE OF THE ENCOUNTER BETWEEN THE FOLLOWERS OF ANDRES MALONG LED BY MELCHOR DE VERA AND THE SPANISH TROOPS IN 1660.\nMOVED TO SAN BARTOLOME IN 1734.\nSWEPT BY THE PARUA RIVER IN THE FLOOD OF 1863.\nRE-ESTABLISHED IN BARRIO SAN PEDRO ON 13 DECEMBER 1863 BY GOBERNADORCILLO PABLO M.\nLUCIANO.\nTHE REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT TOOK OVER, 12 JUNE 1898 UNTIL 5 NOVEMBER 1899 WHEN THE AMERICANS SUCCEEDED.\nOCCUPIED BY THE JAPANESE, 3 JANUARY 1942.\nLIBERATED BY THE AMERICANS, 24 JANUARY 1945.\nTURNED OVER TO THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES, 4 JULY 1946.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/magalang/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Gregorio Sanciangco Y Goson\" in 24 Sancianco, Tonsuya, Malabon, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1952.   "content": "Historical marker \"Blood Compact Between Sikatuna and Legaspi\" in Tagbilaran City, Bohol, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1941. Marker text:\nBLOOD COMPACT BETWEEN SIKATUNA AND LEGASPI\nABOUT THE MIDDLE OF MARCH 1565, CAPTAIN GENERAL MIGUEL LOPEZ DE LEGASPI’S FLEET ANCHORED ALONG THIS SHORE.\nSHORTLY THEREAFTER, LEGASPI MANIFESTING TRUST AND CONFIDENCE IN THE ISLANDERS, ENTERED INTO A BLOOD COMPACT WITH DATU SIKATUNA FOR THE PURPOSE OF INSURING FRIENDLY RELATIONS BETWEEN THE SPANIARDS AND THE NATIVES.\nA FEW DROPS OF BLOOD DRAWN FROM A SMALL INCISION IN THE ARM OF EACH OF THE TWO CHIEFS WERE PLACED IN SEPARATE CUPS CONTAINING WINE, AND IN THE PRESENCE OF THE FOLLOWERS OF BOTH, EACH CHIEF DRANK THE POTION CONTAINING THE BLOOD OF THE OTHER.\nTHUS, DURING THIS PERIOD OF COLONIZATION, A BOND WAS SEALED IN ACCORDANCE WITH NATIVE PRACTICE, THE FIRST TREATY OF FRIENDSHIP AND ALLIANCE BETWEEN SPANIARDS AND FILIPINOS.\nCurrent status: Delisted\nBasis of delisting: Resolution No.\n04, S.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/blood-compact-between-sikatuna-and-legaspi/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Ifugao Rice Terraces\" in Banaue, Ifugao (Region CAR), installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1940. Marker text:\nIFUGAO RICE TERRACES\nTHE IFUGAO RICE TERRACES COVER AN AREA OF NEARLY 400 SQUARE KILOMETERS, AND IF THE WALLS WERE PLACED END TO END, THEY WOULD REACH MORE THAN HALF-WAY AROUND THE EARTH.\nTHOSE OF BANAUE, HAPAO, AND HUNGDUAN ARE AMONG THE OLDEST IN LUZON.\nARCHAEOLOGICAL AND HISTORICAL STUDIES INDICATE THAT IT TOOK THE IFUGAOS MORE THAN 2,000 YEARS TO BUILD THEM.\nTHE STONE-WALLED TERRACES OF IFUGAO ARE THE HIGHEST, BEST BUILT, AND MOST EXTENSIVE IN THE WORLD.\nA SINGLE MIGRATING PEOPLE IS BELIEVED TO HAVE CARRIED THE TERRACE CULTURE FROM SOUTH CHINA OR INDO-CHINA ACROSS TO LUZON AND SOUTHERN JAPAN, AND SOUTHWARD TO JAVA AND THE LESSER SUNDA ISLANDS WHICH ARE THE ONLY REGIONS WHERE TRUE RICE TERRACES EXIST.\nREMAINS INDICATE THAT THE FIRST MIGRATION WAS PROBABLY IN THE SECOND MILLENIUM B.C., AND CARRIED ONLY A MATERIAL CULTURE OF POLISHED STONE, COPPER AND BRONZE;\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/ifugao-rice-terraces/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Mabini Shrine, PUP*\" in PUP Mabini Campus Sta. Mesa, Manila (Region NCR), installed by the National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP). Marker text:\nDAMBANANG APOLINARIO MABINI\nIPINAMANA SA MAG-ASAWANG MARIA DEL ROSARIO AT AGAPITO MABINI NA KAPATID NI APOLINARIO MABINI ANG BAHAY NA ITO NA UNANG NATAGPUAN SA 21 KALYE NAGTAHAN SA MAYNILA.\nDITO UNANG NANIRAHAN SI MABINI HABANG NAG-AARAL NG ABOGASYA NOONG 1888.\nMULI SIYANG NANIRAHAN DITO MATAPOS PALAYAIN SA PAGKAHULI NIYA SA CUYAPO, NUEVA ECIJA DAHIL SA KANYANG PAKIKIBAHAGI SA REBOLUSYON, 3 OKTUBRE 1900.\nMULING NAGBALIK SA BAHAY NA ITO SI MABINI, 26 PEBRERO 1903, MATAPOS IPATAPON SA GUAM.\nSA BAHAY NA ITO YUMAO SI MABINI, 13 MAYO 1903.\nINILIPAT ANG BAHAY SA 23 KALYE NAGTAHAN NANG GAMITIN ANG LOTENG KINATATAYUAN NG BAHAY.\nMULING INILIPAT ANG BAHAY SA DATING BUREAU OF ANIMAL INDUSTRY, NGAYO’Y BAHAGI NG MALACAÑANG PARK, UPANG BIGYANG DAAN ANG PAGPAPATAYO NG KONGKRETONG TULAY NG MABINI SA NAGTAHAN.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/mabini-shrine-pup/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nSIMBAHANG INMACULADA CONCEPCION NG TAMONTAKA\nUNANG IPINATAYO NG MGA PARING HESWITA SA PAMPANG NG PANLAHATAN SA ILOG TAMONTAKA NOONG 1872 BILANG BAHAGI NG MISYONG TAMONTAKA UPANG PANGALAGAAN ANG KAPAKANAN NG MGA KABATAAN AT PALAGANAPIN ANG EBANGHELYO SA REHIYON NG COTABATO.\nIPINATAYO ANG PAARALAN PARA SA MGA KABATAANG LALAKI SA PANGANGASIWA NG MGA HESWITA AT PAARALAN PARA SA MGA KABATAANG BABAE SA PANGANGALAGA NG MGA BEATA NG SAN IGNACIO (NGAYO’Y RELIGIOUS OF THE VIRGIN MARY O RVM).\nINILIPAT SA KASALUKUYANG KINATATAYUAN NITO, 1879 AT NAGING SENTRO NG MISYONG HESWITA.\nNILISAN NG MGA PARING HESWITA, 1899 AT INILAGAY SA PANGANGALAGA NG MGA HESWITA NG ZAMBOANGA.\nPINANGASIWAAN NG MGA PARING OBLATES OF MARY IMMACULATE AT NAGING BAHAGI NG KANILANG MISYON SA COTABATO, 1939.\nNASIRA NG LINDOL, 17 AGOSTO 1976.\nMULING ITINAYO, 1978.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/simbahang-immaculada-concepcion-ng-tamontaka/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Church of San Pedro Apostol (Loboc Church)*\" in Loboc, Bohol (Region VII), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 1999. Marker text:\nCHURCH OF SAN PEDRO APOSTOL\nIN MAY 1597, FR.\nJUAN DE TORRES, S.J., ESTABLISHED THE MISSION OF LOBOC, WHICH WAS CANONICALLY ESTABLISHED AS A PARISH DEDICATED TO SAN PEDRO APOSTOL[.] IN 1602, THE PRESENT CHURCH, BUILT ON FOUNDATIONS OF THE EARLY CHURCH WHICH WAS DESTROYED BY THE FIRE, WAS STARTED IN 1670 AND COMPLETED IN 1734.\nTHE CONVENT ANNEXED TO THE CHURCH IN A THREE-STOREY STRUCTURE, WAS THE CENTRAL RESIDENCE OF THE JESUIT MISSIONS.\nIN 1768, THE RECOLLECTS WERE ASSIGNED THE FORMER MISSIONS IN BOHOL;\nTHEY BUILT THE OCTAGONAL BELL TOWER SEPARATE FROM THE MAIN CHURCH STRUCTURE.\nSOMETIME IN 1858, FRAY AQUILINO BON, O.A.R., BUILT THE PORTICO IN FRONT OF THE CHURCH FAÇADE AND THE OCTAGIONAL MORTUARY CHAPEL AT THE GOSPEL FLANK OF THE CHURCH.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/church-of-san-pedro-apostol-loboc-church/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nSIMBAHAN NG BOLJOON\nITINATAG BILANG BISITA NG CARCAR NG MGA AGUSTINO NOONG 1599.\nNAGING ISANG NAGSASARILING PAROKYA SA PAGTATANGKILIK NG NUESTRA SENORA DE PATROCINIO, 1690.\nINILIPAT SA PAMAMAHALA NG MGA HESWITA, 1737;\nIBINALIK SA MGA AGUSTINO, 1747.\nNATUPOK NG APOY ANG UNANG SIMBAHANG GAWA NG MGA AGUSTINO, 1782;\nIPINATAYO ANG KASALUKUYANG SIMBAHAN NI PADRE AMBROSIO OTERO , OSA, 1783;\nIPINAGPATULOY NI PADRE MANUEL CORDERO, OSA, 1794;\nGANAP NANATAPOS SA PANAHON NG PANUNUNGKULAN NI PADRE LEANDRO MORAN, OSA, 1920-1948.\nNAPASAILALIM SA PAMAMAHALA NG MGA SEKULAR NOONG MGA SUMUNOD NA TAON.\nIPINAHAYAG NA ISANG PAMBANSANG PALATANDAANG MAKASAYSAYAN NG PAMBANSANG SURIANG PANGKASAYSAYAN, DISYEMBRE 15, 1999 SA BISA NG KAUTUSAN NG PANGULO BILANG 260, AGOSTO 1, 1973 NA SINUSUGAN NG MGA KAUTUSAN NG PANGULO BILANG 375, ENERO 14, 1974 AT BILANG 1505, HUNYO 11, 1978.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/simbahan-ng-boljoon/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Iwahig Penal Colony*\" in Puerto Princesa City, Palawan (Region IV-B), installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1954. Marker text:\nIWAHIG PENAL COLONY\nORIGINALLY NAMED IUHUIT PENAL SETTLEMENT, THIS COLONY WAS ESTABLISHED BY THE PHILIPPINE COMMISSION, 16 NOVEMBER 1904.\nTHE SITE WAS SELECTED BY A COMMITTEE COMPOSED OF G.N.\nWOLFE, W.S.\nLYON AND ARLINGTON POND, CREATED BY AN EXECUTIVE ORDER OF GOV.\nGEN.\nLUKE E.\nWRIGHT.\nTHE FIRST SUPERINTENDENT WAS AN AMERICAN, R.J.\nSHIELDS.\nTHE EARLY POLICY OF SENDING THE WORST PRISONERS TO THE PLACE WAS ABANDONED AFTER THE MUTINY OF THIRTY-THREE PRISONERS ON 20 SEPTEMBER 1905.\nPRISONERS OF GOOD CONDUCT WERE SENT AND GIVEN LANDS, TOOLS AND OTHER SUPPLIES AND IN CERTAIN AREAS THEIR FAMILIES WERE ALLOWED TO LIVE WITH THEM.\nRAMON VICTORIO, FIRST FILIPINO SUPERINTENDENT, 1921.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/iwahig-penal-colony/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Fort San Felipe*\" in Cavite City, Cavite (Region IV-A) in February 10, 1978. Marker text:\nKUTA NG SAN FELIPE NERI\nISANG KUWADRADONG KUTA NA MAY APAT NA BASTIYON AT MALAWAK NA LIWASAN, ITO ANG UNANG KUTANG ITINAYO SA DAUNGAN NG KABITE SA PAGITAN NG 1609 AT 1616 NOONG KAPANAHUNAN NI GOB.\nJUAN DE SILUA.\nNOONG AGOSTO 1663 SI GOB.\nSABINIANO MANRIQUE DE LARA AY NAGPATAYO NG ISANG PLATAPORMA SA TARANGKAHAN NG KASTILYO PAKA PAGLAGYAN NG SAMPUNG KANYON.\nPAGKARAAN APAT PANG PLATAPORMA ANG ITINAYO AT HALOS LAHAT AY PINANGALANAN NA KASUNOD SA MGA SANTO.\nSA LAYUNING PANGKALIGTASAN APAT NA SIMBAHAN — ANG SAN FRANCISCO, SANTO DOMIGO, KAPISANAN NI HESUS, AT SAN NICOLAS — ANG GINIBA.\nNOONG AGOSTO 14,1782 ISANG MALAKAS NA BAGYO ANG NAGWASAK SA HALOS BUONG PADER NA MULING IPINATAYO NOONG MARSO 22, 1819 SA PAMAMAHALA NG GOBERNADOR POLITIKO-MILITAR NG LALAWIGAN.\nANG KUTA AY SINAKOP NG ISANG PANGKAT NA NAG-ALSA SA PAMUMUNO NI SARHENTO FRANCISCO LA MADRID NOONG GABI NG ENERO 20, 1872.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/fort-san-felipe/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Church of Pan-ay*\" in Pan-Ay, Capiz (Region VI), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 6 December 1997. Marker text:\nCHURCH OF PAN-AY\nPAN-AY ORIGINALLY CALLED BAMBAN, WAS ESTABLISHED IN 1572.\nTHE FIRST CHURCH, CONSTRUCTED IN 1774 BY FR.\nMIGUEL MURGUIA, WAS HEAVILY DAMAGED BY TYPHOON IN 1875.\nTHE PRESENT CHURCH WAS CONSTRUCTED IN 1884 UNDER THE DIRECTION OF FR.\nJOSE BELOSO WHO COMMISSIONED DON JUAN REINA TO CAST A BELL FOR THE CHURCH FROM SEVENTY SACKS OF COINS DONATED BY THE TOWNSPEOPLE.\nTHIS BELL, THE BIGGEST IN THE PHILIPPINES, MEASURES SEVEN FEET IN DIAMETER, FIVE FEET IN HEIGHT AND WEIGHS 10,000 KIL0GRAMS.\nBY VIRTUE OF NHI BOARD RESOLUTION N0.\n3, S.\n1997, THIS CHURCH IS DECLARED A NATIONAL HISTORICAL LANDMARK.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/church-of-pan-ay/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Simbahan Parokya ng Quipayo*\" in Calabanga, Camarines Sur (Region IV), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 1979. Marker text:\nSIMBAHANG PAROKYA NG QUIPAYO\nISA SA PINAKAMATATANDANG SIMBAHAN SA KABIKOLAN.\nITO AY ITINATAG NOONG 1578 NG MGA MISYONERONG PRANSISKANO NA SINA PRAYLE PABLO DE JESUS AT BARTOLOME RUIZ.\nPINAKAULO NG MGA NAUNANG MISYON, ANG BAYAN AY SUMAKOP SA MGA BISITA NG LIGMANAN (LIBMANAN), BANGON (SIRUMA), CALABANGAN (CALABANGA) AT BOMBON HANGGANG SA ANG MGA ITO AY NAGSARILI NOONG MGA TAONG 1586, 1687, AT 1749, AYON SA PAGKAKABANGGIT.\nMULA NOONG 1902 HANGGANG SA KASALUKUYAN, ANG QUIPAYO AY NAGING PAROKYANG BARYO NG BAYAN NG CALABANGA.\nBUHAT SA ORIHINAL NA NIPA AT KAHOY ANG KASALUKUYANG SIMBAHANG TISA AY IPINATAYO SA PAMAMAHALA NI PRAYLE FRANCISCO GAVIRIA NOONG 1616.\nGAYUNMAN, ANG HARAPAN NG SIMBAHAN AY NAGIBA NONG 1949 DAHIL SA MALAKAS NA PAG-ULAN.\nPATRONA NG PAROKYA AY ANG BIRHEN NG IMAKULADA KONSEPSIYON.\nNOONG 1659, NAGING PANGALAWANG PATRON NITO SI SAN ROQUE.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/simbahan-parokya-ng-quipayo/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"The Tejeros Convention*\" in Barrio Tejeros, San Francisco de Malabon (now General Trias) Cavite (Region IV-A), installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1941. Marker text:\nTHE TEJEROS CONVENTION\nA REVOLUTIONARY ASSEMBLY WAS HELD MARCH 22, 1897, IN THE BUILDING KNOWN AS THE CASA-HACIENDA OF TEJEROS, THAT ONCE STOOD ON THIS SITE.\nPRESIDED OVER BY ANDRES BONIFACIO TOWARD THE END OF THE SESSION, THE ASSEMBLY DECIDED TO ESTABLISH A CENTRAL REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT, AND ELECTED EMILIO AGUINALDO, PRESIDENT;\nMARIANO TRIAS, VICE-PRESIDENT;\nARTEMIO RICARTE, CAPTAIN GENERAL;\nEMILIANO RIEGO DE DIOS, DIRECTOR OF WAR;\nAND ANDRES BONIFACIO, DIRECTOR OF THE INTERIOR.\nCERTAIN EVENTS ARISING IN THE CONVENTION CAUSED BONIFACIO TO BOLT ITS ACTION.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/the-tejeros-convention/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Claro Recto y Mayo (1890–1960)*\" in Tiaong, Quezon (Region IV-A), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in February 8, 1984. Marker text:\nCLARO RECTO Y MAYO\n(1890–1960)\nMAKABAYAN, ESTADISTA, PARLAMENTARYAN, HUKOM, MAMBABATAS, AWTOR AT ORADOR.\nISINILANG SA TIAONG, QUEZON, NOONG PEBRERO 8, 1890, NAGTAPOS NG A.B.\nSA ATENEO DE MANILA 1909;\nLL.B.\nAT LL.M., PAMANTASAN NG SANTO TOMAS, 1913 AT 1914;\nLL.D.\nHONORIS CALISA, PAMANTASAN NG MAYNILA, 1936;\nAT PAMANTASAN NG ARELLANO, 1949, KINATAWAN NG BATANGAS AT LIDER NG MINORYA NG MABABANG KAPULUNGAN.\nSENADOR, AT PANSAMANTALANG PANGULO AT LIDER MAYORYA NG SENADO NG PILIPINAS.\nPANGULO, KONSTITUSYONAL KUMBENSYON AT AMA NG SALIGANG-BATAS NG PILIPINAS, 1934-1935.\nKASAPI SA BAR NG KATAAS-TAASANG HUKUMAN NG ESTADOS UNIDOS AT KATULONG NG MAHISTRADO NG KATAAS-TAASANG HUKUMAN NG PILIPINAS.\nMAY-AKDA NG TULANG BAJO LOS COCOTEROS, DULANG SOLO ENTRE LAS SOMBRAS, AT MARAMING AKLAT PAMBATAS AT PANGKASAYSAYAN.\nNAMATAY SA ROMA NOONG OKTUBRE 2, 1960.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/claro-recto-y-mayo-1890-1960/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"General Artemio Ricarte (Vibora) 20 October 1866 – 31 July 1945\" in Washington Street cor. Dewey Street, Batac, Ilocos Norte, installed by the National Historical Commission (NHC) in 1966. Marker text:\nGENERAL ARTEMIO RICARTE (VIBORA)\n20 OCTOBER 1866 – 31 JULY 1945\nTEACHER, SOLDIER, AND PATRIOT.\nBORN HERE IN BATAC, ILOCOS NORTE, TO ESTEBAN RICARTE Y FAUSTINO AND BONIFACIA GARCIA Y RIGONAN.\nHOLDER OF THE BACHELOR OF ARTS, SAN JUAN DE LETRAN, AND TEACHER’S CERTIFICATE FOR PRIMARY INSTRUCTION.\nPRINCIPAL OF THE SAN FRANCISCO DE MALABON PRIMARY SCHOOL IN CAVITE;\nBRIGADIER-GENERAL, MAGDIWANG FACTION;\nCHOSEN CAPTAIN-GENERAL BY THE TEJEROS CONVENTION.\nCAPTURED BY THE AMERICANS IN 1900.\nIMPRISONED AND BANISHED TO GUAM IN 1901.\nREFUSING TO TAKE THE OATH OF ALLEGIANCE TO THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT, HE LIVED ABROAD.\nRETURNED TO THE PHILIPPINES FROM JAPAN DURING WORLD WAR II.\nDIED IN BARRIO NAGPARAON, KALINGA, MT.\nPROVINCE.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/general-artemio-ricarte-vibora-20-october-1866-31-july-1945/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Battle of Alapan*\" in Alapan Elementary School, Alapan, Imus, Cavite (Region IV-A), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 1998. Marker text:\nBATTLE OF ALAPAN\nON THIS SITE, ON MAY 28, 1898, BETWEEN 10:00 A.M.\nTO 3:00 P.M., A BLOODY ENCOUNTER ENSUED BETWEEN FILIPINO REVOLUTIONARY FORCES AND APPROXIMATELY 270 SPANISH MARINES.\nTHIS BATTLE, WHICH RESULTED IN THE TRIUMPH OF FILIPINO FORCES, WAS TAKEN AS GLORIOUS OCCASION FOR GENERAL EMILIO AGUINALDO Y FAMY TO DISPLAY THE PHILIPPINE FLAG FOR THE FIRST TIME AT CAVITE NUEVO.\nTHE EVENT, WHICH MARKED THE BAPTISM OF FIRE AND GLORY OF THE PHILIPPINE FLAG, WAS THE BEGINNING OF THE SUCCESSFUL STRUGGLE TO OVERTHROW SPANISH RULE AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE PHILIPPINE REPUBLIC.\nBECAUSE OF THE HISTORICAL SIGNIFICANCE OF THIS DATE, PRESIDENT DIOSDADO MACAPAGAL ISSUED PROCLAMATION NO.\n374 DECLARING MAY 28 OF EACH YEAR AS NATIONAL FLAG DAY.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/battle-of-alapan/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Malacañan Palace\" in Malacañang Palace, Jose P. Laurel Street, San Miguel, Manila, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1941. Marker text:\nMALACAÑAN PALACE\nTHIS WAS THE FORMER SITE OF SUMMER RESIDENCE PURCHASED IN 1802 FROM LUIS ROCHA BY COLONEL MIGUEL JOSE FORMENTO, WHOSE TESTAMENTARY EXECUTORS SOLD IT TO THE SPANISH GOVERNMENT IN 1825.\nBY ROYAL DECREES OF 1847, THIS PROPERTY WAS SET ASIDE AS THE SUMMER RESIDENCE OF THE GOVERNOR GENERAL.\nTHE PALACE IN INTRAMUROS HAVING BEEN DESTROYED BY THE EARTHQUAKE OF JUNE 3, 1863, THE GOVERNOR GENERAL MOVED TO THIS PLACE, THEN KNOWN AS THE “POSESION DE MALACANAN:’ THIS BUILDING WAS RECONSTRUCTED, NEW LOTS WERE PURCHASED, OLD GROUNDS RAISED, REGRADED AND PARKED DURING AMERICAN AND FILIPINO ADMINISTRATIONS.\nEXTENSIVE IMPROVE¬MENTS WERE MADE IN 1929-1932 UNDER GOVERNOR GENERAL DWIGHT F.\nDAVIS AND IN 1935-1940 UNDER PRESIDENT MANUEL L.\nQUEZON, THE FIRST FILIPINO CHIEF EXECUTIVE TO OCCUPY THIS PALACE.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/malacanan-palace/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Balantang Memorial Cemetery National Shrine*\" in Jaro, Iloilo (Region VI), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in March 18, 1997. Marker text:\nBATTLE OF BALANTANG\nTHE BLOODIEST BATTLE FOUGHT BY THE PANAY GUERILLA FORCES LED BY COLONEL MACARIO PERALTA, JR., OCCURED IN THESE HOLLOWED GROUNDS OF BALANTANG AND ITS VICINITY FROM FEBRUARY 6 UP TO THE LIBERATION OF ILOILO CITY ON MARCH 20, 1945.\nTHOUGH OUTNUMBERED, THE FILIPINO FORCES STOOD STILL IN THEIR POST, REPULSING THE SEVEN SUICIDAL ATTACKS OF THE JAPANESE IMPERIAL FORCES, THUS ENABLING THE ALLIED 40TH INFANTRY DIVISION OF THE U.S.\nARMY UNDER MAJOR GENERAL RAPP BRUSH TO LAND PEACEFULLY AT TIGBAUAN, PARARA BEACH, ILOILO ON MARCH 18, 1945 AND JOIN THE GUERILLA FORCES OF COL.\nPERALTA IN THEIR MOPPING-UP OPERATION TO LIBERATE PANAY ISLANDS FROM THE JAPANESE.\nTHIS MONUMENT IS DEDICATED TO THE FREEDOM FIGHTERS OF PANAY AND ROMBLON WHO GAVE THEIR LIVES FOR THE CAUSE OF FREEDOM AND DEMOCRACY.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/balantang-memorial-cemetery-national-shrine/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Church of Abucay*\" in Abucay, Bataan (Region III), installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1939. Marker text:\nCHURCH OF ABUCAY\nTHE SPIRITUAL MINISTRATION OF ABUCAY WAS ENTRUSTED TO THE DOMINICANS IN 1588.\nA FIERCE BATTLE BETWEEN THE DUTCH INVADERS AND THE PAMPANGO DEFENDERS WAS FOUGHT IN THIS COURT ON JUNE 23, 1647.\nNEARLY TWO HUNDRED PAMPANGOS WERE PUT TO DEATH AND FORTY OTHERS, TOGETHER WITH THE SPANISH ALCALDE MAYOR AND TWO DOMINICAN PRIESTS WERE TAKEN PRISONERS TO BATAVIA.\nTHE PRESENT CHURCH WAS BADLY DAMAGED BY THE EARTHQUAKE OF SEPTEMBER 16, 1852.\nONE OF THE EARLIEST PRINTING PRESSES IN THE PHILIPPINES WAS OPERATED IN THIS TOWN, WHERE AS EARLY AS 1610 REV.\nFRANCISCO BLANCAS DE SAN JOSE, O.P., AND DON TOMAS PINPIN PRINTED SEVERAL BOOKS IN SPANISH AND TAGALOG.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/church-of-abucay/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Birthplace of Manuel Acuña Roxas\" in Roxas City, Capiz (Region VI), installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1958. Marker text:\nBIRTHPLACE OF MANUEL ACUNA ROXAS\nON THIS SITE OF THE TOWN CAPIZ, WAS BORN PRESIDENT MANUEL A.\nROXAS,1 JANUARY 1892.\nFIERY ORATOR, DIGNIFIED STATESMAN, REALISTIC ECONOMIST, AND TRUE PATRIOT.\nSECOND SON OF GERARDO ROXAS AND ROSARIO ACUNA.\nBECAME LAWYER IN 1913;\nTOWN COUNCILOR, 1917;\nPROVINCIAL GOVERNOR, 1919;\nSPEAKER, HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES, 1922-1934;\nSECRETARY OF FINANCE, 1941;\nPRESIDENT, PHILIPPINE SENATE, 1945-1946;\nLAST PRESIDENT OF THE COMMONWEALTH AND FIRST PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES, 1946-1948.\nDIED OF HEART ATTACK AFTER AN IMPASSIONED SPEECH IN DEFENSE OF DEMOCRACY AT CLARK FIELD, PAMPANGA AS GUEST OF MAJOR GENERAL EUGENE L.\nEUBANK, C.G., U.S.A., 13TH AIR FORCE, 15 APRIL 1948.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/birthplace-of-manuel-acuna-roxas/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "title": "Church of Barasoain",
  "content": "Historical marker \"Church of Barasoain\" in Malolos, Bulacan, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1940. Marker text:\nCHURCH OF BARASOAIN\nBARASOAIN WAS ORIGINALLY PART OF MALOLOS UNTIL ITS OFFICIAL SEPARATION ON AUGUST 31, 1859.\nIN 1903 IT BECAME PART OF MALOLOS AGAIN.\nTHE OLD CHURCH CONSTRUCTED BY REV.\nFRANCISCO ROYO, O.S.A., WAS DESTROYED BY FIRE IN MAY, 1884, BUT REBUILT BY REV.\nJUAN GIRON, O.S.A., IN 1885.\nTHIS CHURCH WAS THE SEAT OF THE REVOLUTIONARY CONGRESS WHICH CONVENED FROM THE MIDDLE OF SEPTEMBER, 1898, TO THE LAST WEEK OF FEBRUARY, 1899, UNDER THE PRESIDENCY OF PEDRO A.\nPATERNO.\nAMONG THE IMPORTANT MEASURES PASSED BY THE CONGRESS WAS THE MALOLOS CONSTITUTION, DRAFTED CHIEFLY BY FELIPE G.\nCALDERON.\nThe church is the site of the historic Malolos congress and the inauguration of the First Philippine Republic.\nThe museum focuses on the Philippine as Asia’s First Republic.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/church-of-barasoain/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Birthplace of Father Burgos\" in Vigan, Ilocos Sur (Region I), installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1939. Marker text:\nBIRTHPLACE OF FATHER BURGOS\nAT THIS PLACE, TOWN OF VIGAN, CAPITAL OF THE PROVINCE OF ILOCOS SUR, JOSE APOLONIO BURGOS, PRIEST AND MARTYR, WAS BORN FEBRUARY 9, 1837.\nHIS PARENTS WERE JOSE BURGOS, AN ARMY LIEUTENANT, AND DONA FLORENCIA GARCIA.\nFATHER BURGOS GRADUATED FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF SANTO TOMAS AND HELD VERY HIGH POSITIONS IN THE CATHEDRAL OF MANILA.\nTHROUGHOUT HIS ECCLESIASTICAL CAREER HE WAS A STAUNCH ADVOCATE OF THE UPLIFT OF THE SECULAR CLERGY.\nHE WAS EXECUTED IN BAGUMBAYAN FIELD FEBRUARY 17, 1872, TOGETHER WITH THE REV.\nMARIANO GOMEZ AND THE REV.\nJACINTO ZAMORA, FOR SUPPOSED IMPLICATION IN THE MILITARY REVOLT OF CAVITE, JANUARY 20, 1872.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/birthplace-of-father-burgos/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Simbahan ng Capul\" in Capul, Northern Samar (Region VIII), installed by the National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) in 5 August 2011.   "content": "Historical marker \"Lumang Simbahan ng Palapag\" in Palapag, Northern Samar (Region V), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in March 16, 2010. Marker text:\nLUMANG SIMBAHAN NG PALAPAG\nITINATAG NG MGA HESWITA BILANG MISYON NG CABO DE ESPIRITU SANTO SA HILAGANG SAMAR SA PATRONATO NG NUESTRA SEÑORA DE LA ASUNCION, 1605.\nIPINATAYO ANG UNANG SIMBAHAN NA YARI SA KAHOY AT NIPA.\nDITO NAGSIMULA ANG HIMAGSIKAN NI AGUSTIN SUMUROY NA LUMAGANAP SA IBANG BAHAGI NG SAMAR AT LEYTE, 1 HUNYO 1649.\nTINAPOS NI IGNACIO ALCINA, S.J.\nANG SIMBAHANG MAY HUGIS KRUS, KUMBENTO AT KUTA NA YARI SA KORALES AT BATO BILANG TANGGULAN SA MGA PIRATA, 1663.\nDITO TUMULOY ANG MGA HESWITA, PRANSISKANO, AT DOMINIKANO NA LULAN NG GALYONG “CONCEPCION” NA DUMAONG SA PALAPAG, 1666.\nISINAILALIM SA PAMAMAHALA NG MGA PARING PRANSISKANO, 1768–1941.\nHULING GINAMIT NANG MATAPOS ANG BAGONG SIMBAHAN, MGA TAONG 1970.\nIPINATAYO SA HARAPAN NITO ANG MALAKING KRUS BILANG ALAALA SA IKA-400 NA TAONG PAGKAKATATAG NG KRISTYANISMO SA HILAGANG SAMAR, 1995.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/lumang-simbahan-ng-palapag/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "title": "Roman Catholic Cathedral of Manila",
  "content": "Historical marker \"Roman Catholic Cathedral of Manila\" in Manila Cathedral, Intramuros, Manila, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1958. Marker text:\nROMAN CATHOLIC CATHEDRAL OF MANILA\nFIRST CATHEDRAL BUILT IN 1581, DAMAGED BY A TYPHOON, 1582 AND DESTROYED BY FIRE 1583.\nSECOND CATHEDRAL BUILT OF STONE IN 1592 AND PARTIALLY DESTROYED BY EARTHQUAKE, 1600.\nTHIRD CATHEDRAL BUILT OF STONE IN 1614 AND DESTROYED BY THE EARTHQUAKE OF 1645.\nFOURTH CATHEDRAL MAGNIFICENTLY BUILT IN 1654-1671 BY ARCHBISHOP MIGUEL POBLETE AND DESTROYED BY THE EARTHQUAKE OF3 JUNE 1863.\nFIFTH CATHEDRAL BUILT IN 1870-1879 UNDER ARCHITECTS LUCIANO OLIVER, VICENTE SERRANO SALAVERRIA AND EDUARDO LOPEZ NAVARRO AND SOLEMNLY BLESSED IN DECEMBER 1879.\nTHE CENTER OF THE CROSS ON THE DOME IS A REFERENCE POINT OF ASTRONOMICAL LONGITUDES OF MANILA IN 1945.\nSIXTH CATHEDRAL RECONSTRUCTION 1954-1958;\nUNDER THE DIRECTION OF ARCHBISHOP RUFINO J.\nSANTOS OF MANILA MAINLY WITH THE SUPPORT OF THE PEOPLE.\nFERNANDO OCAMPO, ARCHITECT.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/roman-catholic-cathedral-of-manila-2/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "title": "Church of Quiapo",
  "content": "Historical marker \"Church of Quiapo\" in Quiapo, Manila (Region NCR), installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1939. Marker text:\nCHURCH OF QUIAPO\nGOVERNOR GENERAL SANTIAGO DE VERA FOUNDED THE DISTRICT OF QUIAPO AUGUST 29, 1586.\nFRANCISCAN MISSIONARIES BUILT THE FIRST CHURCH, OF BAMBOO AND NIPA, THAT WAS BURNED IN 1639.\nREBUILDING AND REPAIRS AT INTERVALS GAVE THE PARISH THE STRONGER EDIFICE THAT THE EARTHQUAKE OF 1863 PARTIALLY DESTROYED.\nTHE NEXT CHURCH, COMPLETED IN 1899, WAS THE WORK OF REV.\nEUSEBIO DE LEON AND REV.\nMANUEL ROXAS, THE LATTER RAISING ₱40,000.00 IN CONTRIBUTONS.\nA FIRE ON OCTOBER 30, 1929, LEFT THE CHURCH ONLY ITS SCARRED WALLS AND BELFRY, AND A PARISH COMMITTEE HEADED BY DOÑA ENCARNACION NAKPIL DE ORENSE RAISED THE FUNDS FOR ITS RECONSTRUCTION.\nJUAN F.\nNAKPIL, ARCHITECT, DRAFTED THE PLANS FOR THE RECONSTRUCTED BUILDING.\nA FAMOUS IMAGE OF CHRIST BEARING THE CROSS, CALLED THE NAZARENE, IS THE CENTER OF INTENSE FRIDAY DEVOTIONS THROUGOUT THE YEAR.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/church-of-quiapo/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Unang Pagawaan ng Sapatos sa Marikina\" in Sentrong Pangkultura Kapitan Moy, Rizal St., Marikina City, installed by the National Historical Commission (NHC) in April 16, 1970. Marker text:\nUNANG PAGAWAAN NG SAPATOS SA MARIKINA\nSA BAHAY NA ITO, NA NAGING PAARALAN, IPINANGANAK SI LAUREANO GUEVARA (KAPITAN MOY), PANGUNAHING MANGGAGAWA NG SAPATOS SA MARIKINA.\nANAK NINA JOSE EMITERIO GUEVARA AT MATEA MARIQUITA ANDRES, NAGSIMULANG GUMAWA NG SAPATOS NANG MGA HULING ARAW NG TAONG 1887 SA TULONG NINA TIBURCIO EUSTAQUIO, AMBROSIO SANTA INES, GERVASIO CARLOS, AT IBA PA.\nNAKATUKLAS SILA NG MGA WASTONG PAMAMARAAN SA PAGGAWA NG SAPATOS.\nANG KANILANG PATULOY NA PANANAGUMPAY SA GAWAING ITO ANG NAGBUNSOD SA KAPULUNGANG-BAYAN NA MAGPATIBAY NG ISANG RESOLUSYON NOONG HULYO 2, 1968 UPANG GAWING ISANG MUSEO ANG BAHAY NA ITO.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/unang-pagawaan-ng-sapatos-sa-marikina/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nSIMBAHAN NG NUESTRA SEÑORA DE LOS DESEMPARADOS\nUNANG IPINATAYONG YARI SA PAWID AT KAWAYAN NG MGA PARING AGUSTINO SA CHORILLO (NGAYO’Y BARANGKA), 1572.\nINILIPAT SA JESUS DE LA PEÑA NANG ANG VISITA AY NALIPAT SA ILALIM NG PANGANGASIWA NG MGA PARING HESWITA, 1630;\nPINASINAYAAAN AT GINANAP ANG UNANG MISA, ABRIL 16, 1630.\nMULING INILIPAT AT IPINAGAWA ANG SIMBAHANG BATO SA KASALUKUYANG KINATATAYUAN NITO, 1687;\nGANAP NA NATAPOS AT NAGING ISANG PAROKYA, 1690.\nNASUNOG ANG MALAKING BAHAGI NG NOONG DIGMAANG PILIPINO LABAN SA KASTILA AT PILIPINO LABAN SA AMERIKANO.\nNASIRA ANG KAMPANARYO NOONG IKALAWANG DIGMAANG PANDAIGDIG.\nPINASIMULANG AYUSIN AT PAGANDAHIN SIMULA PA NOONG 1951 NG KURA PAROKO SA TULONG NG MGA SAMAHANG PANRELIHIYON, SIBIKO AT MAMAMAYAN.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/simbahan-ng-nuestra-senora-de-los-desamparados/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Church of San Fernando, La Union\" in San Fernando City, La Union (Region I), installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1949. Marker text:\nCHURCH OF SAN FERNANDO, LA UNION\nCHAPEL MADE OF STONE AND THATCH ERECTED, 1764 BY FR.\nFRANCISCO ROMERO AND SANTIAGO HOLARTE AT BARRIO SAN VICENTE FORMERLY KNOWN AS PINDANGAN AFTER WHICH SAN FERNANDO WAS FIRST CALLED.\nMOVED TO TANQUE, THEN TO KABAROAN, AND AFTERWARDS TO ITS PRESENT SITE WHERE IT WAS BUILT OF STONE AND BRICK BY FR.\nJUAN SOROLLA, SIMON GUILLERMO AND PEDRO FERNANDO, 1773–1786.\nDAMAGED BY EARTHQUAKE, 1892.\nOCCUPIED BY THE REVOLUTIONISTS UNDER COL.\nBLAS VILLAMOR, 1898, WHEN THEY OVERWHELMED THE SPANISH FORCES THAT SOUGHT SHELTER THEREIN.\nDESTROYED DURING THE LIBERATION, 26 FEBRUARY 1945.\nRECONSTRUCTED BY THE RESIDENTS THROUGH THE EFFORTS OF BISHOP SANTIAGO C.\nSANCHO, 1947–1949.\nREDEDICATED, 10 FEBRUARY 1949.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/church-of-san-fernando-la-union/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Blumentritt Street, San Juan City, installed by the Historical Research and Markers Committee in 1937. Marker text:\nCHURCH OF SAN JUAN DEL MONTE\nTHE CHURCH AND CONVENT WERE BUILT IN 1602-1604 BY THE DOMINICAN PROVINCE OF THE MOST HOLY ROSARY ON A SITE DONATED BY CAPTAIN JULIAN DE CUENCA.\nBOTH BUILDINGS WERE BURNED DURING THE CHINESE UPRISING OF 1639.\nTHE NEW CHURCH AND CONVENT, CONSTRUCTED IN 1641, WERE SET ON FIRE IN JULY 1763 DURING THE BRITISH OCCUPATION OF MANILA.\nTHE PRESENT CHURCH AND CONVENT, CONSTRUCTED IN 1774, WERE USED BY THE INSURGENT FORCES OF THE REVOLUTION OF 1898.\nTHIS SANCTUARY IS THE SEAT OF THE CONFRATERNITY OF SANTISIMO CRISTO DE SAN JUAN DEL MONTE APPROVED BY POPE INNOCENT X ON MARCH 4, 1648.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/church-of-san-juan-del-monte/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "title": "Carriedo Fountain, Manila",
  "content": "Historical marker \"Carriedo Fountain, Manila\" in Sta. Cruz, Manila (Region NCR), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in July 24, 1997. Marker text:\nCARRIEDO FOUNTAIN\nITINAYO NOONG MAYO 1882 BILANG BAHAGI NG CARRIEDO WATERWORKS SYSTEM NA PINASIMULAN NI GOBERNADOR-HENERAL DOMINGO MORIONES NOONG 1878.PINASINAYAAN NI GOBERNADOR-HENERAL PRIMO DE RIVERA NOONG 24 HULYO 1882 AT IPINANGALAN KAY FRANCISCO CARRIEDO Y PEREDO, ANG KASTILANG PENINSULAR AT HENERAL NG GALYONG “SANTA FAMILIA” NA NAGKALOOB NG SAMPUNG LIBONG PISO UPANG IPAGAWA ANG PATUBIG.\nNILAGYAN NG MGA PALAMUTI NG PAMAHALAANG LUNGSOD NG MAYNILA NOONG 1891.\nORIHINAL NA ITINAYO SA ROTONDA DE SAMPALOC, INILIPAT NG METROPOLITAN WATERWORKS AND SEWERAGE SYSTEM SA MWSS, BALARA, LUNGSOD NG QUEZON NOONG 1982 BILANG BAHAGI NG PAGGUNITA SA IKASANDAANG TAONG PAGKAKATAYO NITO.\nMULING IBINALIK SA PANGANGASIWA NG PAMAHALAANG LUNGSOD NG MAYNILA SA PAMAMAGITAN NG KAGALANGGALANG ALKALDE ALFREDO S.\nLIM.\nITINAYO SA POOK NA ITO AT PINASINAYAAN NOONG 24 HULYO 1997.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/carriedo-fountain-manila/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Embassy of the United States of America Chancery\" in Roxas Boulevard, Ermita, Manila (Region NCR), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in September 22, 2005. Marker text:\nEMBASSY OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA CHANCERY\nTHIS BUILDING OPENED IN 1940 TO HOUSE THE OFFICES AND RESIDENCE OF THE U.S.\nHIGH COMMISSIONER IN THE PHILIPPINES, FRANCIS B.\nSAYRE.\nDURING WORLD WAR II, JAPANESE IMPERIAL FORCES OCCUPIED THIS BUILDING UNTIL THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE JAPANESE-SPONSORED REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES ON OCTOBER 14, 1943, WHEN IT BECAME THE JAPANESE EMBASSY IN THE PHILIPPINES.\nTHE U.S.\nARMY’S 12TH CAVALRY LIBERATED THE COMPOUND ON FEBRUARY 20, 1945, FOLLOWING INTENSE FIGHTING DURING THE BATTLE FOR MANILA.\nAFTER THE WAR, THE STILL INTACT BALLROOM SERVED AS THE COURTHOUSE FOR THE WORLD WAR II WAR CRIMES TRIALS OF JAPANESE IN THE PHILIPPINES.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/embassy-of-the-united-states-of-america-chancery/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Memorare – Manila 1945\" in Intramuros, Manila (Region NCR), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 1996. Marker text:\nMEMORARE – MANILA 1945\nTHIS MONUMENT IS ERECTED IN MEMORY OF THE MORE THAN 100,000 DEFENSELESS CIVILIANS WHO WERE KILLED DURING THE BATTLE FOR THE LIBERATION OF MANILA BETWEEN FEBRUARY 3 AND MARCH 3, 1945.\nTHEY WERE MAINLY VICTIMS OF HEINOUS ACTS PERPETRATED BY THE JAPANESE IMPERIAL FORCES AND THE CASUALTIES OF THE HEAVY ARTILLERY BARRAGE BY THE AMERICAN FORCES.\nTHE BATTLE FOR MANILA AT THE END OF WORLD WAR II WAS ONE OF THE MOST BRUTAL EPISODE IN THE HISTORY OF ASIA AND THE PACIFIC.\nTHE NON-COMBATANT VICTIMS OF THAT TRAGIC BATTLE WILL REMAIN FOREVER IN THE HEARTS AND MINDS OF THE FILIPINO PEOPLE.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/memorare-manila-1945/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nCHURCH OF MAUBAN\nTHE TOWN, SUCCESSFULLY LOCATED AT THE PINAGBAYANAN, BALAYBALAY, AND SOLEDAD, WAS TRANSFERRED TO THIS SITE IN 1647.\nTHE FIRST CHURCH AND THE FIRST CONVENT, CONSTRUCTED IN 1647, WERE DEMOLISHED IN 1769.\nTHE SECOND CHURCH AND THE SECOND CONVENT WERE COMPLETED IN 1773.\nTHE CONVENT WERE BADLY DAMAGED IN THE EARTHQUAKE OF 1830 AND REBUILT BETWEEN 1836 AND 1945.\nTHE OLD CHURCH COLLAPSED DURING THE EARTHQUAKES OF JULY, 1880.\nTHE PRESENT CHURCH WAS BUILT IN 1891.\nTHE BELFRY, CONSTRUCTED IN 1773, WAS SERIOUSLY DAMAGED DURING THE EARTHQUAKES OF 1880 AND THE PORTION OF WHICH REMAINED WAS PARTIALLY DESTROYED AGAIN BY THE EARTHQUAKE OF AUGUST 20, 1937.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/church-of-mauban/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Church of Nuestra Señora de Manaoag\" in Manaoag, Pangasinan (Region I), installed by the Historical Research and Markers Committee in 1937. Marker text:\nCHURCH OF NUESTRA SEÑORA DE MANAOAG\nADMINISTERED SINCE 1605 BY THE DOMINICANS, THE FIRST CHURCH OF WOOD LASTED A CENTURY.\nTHE SECOND ONE, WHICH WAS OF STONE, WAS BUILT THROUGH THE GENEROSITY OF GASPAR DE GAMBOA AND AGATA YANGTA, AND INAUGRATED IN 1720.\nIN 1733 IT WAS DONATED TO THE DOMINICAN CORPORATION, BUT WAS DESTROYED BY THE EARTHQUAKE OF 1892.\nTHE PROVISIONAL CHURCH, BUILT OF WOOD, WAS BURNED DURING THE INSURRECTION OF 1898.\nTHE RECONSTRUCTION OF THE PRESENT CHURCH BEGAN IN 1901 WITH THE RETURN OF THE DOMINICANS.\nTHE IMAGE OF NUESTRA SEÑORA DE MANAOAG IS FAMOUS THROUGHOUT PANGASINAN.\nIT WAS PRESERVED IN DAGUPAN DURING THE REVOLUTION, THEN TAKEN BACK TO THE SANCTUARY BY THE PEOPLE OF MANAOAG WHERE IT WAS SOLEMNLY CROWNED ON APRIL 21, 1926, IN THE PRESENCE OF THOUSANDS OF THE FAITHFUL, BY MONS.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/church-of-nuestra-senora-de-manaoag/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Jose Ma. Panganiban y Enverga (1863–1890)\" in Jose Panganiban, Camarines Norte (Region V), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI). Marker text:\nJOSE MA.\nPANGANIBAN Y ENVERGA\n(1863–1890)\nMANUNULAT, SIYENTIPIKO, ORADOR AT PROPAGANDISTA.\nISINILANG NOONG PEBRERO 1, 1863, SA MAMBULAO (NGAYO’Y JOSE PANGANIBAN) CAMARINES NORTE.\nNAG-ARAL, MABABANG PAARALAN SA SEMINARYO NG NUEVA CACERES (NGAYO’Y NAGA), MATAAS NA PAARALAN SA SAN JUAN DE LETRAN, MAYNILA.\nKUNG SAAN NAKAMIT ANG A.B., AT MEDISINA SA PAMANTASAN NG SANTO TOMAS AT PAMANTASAN NG BARCELONA, ESPANYA.\nMANANALAYSAY AT TAGASALINGWIKA NG LA SOLIDARIDAD.\nNAMATAY SA BARCELONA NOONG AGOSTO 19, 1890.\nBILANG ALAALA, SINULAT NI JOSE RIZAL: “NAMATAY SIYANG HINDI NAISAKATUPARAN ANG ISANG DAKILANG ADHIKAIN NA INILAAN SA KANYA NG KANYANG TALINONG HINDI-MAPANTAYAN.\nHINDI LUHA ANG KANYANG PINAKAMIMITHING KASAYSAYAN KUNDI ANG NAKIKITANG GAWA: HINDI PARA SA KANYANG SARILI, KUNDI PARA SA KANYANG BAYAN.”\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/jose-ma-panganiban-y-enverga-1863-1890-2/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Plaza Aviles (Freedom Park)\" in San Miguel, Manila (Region NCR), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in February 27, 1995. Marker text:\nLIBERATION OF MANILA\nLATE IN THE AFTERNOON OF FEBRUARY 3, 1945 TWO GROUPS OF THE FLYING COLUMNS OF THE 1 ST CAVALRY DIVISION, INCLUDING THE ATTACHED 44TH TANK BATALLION, ENTERED MANILA, WITH THE FIRST GROUP TAKING POSSESSION OF MALACANANG PALACE AND THE SECOND GROUP LIBERATING THE AMERICAN AND OTHER ALLIED CIVILIAN INTERNEES AT THE UNIVERSITY OF STO.\nTOMAS.\nTHEY WERE FOLLOWED BY THE 37THINFANTRY DIVISION, WHICH RESCUED ALLIED CIVILIAN INTERNEES AND PRISONERS OF WAR AT BILIBID PRISON.\nFROM THE SOUTH THE 11TH AIRBORNE DIVISION CLOSED IN ON MANILA.\nTHE JAPANESE IMPERIAL FORCES WERE ANNIHILATED BY FEBRUARY 24.\nIN A SOLEMN CEREMONY IN MALACANANG AT ELEVEN O’CLOCK IN THE MORNING OF FEBRUARY 27, 1945, GENERAL DOUGLAS MACARTHUR RESTORED THE SEAT OF THE COMMONWEALTH GOVERNMENT – MANILA, THE CAPITAL OF THE PHILIPPINES, TO PRESIDENT SERGIO OSMENA, SR.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/plaza-aviles-freedom-park/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Guho ng Simbahang Katoliko ng Dingras\" in Dingras, Ilocos Norte (Region I), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in March 19, 1987. Marker text:\nGUHO NG SIMBAHANG KATOLICO NG DINGRAS\nBAKAS NG ISANG SIMBAHANG SINIRA NG LINDOL AT APOY, 1913.\nMAY BUBONG NA YERO, MALAKI AT MATIBAY NA PADER.\nANG SIMBAHAN NA MAY HABANG 90 HAKBANG AT LAPAD NA 20 HAKBANG, AY ISA SA PINAKAMALAKI SA PILIPINAS.\nNAGSIMULANG VISITA NG BATAC, GINAWANG PAROKYA NG MGA AGUSTINO AT INIALAY SA PATRONG SAN JOSE;\nSI PADRE BARTOLOME CONRADO ANG UNANG KURA, 1598.\nIBINALIK SA PAGKAVISITA, 1603;\nNAGING PAROKYANG MULI BILANG SENTRO NG MISYON, 1605.\nNASIRA NG LINDOL, 1619;\nMULING IPINAGAWA BAGO NASUNOG, 1838 AT NASIRA NG KIDLAT,1853.\nHULING IPINATAYO NI PADRE RICARDO DEZA SA PAGGAWA NG 2 POLISTAS BUHAT SA BAWAT ISA NG 58 CABECERIAS SA HALAGANG 28,649.31 PISO NG MEHIKO, SA TULONG NI ALKALDE MAYOR CAMILO MILLAN,1879-1893.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/guho-ng-simbahang-katoliko-ng-dingras/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nPOOK NA KINAMATAYAN NI DOÑA AURORA ARAGON QUEZON\nSA POOK NA ITO, NOONG IKA-28 NG ABRIL 1949, SINA DOÑA AURORA ARAGON QUEZON, KANYANG ANAK, MARIA AURORA;\nMANUGANG, PHILIP BUENCAMINO III;\nAT ANG PUNONG BAYAN NG LUNGSOD NG QUEZON, PONCIANO BERNARDO, AY TINAMBANGAN AT PINASLANG.\nANG PANGKAT AY PATUNGONG BALER, TAYABAS (NGAYO’Y QUEZON) UPANG DUMALO SA PAGPAPASINAYA NG BALER MEMORIAL HOSPITAL AT PAGHAHAWI NG TABING NG MAKASAYSAYANG PALATANDAAN PARA KAY PANGULONG MANUEL L.\nQUEZON.\nSI DONA AURORA, KAUNA-UNAHANG UNANG GINANG NG BANSA AY KILALANG-KILALA SA KANYANG MGA GAWAING SIBIKO PARA SA MGA MAHIHIRAP AT KAPUS-PALAD.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/pook-na-kinamatayan-ni-dona-aurora-aragon-quezon/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "title": "Church of Orani",
  "content": "Historical marker \"Church of Orani\" in Orani, Bataan (Region III), installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1939. Marker text:\nCHURCH OF ORANI\nORANI BECAME AN INDEPENDENT MISSIONARY CENTER IN 1714.\nTHE CHURCH AND THE CONVENT OF ORANI, REPAIRED IN 1792 AND 1836, WERE BADLY DAMAGED BY THE EARTHQUAKE OF 16 SEPTEMBER 1852.\nTHEY WERE REBUILT AND IMPROVED UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF THE REV.\nBARTOLOME ALVAREZ DEL MANZANO, O.P., IN 1868, AND OF THE REV.\nFERMIN PEREZ SAN JULIAN, O.P., IN 1891, AND WERE DESTROYED ON 16 MARCH 1938, BY THE FIRE WHICH RAZED ABOUT THREE FOURTHS OF ORANI INCLUDING THE TOWN HALL, THE TERCENA – FORMER BATAAN HIGH SCHOOL AND LATER ORANI ELEMENTARY SCHOOL BUILDING.\nTHE CHURCH WAS RECONSTRUCTED IN SEPTEMBER, 1938.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/church-of-orani/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Lalloc-Nueva Segovia\" in Lallo Church facade, Lallo, Cagayan (Region II), installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1939. Marker text:\nLALLOC–NUEVA SEGOVIA\nTHE TOWN OF LALLOC, NAMED NUEVA SEGOVIA BY JUAN PABLO CARRION IN 1581, WAS VISITED BY JUAN SALCEDO IN 1572 AND BY LUIS PEREZ DASMARIÑAS IN 1592.\nLALLOC WAS THE SEAT OF THE DIOCESE OF NUEVA SEGOVIA, CREATED BY POPE CLEMENT VIII ON AUGUST 15, 1595, AND CONTINUED TO BE SO UP TO 1755, WHEN IT WAS TRANSFERRED TO VIGAN.\nIT WAS THE CAPITAL OF CAGAYAN UP TO 1839, WHEN THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT WAS MOVED TO TUGUEGARAO.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/lalloc-nueva-segovia/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nBIRTHPLACE OF MANUEL LUIS QUEZON\nON THIS SITE OF THIS TOWN, BALER, WAS BORN MANUEL LUIS QUEZON, 19 AUGUST 1878.\nINDOMITABLE CRUSADER OF PHILIPPINE INDEPENDENCE AND SOCIAL JUSTICE, GREAT AND FIERY STATESMAN, DYNAMIC AND FAR-SIGHTED LEADER, AND TRUE PATRIOT.\nSON OF LUCIO QUEZON AND MARIA MOLINA.\nBECAME A SOLDIER IN 1899, LAWYER, 1903;\nMEMBER, FIRST PHILIPPINE ASSEMBLY, 1907–1909;\nRESIDENT COMMISSIONER AT WASHINGTON, D.C., 1909–1916;\nPRESIDENT, PHILIPPINE SENATE, 1916–1935;\nPRESIDENT, COMMONWEALTH OF THE PHILIPPINES, 1935–1944.\nDIED AT SARANAC LAKE, NEW YORK, 1 AUGUST 1944.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/birthplace-of-manuel-luis-quezon/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Where “Ang Kalayaan” Was Printed\" in San Nicolas, Manila (Region NCR), installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1941. Marker text:\nWHERE “ANG KALAYAAN” WAS PRINTED\nTHE HOUSE WAS OCCUPIED BY DR.\nPIO VALENZUELA TOGETHER WITH ULPIANO FERNANDEZ AND FAUSTINO DUQUE, FILIPINO PRINTERS WHO TURNED OUT FOR DR.\nVALENZUELA AND EMILIO JACINTO 2000 COPIES OF THE NEWSPAPER ENTITLED “ANG KALAYAAN” GIVING YOKOHAMA AS THE PLACE OF PUBLICATION TO EVADE SUSPICION.\nTHE FIRST ISSUE WAS DATED JANUARY 18, 1896, BUT WAS NOT CIRCULATED UNTIL THE MIDDLE OF MARCH.\nTHE SECOND ISSUE, IN PREPARATION, WAS SEIZED BY THE SPANISH AUTHORITIES WHEN THE REVOLUTION BROKE OUT THAT YEAR.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/where-ang-kalayaan-was-printed/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Simbahan ng Obando\" in Obando, Bulacan (Region III), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in April 28, 1984. Marker text:\nSIMBAHAN NG OBANDO\nIPINATAYO NG MGA PARING PRANSISKANO SA PANGUNGUNA NI REB.\nP MANUEL DE OLIVENCIA, UNANG KURA NG OBANDO, NOONG 29 ABRIL 1754.\nIPINAGAWA ANG PANGALAWANG SIMBAHANG BATO NA MAY MAGANDANG KRUSERO NG MGA NANINIRAHAN BUHAT SA BUWIS NA NASINGIL SA LOOB NG DALAWANG TAON.\nIGINUHO NG MALAKAS NA PANGANGANYON NOONG LIBERASYON NG 1945.\nMULING IPINAGAWA ANG SIMBAHAN AT KUMBENTO NG MGA TAGA-PAROKYA SA PANGUNGUNA NI REB.\nP MARCOS C.\nPUNZAL SA LOOB NG DALAWANG TAON.\nPINAG-IBAYO ANG PAGSASAAYOS SA PANGANGASIWA NI D.\nREB.\nMONS.\nROME R.\nFERNANDEZ, H.P IPINAGDIRIWANG ANG KAPISTAHAN NG BAYAN TUWING IKA-17,18 AT 19 NG MAYO BILANG PARANGAL KINA SAN PASCUAL DE BAILON, KABILANG ANG PAGSASAYAW UPANG MAGKAANAK;\nSANTA CLARA, PATRONA NG MGA NAGLILIHING INA;\nAT NUESTRA SENORA DE SALAMBAO, PATRONA NG MGA MANGINGISDA AT MAGBUBUKID.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/simbahan-ng-obando/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nSIMBAHAN NG HAGONOY\nANG BAYAN AY ITINATAG NG MGA PARING AGUSTINO NOONG 1581.\nYARI SA MAGAGAANG KAGAMITAN, ANG UNANG SIMBAHAN AY IPINAGAWA SA ILALIM NG PATRONANG SI SANTA ANA.\nUNANG PARI NITO SI PADRE DIEGO ORDOÑEZ VIVAR.\nPAGKARAAN, ANG SIMBAHAN AY BINAGO AT GINAMITAN NG MGA BATO AT LADRILYO, SINA PADRE JOAQUIN MARTINEZ ZUÑIGA, KILALANG MANANALAYSAY NA AGUSTINO, AT PADRE MARIANO SEVILLA, ISANG MALIKHAING MANUNULAT NA TAGALOG, AY NAGING MGA KURA PAROKO NG BAYANG ITO.\nANG SIMBAHAN AY IPINAAYOS NOONG 1936–1963;\nBINAGO NOONG 1968 AT INIHANDOG SA PANGINOON NOONG IKA 25 NG HULYO 1970.\nANG BAYAN NG LILIW\nITINATAG ANG BAYANG ITO NOONG 29 AGOSTO 1571, SA PAMUMUNO NI GAT TAYAW.\nANG BAHAY-PAMAHALAAN AY MULING ITINAYO NOONG 1928.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/simbahan-ng-hagonoy/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Ramon Magsaysay (1907–1957)\" in Mount Manunggal, Brgy. Sunog, Balamban, Cebu, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 1988. Marker text:\nRAMON MAGSAYSAY\n(1907–1957)\nIDOLO NG MASA, KILALA SA TAWAG NA “THE GUY.” ISINILANG NOONG AGOSTO 31, 1907 SA IBA, ZAMBALES.\nNAGKAMIT NG BSC, JOSE RIZAL COLLEGE, MANDALUYONG, RIZAL.\nPANGKALAHATANG PUNO, ZAMBALES MILITARY DISTRICT, 1942;\nPANGHUKBONG PUNONG-LALAWIGAN NG ZAMBALES AT ITINAAS SA PAGKA-MEDYO NI HENERAL DOUGLAS MACARTHUR, 1945;\nKINATAWAN, 1946–1950;\nKALIHIM NG NATIONAL DEFENSE, 1950;\nPANGATLONG PANGULO NG PILIPINAS, 1953.\nKUMUHA NG ROGERS BILL SA ESTADOS UNIDOS PARA SA MGA BETERANONG PILIPINO AT SUMUPIL NG MGA HUKBALAHAP.\nNAGTATAG NG PRESIDENT’S ACTION COMMITTEE (PCAC), NATIONAL REHABILITATION AND RESETTLEMENT ADMINISTRATION (NARRA), NATIONAL MARKETING CORPORATION (NAMARCO), AT LAND TENURE ADMINISTRATION (LTA).\nNAMATAY NANG BUMAGSAK ANG SINASAKYANG MT.\nPINATUBO SA POOK NA ITO, NOONG MARSO 17, 1957.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/ramon-magsaysay-1907-1957-3/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "title": "Rizal Hill Park",
  "content": "Historical marker \"Rizal Hill Park\" in Mauban, Quezon (Region IV-A), installed by the National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) in 2011. Marker text:\nRIZAL HILL PARK\nNAKILALA SA TAWAG NA CALVARIO, DATING BAHAGI NG BULUBUNDUKIN NG SIERRA MADRE NA NANG MALAON AY NAHIWALAY SA PAGTATABAS NG LUPA UPANG GAWING KALSADA.\nPINAKAMATAAS NA BAHAGI NG KABAYANAN NA GINAMIT BILANG BANTAYAN AT SA MGA GAWAING PANRELIHIYON NOONG PANAHON NG ESPANYOL.\nNAGING PUNONG HIMPILAN NG MGA SUNDALONG AMERIKANO AT BANTAYAN NG PHILIPPINE CONSTABULARY NOONG PANAHON NG AMERIKANO, AT NG CIVILIAN EMERGENCY ADMINISTRATION NOONG PANAHON NG HAPON.\nITINAYO ANG BANTAYOG PARA KAY JOSE RIZAL, DISYEMBRE 1925.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/rizal-hill-park/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Simbahan ng Tayabas\" in Tayabas, Quezon (Region IV-A), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in November 11, 1982. Marker text:\nANG SIMBAHAN NG TAYABAS\nANG UNANG SIMBAHAN NA YARI SA KAWAYAN, NIPA AT ANAHAW AY IPINATAYO NG MGA PRAYLENG PRANSISKANO NOONG 1585 SA ILALIM NG PATRONATO NI SAN MIGUEL ARKANGHEL.\nITO AY MULING IPINAAYOS NI SAN JUAN BAUTISTA NOONG 1590.\nNOONG 1600 ISANG SIMBAHANG YARI SA TISA ANG IPINATAYO SUBALIT ITO AY GINIBA NG LINDOL NOONG 1743.\nNANG SUMUNOD NA MGA TAON ANG SIMBAHAN AY MULING IPINAGAWA AT PINALAKIHAN.\nITO AY HIGIT PANG PINALAKI NOONG 1856 SA PAMAMAGITAN NG PAGPAPAGAWA NG TRANSEPTO AT KUPOLA.\nANG BUBONG NA TISA NG TRANSEPTO AY PINALITAN NG GABANISADONG YERO NOONG 1894.\nANG SIMBAHANG ITO AY ISA SA PINAKAMAGANDANG SIMBAHAN SA PILIPINAS.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/simbahan-ng-tayabas/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Ladislao Bonus (1854–1908)\" in 1141 Teodoro San Luis Street, Pandacan, Manila, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 1980. Marker text:\nLADISLAO BONUS\n(1854–1908)\nANG “AMA NG OPERANG PILIPINO”, DALUBHASANG MUSIKO, KOMPOSITOR AT GURO SA MUSIKA.\nSI LADISLAO BONUS AY ISINILANG SA POOK NA ITO NOONG IKA-27 NG HUNYO 1854, KINA PEDRO BONUS AT MARIA MARIANO.\nMAYKATHA NG UNANG OPERANG PILIPINO ANG “SANDUGONG PANAGINIP” NI PEDRO A.\nPATERNO, NAGLAPAT NG TUGTUGIN SA “RECUERDOS A LA PATRIA” NI DR.\nJOSE RIZAL, AT MAYKATHA PA RIN NG MARAMING TUGTUGIN SA SARSUELANG PILIPINO, MISA, ROSARYO KANTADA, GOZO AT MGA KANTAHING-BAYAN NA NAGING DAHILAN UPANG ANG PANDACAN AY KILALANING “MUNTING ITALYA NG PILIPINAS.”\nSIYA AY NAMATAY NOONG IKA-28 NG MARSO, 1908.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/ladislao-bonus-1854-1908/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Honorio Lopez (1875-1958)\" in Plaza Moriones, Moriones Street cor. Nicolas Zamora Street, Tondo, Manila in 2010. Marker text:\nHONORIO LOPEZ\n(1875–1958)\nMANDUDULA AT REBOLUSYONARYO.\nISINILANG SA STA.\nCRUZ, MAYNILA, 30 DISYEMBRE 1875 AT LUMAKI SA TONDO.\nNAGTAPOS NG BACHILLER EN ARTES SA COLEGIO DE SAN JUAN DE LETRAN.\nSUMAPI SA HIMAGSIKANG FILIPINO.\nNAGING TINYENTE KOLONEL AT HEPE NG REHIMYENTO IMPANTERIYA RAXA MATANDA “VIBORA”, SA ILALIM NG PAMUMUNO NI HEN.\nARTEMIO RICARTE.\nNAGPATULOY NG PAKIKIBAKA LABAN SA MGA AMERIKANO, 1899.\nMAY-AKDA NG CALENDARIONG FILIPINO “DIMASALANG”.\nKASAMA NI JUAN ABAD NA NAGTATAG NG LA JUVENTUD FILIPINA, ISANG KUMPANYA NA NAGTATANGHAL NG MGA DULANG MAKABAYAN.\nNAGING PATNUGOT NG PAHAYAGANG LIBRE, LA PATRIA AT LA CONSOLIDACION NOONG PANAHON NG MGA AMERIKANO.\nPROPESOR NG AGRIMENSURA AT SEGUNDA ENSEÑANZA;\nDIREKTOR NG KOLEHIYO, INSTITUTO PATRIO, CA.\n1907–09.\nASESOR TECNICO, COMITE CENTRAL NG UNION AGRARIA DE FILIPINAS.\nNAHALAL NA KONSEHAL NG MAYNILA, 1916–1919.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/honorio-lopez-1875-1958/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nKAPILYA NG SAN JACINTO\nITINAYO NG MGA DOMINIICANO NOONG 1604 SA KARANGALAN NI SAN JACINTO.\nMULING ITINAYO NI FRAY BERNABE DE LA MAGDALENA AT PINASINAYAAN NOONG AGOSTO 16, 1724.\nDITO ITINATAG AT IPINAG-UTOS NI DON JOSEPH ARZADUN DE REBOLLEDO NG AUDIENCIA REAL DE MANILA ANG PONDONG PAMPAMAYANAN AT ALITUNTUNIN SA MAMAMAYAN NG CAGAYAN NOONG 1739.\nPINALAMUTIHAN NG MGA MAMAMAYAN SA PAMAMATNUBAY NI GOBERNADORSILYO DOMINGO BALINO AT PINANGANLANG HERMTlA DE PIEDRA DE SAN jACINTO NOONG 1722.\nGINAMIT NA KUWARTEL NG MGA MANGHIHIMAGSIK AT KANLUNGAN NG MGA SUNDALONG AMERIKANO NOONG DIGMAANG PILIPINO-AMERIKANO.\nKASALUKUYANG PINAMAMAHALAAN NG ST.\nPAUL SISTERS.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/kapilya-ng-san-jacinto-2/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"The Battle of Bessang Pass\" in Cervantes, Ilocos Sur (Region I), installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1954. Marker text:\nTHE BATTLE OF BESSANG PASS\nBEGAN WITH THE ASSAULT ON THE JAPANESE LINE AT BITALAG, TAGUDIN, ILOCOS SUR, BY THE UNITED STATES ARMY FORCES IN THE PHILIPPINES, NORTH LUZON (USAFIP, NL), 8 JANUARY 1945, FOLLOWED BY THE SEIZURE OF ENEMY STRONGHOLDS ALONG HIGHWAY 4 AND THE DEFEAT OF THE JAPANESE DEFENDERS OF THE PASS, 14 JUNE 1945.\nTHE BATTLE SPEARHEADED BY THE 121ST INFANTRY, USAFIP, NL, WAS CONCEDED BY AMERICAN MILITARY AUTHORITIES AS “ONE OF THE MOST TERRIBLE AND INCREDIBLY DIFFICULT BATTLE OF THE ENTIRE WAR.” HASTENED THE SURRENDER OF THE JAPANESE IMPERAL FORCES UNDER GENERAL TOMOYUKI YAMASHITA.\nTHIS MONUMENT IS ERECTED IN HONOR OF THE 3,400 MEN KILLED AND WOUNDED WHO FOUGHT GALLANTLY FOR FREEDOM AND PEACE.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/the-battle-of-bessang-pass/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Simbahan ng Bosoboso\" in Boso-Boso, Antipolo, Rizal (Region IV-A), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 2001. Marker text:\nSIMBAHAN NG BOSOBOSO\nUNANG ITINATAG BILANG SIMBAHANG PANGMISYON NG MGA PARING HESWITA NOONG LABING PITONG DANTAON AT ISINAILALIM SA PATRONAHE NG NUESTRA SENORA DE LA ANUNCIATA.\nNALIPAT ANG PANGANGASIWA SA MGA PARING SEKULAR NOONG 1768.\nNAPINSALA NG LINDOL NOONG HULYO 18, 1880.\nNILISAN NOONG 1930 NANG ANG BAYAN AY INILIPAT NOONG UPANG MAGBIGAY DAAN SA ISANG PINANUKALANG PRINSA.\nNAGBALIK ANG TAONG BAYAN SA BOSOBOSO NANG HINDI MAISAKATUPARAN ANG GAWAIN.\nANG SIMBAHAN AY NATUPOK NG APOY NOONG 1943 AT IBINALIK SA DATING KALAGAYAN NOONG 1995 SA PAMAMAGITAN NG MGA MANANAMPALATAYA.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/simbahan-ng-bosoboso/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Sinilangang Pook ni Heneral Antonio Luna 1866–1899*\" in 457 Urbiztondo St., San Nicolas, Binondo, Manila (Region NCR), installed by the National Historical Commission (NHC) in October 29, 1967. Marker text:\nSINILANGANG POOK NI HENERAL ANTONIO LUNA\n(1866-1899)\nSA BAHAY NA ITO, 843 URBIZTONDO, ISINILANG SI ANTONIO LUNA NOONG IKA-29 NG OKTUBRE,1866.\nANAK NINA JOAQUIN LUNA DE SAN PEDRO AT LAUREANA NOVICIO AT KAPATID NI JUAN LUNA, ANG PINTOR, PARMASYUTIKO AT KIMIKO.\nBANTOG NA MANUNULAT NG LA SOLIDARIDAD, ISANG PAHAYAGANG PILIPINO.\nNAPAGHINALAAN NG MGA KASTILANG KASAPI SA KATIPUNAN, KAYA IPINATAPON SA MADRID NOONG 1897.\nSA KANYANG PAGBABALIK SA PILIPINAS NOONG 1898, AY HINIRANG SIYANG KATULONG SA KALIHIM NG DIGMA;\nHINIRANG NA PUNONG KOMANDANTE NG HUKBO NG REPUBLIKA NG PILIPINAS NOONG PEBRERO 1899.\nPINATAY SA KABANATUAN, NUEVA ECIJA, NOONG IKA-5 NG HUNYO, 1899.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/sinilangang-pook-ni-heneral-antonio-luna-1866-1899/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "title": "First Mass in the Philippines*",
  "content": "Historical marker \"First Mass in the Philippines*\" in Limasawa Shrine, Southern Leyte (Region VIII), installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1950. Marker text:\nFIRST MASS IN THE PHILIPPINES\nCELEBRATED HERE ON EASTER SUNDAY, 31 MARCH 1521, WHEN MAGELLAN LANDED ON THIS ISLAND OF LIMASAWA ON HIS VOYAGE AROUND THE WORLD.\nEARLY IN THE MORNING MAGELLAN SENT ASHORE PRIEST PEDRO DE VALDERAMA WITH MEN TO PREPARE A MASS AND TO INFORM RAJAH KOLAMBU, THROUGH AN INTERPRETER THAT HE AND HIS MEN WOULD LAND TO ATTEND.\nTHE RAJAH SHOWED CONSENT BY SENDING GIFTS.\nAS MAGELLAN AND HIS MEN APPROACHED THE SHORE A SALVO OF SIX GUNS WAS FIRED AS A SIGN OF PEACE.\nRAJAHS KOLAMBU AND SI-AGU EACH EMBRACED MAGELLAN FLANKED HIM AND TOGETHER WITH THE SAILORS, THEY MARCHED TO THE PLACE OF WORSHIP.\nDURING THE MASS THE RAJAHS REMAINED ON THEIR KNEES WITH CLASPED HANDS;\nAT THE ELEVATION THE SHIPS FIRED ALL THEIR ARTILLERY IN RESPONSE TO MUSKET SIGNAL FROM THE SHORE.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/first-mass-in-the-philippines/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Simbahan ng Lazi*\" in Lazi, Siquijor (Region VII), installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in May 19, 1984. Marker text:\nSIMBAHAN NG LAZI\nANG PAROKYANG ITO AY ITINATAG NG MGA PARING AGUSTINO REKOLETO SA ILALIM NG PATRONATO NI SAN ISIDRO LABRADOR NOONG 1857.\nANG SIMBAHAN AT KUMBENTO AY IPINATAYO SA PANGANGASIWA NG P.\nTORIBIO SANCHEZ, O.A.R.\nYARI SA MGA BATONG-DAGAT AT MATITIGAS NA KAHOY, ANG SIMBAHAN AY TINAPOS NG MGA PILIPINONG ARTESANO NONG 1884 AT ANG KAMPANARYO PAGKALIPAS NG ISANG TAON.\nANG MALUWANG NA KUMBENTO AY SINIMULAN NOONG 1887 AT BINASBASAN NOONG 1891.\nMAY SUKAT NA 42 SA 38 METRO, ANG KUMBENTONG ITO AY ISA SA PINAKAMALAKI SA PILIPINAS.\nSA BISA NG KAUTUSAN NG PANGULO BILANG 260, 1 AGOSTO 1973, NA SINUSUGAN NG MGA KAUTUSAN BILANG 375, 14 ENERO 1974, AT BILANG 1505, 11 HUNYO 1978, ANG SIMBAHAN AT KUMBENTO AY IPINAHAYAG NA MGA PAMBANSANG PALATANDAANG MAKASAYSAYAN.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/simbahan-ng-lazi/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nBANTAYAN NG PUNTA CRUZ\nIPINATAYO NG MGA PARING RECOLETOS SA PATRONATO NI SAN VICENTE FERRER LABAN SA PAGSALAKAY NG MGA PIRATANG MORO, 1796.\nYARI SA KORALES NA MAY HUGIS TATSULOK AS UNANG PALAPAG AT HEKSAGONAL SA IKALAWANG PALAPAG.\nNALIGTAS SA PAGKASIRA NOONG DIGMAANG FILIPINO–AMERIKANO AT IKALAWANG DIGMAANG PANDAIGDIG NANG SUNUGIN NG MGA PUWERSANG HAPONES ANG BAYAN NG MARIBOJOC, 1944.\nHALIMBAWA NG ARKITEKTURANG MILITAR NOONG PANAHON NG MGA ESPANYOL AT BANTAYOG SA KAHUSAYAN NG MGA LOKAL NA ARTISANO.\nIPINAHAYAG NA PAMBANSANG PALATANDAANG PANGKASAYSAYAN, 2009.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/bantayan-ng-punta-cruz/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Dito Lumusad si Rizal\" in Sunset Boulevard, Dapitan, Zamboanga del Norte, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 1989. Marker text:\nDITO LUMUNSAD SI RIZAL\nSA DALAMPASIGANG ITO NG STA.\nCRUZ, LUMUNSAD SI JOSE RIZAL NOONG IKA-7 NG GABI, IKA-17 NG HULYO, 1892 UPANG SIMULAN ANG BUHAY-TAPON SA DAPITAN.\nKASAMA NI KAPITAN DELGRAS ANG TATLONG KAWAL NG ARTILYERYA AY NAGLAKAD SINA RIZAL SA DAANG PATUNGO SA CASA REAL.\nDITO SIYA IPINAKILALA KAY DON RICARDO CARNICERO, ANG KASTILANG GOBERNADOR MILITAR NG PUROK.\nSITE WHERE RIZAL LANDED\nON THIS BEACH OF STA.\nCRUZ, JOSE RIZAL LANDED AT 7:00 O’CLOCK PM ON JULY 17, 1892 TO BEGIN THE LIFE AN EXILE IN DAPITAN.\nWITH CAPTAIN DELGRAS AND THREE ARTILLERY MEN, THEY WALKED THROUGH STA.\nCRUZ STREET WITH A “FAROL DE COMBATE” TO THE CASA REAL WHERE HE WAS PRESENTED TO DON RICARDO CARNICERO, SPANISH MILITARY GOVERNOR OF THE DISTRICT.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/dito-lumusad-si-rizal/ (checked 2026-11-26).",
