  "content": "Historical marker \"Teodoro M. Kalaw\" in 65-B T.M. Kalaw Street cor. Mabini Street, Lipa, Batangas, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1959. Marker text:\nTEODORO M.\nKALAW\nSCHOLAR, AUTHOR, JOURNALIST, AND HISTORIAN.\nBORN 31 MARCH 1884 IN A HOUSE ON THIS SITE, LIPA, BATANGAS, SON OF VALERIO KALAW AND MARIA MANGUIAT.\nEDITOR, EL RENACIMIENTO, 1907–1909;\nONE OF THE DEFENDANTS IN THE LIBEL SUIT AGAINST EL RENACIMIENTO, 1902–1912;\nMEMBER, PHILIPPINE ASSEMBLY, 1910–1913;\nSECRETARY, PHILIPPINE ASSEMBLY, 1913–1916;\nDIRECTOR, NATIONAL LIBRARY, 1916–1917;\nAND 1929–1939;\nSECRETARY OF THE INTERIOR, 1920–1922;\nEXECUTIVE SECRETARY AND CHIEF ADVISER OF THE COMMISSION ON INDEPENDENCE, 1923–1925;\nFIRST PRESIDENT PHILIPPINE CHAPTER, ACADEMIA HISPANO–AMERICANA DE CADIZ, 1925.\nAUTHOR OF HACIA LA TIERRA DEL CZAR, CINCO REGLAS DE NUESTRA MORAL ANTIGUA, THE PHILIPPINE REVOLUTION, LA CONSTITUCION DE MALOLOS LA MASONERIA FILIPINA, ETC.\nMARRIED TO PURA VILLANUEVA.\nDIED IN MANILA, 4 DECEMBER 1940.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/teodoro-m-kalaw/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nIKA-41 DIBISYON HUKBONG KATIHAN NG PILIPINAS (USAFFE)\n1 SETYEMBRE – 25 DISYEMBRE 1941\nSA POOK NA ITO NAGTIPON ANG IKA-41 DIBISYON, HUKBONG KATIHAN NG PILIPINAS (USAFFE) NA TINAWAG SA PAGLILINGKOD SA PAMAMAHALA NI BRIG.\nHEN.\nVICENTE P.\nLIM, NOONG 28 AGOSTO 1941, SA BISA NG UTOS MILITAR NG PANGULONG FRANKLIN D.\nROOSEVELT NOONG 26 HULYO 1941 AT NG PROKLAMASYONG BILANG 740 NG PANGULONG MANUEL L.\nQUEZON NOONG 10 AGOSTO 1941.\nSINANAY NOONG 1937 AT 1938, ANG MGA SUNDALONG PANLAAN NG DIBISYON ANG BUMUO NG IKA-4 NA POOK MILITAR NG HUKBONG KATIHAN NG PILIPINAS NA MAY PUNONG-HIMPILAN SA LIPA, BATANGAS.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/ika-41-dibisyon-hukbong-katihan-ng-pilipinas-usaffe/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nITINALAGA SA TUNGKULIN NG USAFFE NOONG 1 SETYEMBRE 1941, ANG IKA-41 AT 42 IMPANTERYA REHIMYENTO, SA TULONG NG IBANG PANGKAT NG HUKBONG SANDATAHAN, AY ITINALIBA UPANG IPAGTANGGOL ANG MGA BAYBAYIN MULA LOOC, KABITE HANGGANG LEMERY, BATANGAS NOONG 17 NOBYEMBRE 1941, AT ITINALAGA ANG IKA-43 REHIMYENTO NA RESERBA SA TAGAYTAY.\nDAHIL SA PAGSALAKAY NG HUKBONG HAPONES SA MAUBAN, TAYABAS NOONG 22 DISYEMBRE, NAGING MAPANGANIB ANG KATAYUAN NG MILITAR, AT ANG BUONG PANGKAT AY INATASANG TUMUNGO NOONG IKA-24–25 NG DISYEMBRE 1941 MULA BATANGAS HANGGANG SA BATAAN UPANG ITINDIG ANG HANAY NG DEPENSANG ABUCAY–MORONG SA BATAAN.\nANG PANGKAT AY ISA SA MGA GUMAWA NG HULING PAGTATANGGOL SA MAKASAYSAYANG LABANAN SA BATAAN HANGGANG IKA-9 ABRIL 1942.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/ika-41-dibisyon-hukbong-katihan-ng-pilipinas-usaffe/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nMARCELO ADONAY Y QUINTERIA\n(1848–1928)\nISINILANG SA PAKIL, LAGUNA, NOONG PEBRERO 6, 1848.\nNATUTO NG MUSIKA HABANG KATULONG AT SAKRISTAN SA SIMBAHAN NG SAN AGUSTIN, MAYNILA.\nNAGING MAESTRO DE CAPILLA AT DIREKTOR NG ORKESTRA NG SIMBAHAN, 1870.\nKUMUMPAS NG SOLEMN MASS SA D.\nMAJOR NI BEETHOVEN, 1877;\nSOLEMN MASS NI REPARAZ, 1891;\nAT MISERERE NI ESLAVA, 1893.\nKUMATHA NG GOZOS A NUESTRA SEÑORA DE LA CONSOLACION, O VITA JESU, A SAN PASCUAL BAILON EN OBANDO, A NUESTRA SEÑORA DE ANTIPOLO, A SAN JUAN BAUTISTA, LA PROCESION DE TURUMBA EN PAKIL, TE DEUM, RIZAL GLORIFIED, ANG QUEROT NG REUMA AT TOCATA EN DD MAYOR.\nNAMATAY NOONG PEBRERO 8, 1928.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/marcelo-adonay-y-quinteria-1848-1928/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nDON PLACIDO ESCUDERO DAM\nDON CIRIACO NADRES, DULY AUTHORIZED BY THE SPANISH GOVERNMENT, CONSTRUCTED HERE IN 1872 A DAM OF ADOBE STONE AND LIME MORTAR FOR IRRIGATING HIS LAND ON THIS SIDE OF THE BROOK.\nDON HERMENEGILDO, HIS SON, SOLD THE PROPERTY IN 1890 TO DON PLACIDO ESCUDERO AND HIS WIFE, DOÑA CLAUDIA MARASIGAN, WHO IN 1904 RECONSTRUCTED THIS DAM WITH HARD STONE AND CEMENT MORTAR.\nTHEIR ONLY SON DON ARSENIO AND DOÑA ROSARIO ADAP, HIS WIFE, REBUILT THIS DAM IN 1937 FOR IRRIGATION, AND FOR THE HYDRO-ELECTRIC PLANT, SUPPLYING POWER AND LIGHT TO THE “COOPERATIVE COCONUT PRODUCTS, INC.”, AND TO “VILLA ESCUDERO”.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/don-placido-escudero-dam/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Town of Tanay\" in M.H. del Pilar Street, Plaza Aldea, Tanay, Rizal, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1939. Marker text:\nTOWN OF TANAY\nA SMALL VILLAGE ON MONTE TAN-AY, NOW INALSAN UNDER THE JURISDICTION OF PILILLA FROM 1573.\nTANAY BECAME AN INDEPENDENT PARISH UNDER SAN ILDEFONSO IN 1606.\nIN 1620 IT WAS TRANSFERRED TO SAN ANTONIO (PANTAY).\nWHEN SAN ANTONIO WAS BURNED IN 1639, THE PEOPLE MOVED TO THE PRESENT SITE AND FOUNDED THE TOWN IN 1640.\nTHE FIRST STONE CHURCH IN THIS TOWN WAS FINISHED IN 1680.\nTHE PRESENT CHURCH WAS BUILT IN 1773–1783.\nTWO IRRIGATION DAMS WERE BUILT IN 1790–1808.\nA SCHOOL FOR BOYS AND A SCHOOL FOR GIRLS WERE OPENED IN 1821.\nA STONE BRIDGE, BUILT ACROSS THE TANAY RIVER IN 1854–1856, WAS DESTROYED BY THE TYPHOON AND FLOOD OF SEPTEMBER 27, 1864, BUT REBUILT IN 1877.\nA MUNICIPAL BUILDING WAS ERECTED IN 1888 AND A SCHOOL HOUSE IN 1893.\nTHESE PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS WERE ACHIEVED LARGELY BY VOLUNTARY CONTRIBUTION.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/town-of-tanay/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Heneral Nicolas Gonzales at Lantin\" in People’s Park in the Sky, Tagaytay, Cavite, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in December 5, 1958. Marker text:\nHENERAL NICOLAS GONZALES AT LANTIN\nISINILANG SA TANAUAN, BATANGAS, IKA-5 NG DISYEMBRE 1859.\nANAK NINA EUSEBIO GONZALES AT LEOCADIA LANTIN.\nNAGTAPOS SA KOLEHIYO NG SAN JUAN DE LETRAN AT NAG-ARAL SA PAMANTASAN NG SANTO TOMAS.\nNAHALAL NA GOBERNANDOR NG TANAUAN, 1894–1897;\nNAMUNO BILANG KORONEL SA BATALYON MAKILING SA ILALIM NG PANGANGASIWA NI HENERAL MIGUEL MALVAR.\nNAKASAMA NINA HENERAL JUAN CAILLES AT HENERAL PIO DEL PILAR SA PANGKAT NG MGA MANGHIHIMAGSIK NA NAGWAGI SA LIPA, BATANGAS, AT SA SANTA CRUZ, LAGUNA.\nNATAAS SA TUNGKULING BRIGADYER, 1901;\nNAGING GOBERNADOR NG BATANGAS, IKA-16 NG OKTUBRE 1916 HANGGANG IKA-31 NG OKTUBRE 1919.\nTINAGURIANG BUNDOK NG GONZALES NG MGA AMERIKANO ANG POOK NG BANAWAN BILANG ALAALA SA KANYANG PAGKAHIMPIL DOON.\nNAMATAY SA TANAUAN, BATANGAS, IKA-5 NG HULYO 1923.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/heneral-nicolas-gonzales-at-lantin/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Dolores, Taytay, Rizal, installed by the National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) in February 13, 2017. Marker text:\nLICERIO L.\nGERONIMO (1855–1924)\nBAYANI NG LABANAN NG SAN MATEO.\nIPINANGANAK AGOSTO 27, 1855, SAMPALOC, MAYNILA.\nPUNO, KAPULUNGANG KATIPUNAN NG WAWA, MONTALBAN;\nTAGAPAGTATAG, KATIPUNAN SA SAN MATEO AT MARIKINA.\nNAPAURONG ANG MGA KASTILA NA SUMALAKAY SA PUWERSA NI HENERAL AGUINALDO SA BUNDOK PURAY.\nNAHIRANG NA MEDYOR HENERAL NG DIBISYON NAKATALAGA SA SAN MATEO, 1898;\nKOMANDANTE HENERAL NG IKATLONG SONA MILITAR NG LALAWIGAN NG MAYNILA, 1899.\nBUONG TAPANG NA NAKIPAGLABAN KASAMA ANG KANYANG MGA TIRADORES DE LA MUERTE SA LABANAN NG SAN MATEO KUNG SAAN NAPATAY NIYA SI HENERAL HENRY LAWTON AT IBA PANG OPISYAL NA AMERIKANO.\nSINUNDAN ITO NG MGA PAGSALAKAY SA IBA’T-IBANG HIMPILAN NG MGA AMERIKANO SA BULAKAN, RIZAL AT MGA KARATIG BAYAN NG MAYNILA.\nSUMUKO SA MGA AMERIKANO, 1901.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/licerio-l-geronimo-1855-1924/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Paul P. de la Gironiere\" in Jalajala, Rizal, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 1978. Marker text:\nPAUL P.\nDE LA GIRONIERE\nMANLALAKBAY NA PRANSES NA DUMATING SA MAYNILA NOONG 1820.\nNANIRAHAN SA PILIPINAS SA LOOB NG DALAWAMPUNG TAON AT BINUO ANG ASYENDANG JALA-JALA SA MORONG, NGAYO’Y LALAWIGANG RIZAL.\nPINAUNLAD ANG PAG-AALAGA NG BABOY, PAGTATANIM NG INDIGO, TUBO AT KAPE AT NAKAPAGTANIM NG KAPENG MAY 60,000 PUNO SA IKALAWA NITONG PAG-AANI.\nDAHIL DITO SIYA AY TUMANGGAP NG KARANGALAN BUHAT SA LA REAL SOCIEDAD ECONOMICA DE AMIGOS DEL PAIS DE FILIPINAS NOONG HUNYO 27, 1837.\nSINULAT ANG SALAYSAY NG KANYANG BUHAY AT PAGLALAKBAY SA KAPULUAN NA PINAMAGATANG VINGT ANNEES AUX PHILIPPINES (DALAWAMPUNG TAON SA PILIPINAS).\nNAGBALIK SA PRANSIYA AT BINAWIAN NG BUHAY NOONG 1865.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/paul-p-de-la-gironiere/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nANG SIMBAHAN NG MARAGONDON\nIPINATAYO NG MGA PARING HESWITA SA PATRONATO NG NUESTRA SEÑORA DE LA ASUNCION, 1618.\nNAGING SIMBAHANG PAROKYAL, 1627.\nIPINATAYO AT IPINALAKI ANG BAGONG SIMBAHAN, 1630–1633.\nIPINAGIBA UPANG IWASANG MAGING KUTA NG MGA OLANDES, 1646–1649.\nMULING IPINATAYO NA GAWA SA KAHOY, 1650.\nINAYOS ANG KUMBENTO, 1666–1672.\nGINAWA SA BATO, 1714.\nINILIPAT SA PANGANGASIWA NG MGA PARING SEKULAR, 1768, AT NG MGA REKOLETOS, 1860.\nGINAMIT NA TANGGULAN NG MGA REBOLUSYONARYO NANG GAWING PUNONG HIMPILAN ANG MARAGONDON NG MGA PUWERSA NI HEN.\nEMILIO AGUINALDO, MAYO 1897.\nMULING PINANGASIWAAN NG MGA PARING SEKULAR NOONG IKADALAWAMPUNG DANTAON.\nNATATANGING HALIMBAWA NG DISENYO AT ARKITEKTURANG KOLONYAL.\nIPINAHAYAG NA PAMBANSANG YAMANG PANGKALINANGAN NG PAMBANSANG MUSEO, 31 HULYO 2001.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/ang-simbahan-ng-maragondon/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Galicano C. Apacible (1864–1949)\" in Balayan, Batangas, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 2003. Marker text:\nLABINTATLONG MARTIR NG CAVITE\nMGA KILALANG MAMAMAYAN NG CAVITE NA DINAKIP SA SALANG PAKIKIPAGSABWATAN SA MGA KATIPUNERO KAUGNAY NG NAGANAP NA PAG-AALSA SA CAVITE NOONG AGOSTO 31, 1896.\nBAGAMAN AT WALANG KASALANAN SA KRIMENG IBINIBINTANG SA KANILA SILA AY HINATULAN NG KAMATAYAN SA KOMISYONG MILITAR NA LUMITIS SA KANILA.\nBINARIL NOONG HAPON NG SETYEMBRE 12, 1896 SA KUTANG SAN FELIPE, LUNGSOD NG CAVITE, ANG MGA MARTIR NA ITO AY SINA:\nLUIS AGUADO\nEUGENIO CABEZAS\nFELICIANO CABUCO\nAGAPITO CONCHU\nMAXIMO INOCENCIO\nMAXIMO GREGORIO\nJOSE LALLANO\nSEVERINO LAPIDARIO\nVICTORIANO LUCIANO\nALFONSO DE OCAMPO\nFRANCISCO OSORIO\nHUGO PEREZ\nANTONIO SAN AGUSTIN\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/labintatlong-martir-ng-cavite/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nNICANOR ABELARDO AT STA.\nANA\n(1893–1934)\nISINILANG SI NICANOR ABELARDO SA POOK NA ITO NG SAN MIGUEL, BULAKAN, NOONG IKA-7 NG PEBRERO, 1893, ANAK NA PANGANAY NINA VALENTIN ABELARDO AT PLACIDA STA.\nANA.\nNAGTAPOS NG MUSIKA SA UNIBERSIDAD NG PILIPINAS NOONG 1921 AT SA CHICAGO MUSICAL COLLEGE NOONG 1932.\nSA BISA NG KANYANG MATITIMYAS NA KUNDIMAN AT MGA HIMIG NA NAGLALARAWAN NG KATUTUBONG TANAWIN, SI ABELARDO AY TINAGURIANG “MAKATA NG TUGTUGIN” AT KINIKILALANG PINAKADAKILANG MANGANGATHA NG TUGTUGIN SA PILIPINAS.\nSA KANYANG MGA TUGTUGIN AY LALONG NATAMPOK ANG “NASAAN KA IROG” AT “MUTYA NG PASIG.”\nYUMAO NOONG IKA-21 NG MARSO, 1934, SA MAYNILA.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/nicanor-abelardo-at-sta-ana-1893-1934/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "title": "Claro Caluya",
  "content": "Historical marker \"Claro Caluya\" in Don Claro Caluya Green Garden, Estella Street, Piddig, Ilocos Norte, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1958. Marker text:\nCLARO CALUYA\nFOREMOST VERNACULAR POET AND DRAMATIST IN ILOCOS NORTE.\nBORN 22 JUNE 1868.\nSON OF RAFAEL CALUYA AND NORBERTA PASION.\nSTUDIED N HIS HOMETOWN;\nLATER WENT TO A HIGHER SCHOOL IN LAOAG 1882;\nBECAME CABEZA DE BARANGAY, 1890 AND CAPITAN MUNICIPAL, 1893–1896;\nJOINED THE REVOLUTIONARY FORCES, 1896–1897;\nDISTINGUISHED HIMSELF IN THE FILIPINO–AMERICAN WAR;\nSERVED AS MUNICIPAL PRESIDENT OF HIS TOWN, 1903–1905.\nUNDER HIS ADMINISTRATION, THE FIRST PUBLIC MARKET WAS BUILT AND SEVERAL PRIMARY SCHOOLS WERE OPENED.\nFOUNDED CIVIC AND CULTURAL ORGANIZATIONS.\nWROTE MANY PLAYS AND POEMS IN ILOCANO, INCLUDING A TRANSLATION OF RIZAL’S ULTIMO ADIOS, WHICH IS CONSIDERED AS THE MOST LYRICAL ILOCANO VERSION OF THE POEM.\nMARRIED TO SABINA AQUINO.\nDIED 14 DECEMBER 1914.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/claro-caluya/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Don Mariano Marcos y Rubio (1897–1945)\" in Mariano Marcos State University, Marcos Avenue, Batac, Ilocos Norte, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in October 24, 1983. Marker text:\nDON MARIANO MARCOS Y RUBIO\n(1897–1945)\nBORN IN BATAC, ILOCOS NORTE, 21 APRIL 1897, TO DON FABIAN MARCOS AND DOÑA CRESENCIA RUBIO.\nHIS FATHER WAS THE JUSTICE OF THE PEACE, SCHOOL TEACHER AND GOBERNADORCILLO OF BATAC AFTER THE REVOLUTION.\nMARRIED TO JOSEFA QUETULIO EDRALIN, 1916;\nCHILDREN: FERDINAND, PACIFICO, ELIZABETH AND FORTUNA.\nPRIMARY SCHOOLING IN THE NEW ELEMENTARY SCHOOLS ESTABLISHED BY THE AMERICANS, ILOCOS NORTE.\nSECONDARY EDUCATION, MANILA.\nTEACHER’S COURSE, PHILIPPINE NORMAL SCHOOL, 1916.\nPRINCIPAL TEACHER, 1917;\nLIEUTENANT, PHILIPPINE NATIONAL GUARD, 1918;\nLAOAG SCHOOL DISTRICT SUPERVISOR, 1919;\nAND TEACHER, NATIONAL UNIVERSITY, MANILA, 1921.\nGRADUATED VALEDICTORIAN IN LAW, UNIVERSITY OF THE PHILIPPINES, 1925.\nREPRESENTATIVE TO THE PHILIPPINE ASSEMBLY, SECOND DISTRICT, ILOCOS NORTE, 1925;\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/don-mariano-marcos-y-rubio-1897-1945/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nAGUEDA KAHABAGAN\nREBOLUSYONARYO AT HENERAL NG HUKBO NG REPUBLIKA NG PILIPINAS.\nISINILANG SA SANTA CRUZ, LAGUNA.\nISA SA MGA BABAENG LUMAHOK SA REBOLUSYON SA LAGUNA AT SA DIGMAAN LABAN SA MGA AMERIKANO.\nPINAMUNUAN ANG ISANG PULUTONG NG KAWAL NI BRIGADYER HENERAL SEVERINO TAIÑO, MAYO 1897.\nBINANSAGANG “HENERALA” DAHIL SA KANYANG GALING AT KASANAYAN SA PAMUMUNO SA ILANG MGA LABANAN SA LAGUNA, ISA NA RITO ANG SA SAN PABLO, OKTUBRE 1897.\nIMINUNGKAHI NI HENERAL PIO DEL PILAR KAY HENERAL EMILIO AGUINALDO NA KILALANIN BILANG HENERAL, 6 ABRIL 1899.\nINIHALAL SA KATUNGKULAN AT NAGING KAISA-ISANG BABAENG HENERAL SA TALAAN NG HUKBONG PILIPINO, 1899.\nDINAKIP NG PWERSANG AMERIKANO, ENERO 1902.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/agueda-kahabagan/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "title": "Municipality of Lemery",
  "content": "Historical marker \"Municipality of Lemery\" in Lemery, Batangas, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1952. Marker text:\nMUNICIPALITY OF LEMERY\nTHE TOWN OF LEMERY WAS FOUNDED IN 1862 DURING THE ADMINISTRATION OF GOVERNOR GENERAL JOSE LEMERY.\nJOSE CABRERA WAS ITS FIRST GOBERNADORCILLO.\nOTHERS WERE MIGUEL AGONCILLO, ELENO ANIVERSARIO, BASILIO GATACHALIAN, MARIANO GENEROSO, PERPETUO ILUSTRE, MARIANO MARELLA, JUAN MEDINA, BRIGIDO MORALES, RAMON M.\nMITRA, RAMON NOBLE, VICTORIANO NOBLE, AGAPITO PANGANIBAN, AND PIOQUINTO REYES.\nLEMERY WAS ANNEXED TO THE MUNICIPALITY OF TAAL IN 1904.\nAGAIN BECAME A MUNICIPALITY IN 1907 WITH PERPETUO DE JOYA AS MUNICIPAL PRESIDENT.\nTHE ERUPTION OF NEARBY TAAL VOLCANO IN JANUARY 1911 KILLED HUNDREDS OF ITS INHABITANTS.\nOCCUPIED BY THE JAPANESE IMPERIAL ARMY IN 1942.\nONE THIRD OF THE TOWN WAS BURNT BY ENEMY ARTILLERY WHEN IT WAS LIBERATED BY THE AMERICANS AIDED BY FILIPINO GUERILLAS ON 6 MARCH 1945.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/municipality-of-lemery/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nBAHAY NA TINIGILAN NI ANDRES BONIFACIO\nSA BAHAY NA ITO PANSAMANTALANG TUMIGIL SINA ANDRES BONIFACIO, TAGAPAGTATAG NG KATIPUNAN AT MGA KAPATID NA SINA CIRIACO AT PROCOPIO NANG PUMUNTA SA CAVITE SA PAANYAYA NG KONSEHONG PANLALAWIGAN NG MAGDIWANG, DISYEMBRE 1896 – ABRIL 1897.\nNAGING PAG-AARI NI ESTEFANIA POTENTE, PAGKARAA’Y NABILI NI EMILIO P.\nVIRATA, KINATAWAN NG CAVITE, 1919–1922.\nHANGGANG SA MABILI NG MAG-ASAWANG DR.\nJOSE AT MARTHA RODRIGUEZ, 1975, AT TINIRAHAN.\nKABILANG SA MGA NAGING PANAUHIN DITO SINA PANGULONG EMILIO AGUINALDO, MANUEL LUIS QUEZON, SERGIO OSMEÑA, MANUEL ROXAS AT ELPIDIO QUIRINO.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/bahay-na-tinigilan-ni-andres-bonifacio/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

San Gabriel Street, Vibora, General Trias, Cavite, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in July 13, 1974. Marker text:\nARTEMIO RICARTE\n(VIBORA) 1866–1945\nSA POOK NA ITO NANIRAHAN MULA NOONG 1890–1900.\nIPINANGANAK SA BATAK, HILAGANG ILOKOS, NOONG IKA-20 NG OKTUBRE, 1866.\nNAG-ARAL SA SAN JUAN DE LETRAN AT NAGTAPOS SA ESCUELA NORMAL NOONG 1890.\nNAGING HENERAL NG BRIGADA SA SANGGUNIANG MAGDIWANG AT NAHALAL NA KAPITAN HENERAL SA KUMBENSIYON SA TEHEROS, KABITE.\nNADAKIP NG MGA AMERIKANO NOONG 1900 AT IPINATAPON SA GUAM NOONG 1901.\nHINDI KUMILALA SA KAPANGYARIHANG AMERIKANO AT NANIRAHAN SA HAPON HANGGANG SA PAGSIKLAB NG DIGMAAN SA PASIPIKO NOONG 1941.\nNAMATAY SA PUNDUNG, IPUGAW, NOONG HULYO 31, 1945.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/artemio-ricarte-vibora-1866-1945/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "title": "Diego Mojica",
  "content": "Historical marker \"Diego Mojica\" in Real Street, General Trias, Cavite, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in March 17, 1990. Marker text:\nDIEGO MOJICA\nMAKATA AT LIDER MANGHIHIMAGSIK NA KILALA SA SAGISAG NA KATIBAYAN.\nIPINANGANAK SA BAYANG ITO NG SAN FRANCISCO DE MALABON (NGAYO’Y HENERAL TRIAS).\nKASAL SIYA KAY IGMEDIA GREPO, ISA NIYANG KABABAYAN.\nPANGULO, SANGGUNIANG BALANGAY NG BAYANG MAPAGTIIS;\nMINISTRO NG PANANALAPI, KAPULUNGANG MAGDIWANG AT PRESIDENTE MUNICIPAL, 1900–1901.\nKAUNA-UNAHANG NAGSALIN SA TAGALOG NG MI ULTIMO ADIOS NI DR.\nJOSE RIZAL NA INILIMBAG SA BAYANG ITO NOONG PANAHON NG HIMAGSIKAN.\nMAY-AKDA NG MGA TULA: “ANG KAPITAN SA BAYAN”, “SINO ANG ILAW NG BAYAN”, “ISANG PANGARAP”, “IROG KONG MAHAL”, “IKAW MUNDO AY MARAYA”, “PASIONG BAGONG KATHA”, AT MARAMI PANG IBA.\nANG MAHALAGANG SANDALI NG KANYANG BUHAY AY GINUGOL NIYA SA BAHAY NA DATING NAKATAYO SA POOK NA ITO.\nBILANG PAGKILALA SA KANYANG PAGKAMAKABAYAN ANG NAYON NG BUENAVISTA SA BAYAN DING ITO AY PINANGANLANG “KATIBAYAN”.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/diego-mojica/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Diosdado P. Macapagal\" in President Diosdado P. Macapagal Library and Museum, Lubao, Pampanga, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 1990. Marker text:\nDIOSDADO P.\nMACAPAGAL\n5TH PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES, A NATIVE SON OF LUBAO, PAMPANGA, WITH DELIBERATE PATIENCE, LIBERATED HIMSELF FROM AND TRANSCENDED ALL THE SHACKLING OBSTACLES ADHERENT TO THE POVERTY OF HIS BIRTH ON SEPTEMBER 28, 1910.\nWORKING HIS WAY THROUGH SCHOOL, PARTLY WITH THE SUPPORT OF PHILANTROPHIST HONORIO VENTURA, HE EARNED THE DEGREES OF BACHELOR OF LAWS, MASTER OF LAWS, DOCTOR OF LAWS AND DOCTOR OF ECONOMICS FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF SANTO TOMAS.\nHE TOPPED THE BAR EXAMINATION IN 1936.\nIN 1949, HE WAS ELECTED CONGRESSMAN FOR THE FIRST DISTRICT OF PAMPANGA, AFTER TWO TERMS IN CONGRESS, HE WAS ELECTED VICE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES IN 1957 AND WAS CHOSEN AS PRESIDENT OF THE LIBERAL PARTY.\nIN 1961, HE WAS ELECTED PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/diosdado-p-macapagal/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Diosdado P. Macapagal\" in President Diosdado P. Macapagal Library and Museum, Lubao, Pampanga, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 1990. Marker text:\nAS PRESIDENT, HE HAD TWO OBJECTIVES: TO FIGHT MASS POVERTY AND TO STRENGTHEN AND MATURIZE DEMOCRACY IN THE PHILIPPINES.\nON AUGUST 8, 1963, HE ENACTED THE AGRICULTURAL LAND REFORM CODE, WHICH ABOLISHED THE CENTURIES-OLD TENANCY IN THE PHILIPPINES.\nAFTER HIS RETIREMENT FROM POLITICS IN 1965, HE WAS ELECTED DELEGATE TO THE 1971 CONSTITUTIONAL CONVENTION WHICH ELECTED HIM AS ITS PRESIDENT.\nDIOSDADO MACAPAGAL’S SERVICE TO HIS PEOPLE AND COUNTRY IS CHARACTERIZED BY HIS PERSONAL VIRTUES OF HONESTY, COMMITMENT AND INTEGRITY AND BY A DEEP LOVE AND FEAR OF GOD.\nALL THESE MANIFESTATIONS OF HIS IDEALISM ARE SHARED BY HIS WIFE, EVANGELINA MACARAEG-MACAPAGAL, AND HIS CHILDREN CIELO MACAPAGAL-SALGADO, ARTURO MACAPAGAL, GLORIA MACAPAGAL-ARROYO AND DIOSDADO MACAPAGAL, JR.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/diosdado-p-macapagal/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nMILITARY HOSPITAL OF MANILA\nSTERNBERG HOSPITAL\nTHE MILITARY HOSPITAL OF MANILA WAS FORMERLY LOCATED NEAR SANTA CLARA CONVENT, WHERE IT WAS DESTROYED BY THE EARTHQUAKE OF JUNE 3,1863.\nA NEW HOSPITAL WAS BUILT IN THIS SECTION OF ARROCEROS AND ENTRUSTED TO THE CARE OF THE SISTERS OF CHARITY IN 1867.\nTHE HOSPITAL AGAIN WAS DESTROYED BY THE TYPHOON OF 1869.\nA NEW ONE BUILT IN 1879 WAS GREATLY DAMAGED BY THE EARTHQUAKES OF 1880.\nSINCE THE AMERICAN ADMINISTRATION THE HOSPITAL HAS BEEN USED FOR THE PHILIPPINE DEPARTMENT OF THE UNITED STATES ARMY.\nIT WAS NAMED INHONOR OF MAJOR GENERAL GEORGE M.\nSTERNBERG, MEDICAL CORPS, U.S.A.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/military-hospital-of-manila-sternberg-hospital/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nPOOK NG BILANGGUANG KAMPO SA LOS BAÑOS\nGINAMIT NG MGA HAPONES BILANG BILANGGUANG KAMPO PARA SA MGA BIHAG NA AMERIKANO AT IBANG BANYAGA NOONG 1943.\nNILUSOB NG PINAGSANIB NA PANGKAT NG MGA GERILYANG FILIPINO MULA SA MGA KASAPI NG ROTC HUNTERS, HUKBALAHAP IKA-48 ISKWADRONG TSINO, SARILING PANGKAT NI PANGULONG QUEZON, PANGKAT MARKING, AT IBA PANG DI-REGULAR NA TROPA NOONG 23 PEBRERO 1945.\nANG PINAGSANIB NA PUWERSA AY INORGANISA NI TINYENTE KORONEL GUSTAVO INGLES NA KASAPI NG HUNTERS AT KINATAWAN NG PUWERSANG AMERIKANONG NANGANGASIWA SA MGA GERILYA NG KATIMUGANG LUZON.\nPINAMUNUAN NI TINYENTE KORONEL HONORIO GUERRERO AT NG ROTC HUNTERS ANG UNANG SALAKAY.\nMATAGUMPAY NILANG NAKONTROL ANG PALIGI NG KAMPO AT SA TULONG NG MGA AMERIKANONG MIYEMBRO NG COMPANY B 511TH PARATROOP INFANTRY AY NAPALAYA ANG 2,147 BILANGGO.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/pook-ng-bilangguang-kampo-sa-los-banos/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nHENERAL VICENTE LIM\n(1888–1944)\nIPINANGANAK SA CALAMBA, LAGUNA NOONG PEBRERO 24, 1888 KINA JOSE LIM AT ANTONIA PODICO.\nKAWAL, MAKABAYAN, ISA SA MGA NAGTATAG NG BOY SCOUTS OF THE PHILIPPINES AT UNANG PILIPINONG NAG-ARAL SA UNITED STATES MILITARY ACADEMY SA WEST POINT, NEW YORK.\nIKINASAL KAY PILAR HIDALGO, KILALANG EDUKADOR AT MAPAGKAWANGGAWA.\nNAMUMUNONG HENERAL, IKA-41 DIBISYON NG IMPANTERIYA NOONG 1941;\nNAKALIGTAS SA DEATH MARCH;\nNAGTATAG NG PANGKAT NG GERILYA NOONG IKALAWANG DIGMAANG PANDAIGDIG;\nNABIHAG NG PATRULYANG HAPONES SA BAYBAYIN NG MINDORO;\nIBINILANGGO SA KUTANG SANTIAGO AT PAGKARAAN AY BINARIL SA SEMENTERYO NG INTSIK NOONG 1944.\nPAGKARAANG MAMATAY, PINAGKALOOBAN NG MGA MEDALYANG DISTINGUISHED CONDUCT STAR, DISTINGUISHED SERVICE STAR AT DISTINGUISHED LONG SERVICE STAR AT GINAWARAN NG RANGGONG HENERAL NA MAY TATLONG BITUIN.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/heneral-vicente-lim-1888-1944/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Ferdinand Magellan’s Death\" in Liberty Shrine, Punta Engaño Road, Mactan, Lapu-Lapu City, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1941. Marker text:\nFERDINAND MAGELLAN’S DEATH\nON THIS SPOT FERDINAND MAGELLAN DIED ON APRIL 27, 1521, WOUNDED IN AN ENCOUNTER WITH THE SOLDIERS OF LAPULAPU, CHIEF OF MACTAN ISLAND.\nONE OF MAGELLAN’S SHIPS, THE VICTORIA, UNDER THE COMMAND OF JUAN SEBASTIAN ELCANO, SAILED FROM CEBU ON MAY 1, 1521, AND ANCHORED AT SAN LUCAR DE BARRAMEDA ON SEPTEMBER 6, 1522, THUS COMPLETING THE FIRST CIRCUMNAVIGATION OF THE EARTH.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/ferdinand-magellans-death/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"The Provincial Government Building of Bataan\" in Balanga, Bataan, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1939. Marker text:\nTHE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT BUILDING OF BATAAN\nTHIS BUIDING, FORMERLY KNOWN AS THE CASA REAL, WAS BUILT IN THE YEARS 1792-1794 ACCORDING TO THE PLANS OF DOMINGO DE LA CRUZ GONZALES, AN ARCHITECT.\nWHEN CHARLES IV WAS KING OF SPAIN, RAFAEL MARIA DE AGUILAR WAS GOVERNOR GENERAL OF THE PHILIPPINES, AND DOMINGO DE GOYENECHEA WA ALCALDE MAYOR OF BATAAN PROVINCE.\nEARTHQUAKE DAMAGED THE CASA REAL IN 1852 AND 1854, AND REPAIRS WERE MADE IN 1854, 1869, 1880 AND 1885.\nTHIS BUILDING WAS THE HEADQUARTERS OF THE BATAAN REVOLUTIONARY GROVERNMENT FROM MAY 31, 1898 TO JANUARY 1900.\nFROM 1903 TO 1906 IT HOUSED THE PROVINCIAL HIGH SCHOOL.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/the-provincial-government-building-of-bataan/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"The Battle and Liberation of Suyo\" in Suyo, Ilocos Sur, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1959. Marker text:\nTHE BATTLE AND LIBERATION OF SUYO\nTHE BATTLE BEGAN ON THE MORNING OF 1 FEBRUARY 1945 WHEN SUYO, ILOCOS SUR, WAS SUBJECTED TO MORTAR BOMBARDMENT FOLLOWED BY CONCERTED ASSAULTS BY THE 3RD BATTALION, 121ST INFANTRY, USAFIP, NL, ON ENEMY STRONGPOINTS GUARDING THE APPROACHES TO THE TOWN;\nMT.\nTAPAO IN THE NORTHWEST, KIMPOSA ALONG HIGHWAY 4 IN THE WEST, AND OSO AND URZADAN IN THE EAST.\nSUYO, THEN VITAL TO THE JAPANESE WAR ECONOMY BEING THE DEPOSITORY OF COPPER CONCENTRATES MINED IN LEPANTO, MT.\nPROVINCE, WAS FINALLY LIBERATED ON 5 FEBRUARY AND BECAME THE SITE OF THE HEADQUARTERS OF THE 121ST INFANTRY FROM LATE MARCH TO 14 JUNE DURING THE BATTLE OF BESANG PASS.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/the-battle-and-liberation-of-suyo/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nSIGNING OF THE JAPANESE CAPITULATION DOCUMENT\nHERE WAS SIGNED THE CAPITULATION DOCUMENT FOR THE SURRENDER OF THE JAPANESE IMPERIAL FORCES IN THE PHILIPPINES ON SEPTEMBER 3, 1945 AT 12:07 P.M.\nGEN.\nTOMUYUKI YAMASHITA, LT.\nCOL.\nMOTO, VICE-ADMIRAL OKOCHI AND REAR-ADMIRAL ARIMA SIGNED FOR JAPAN.\nMAJOR GEN.\nE.H.\nLEAHEY, PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVE OF GEN.\nDOUGLAS MACARTHUR WHO WAS IN TOKYO SIGNED FOR THE UNITED STATES.\nOTHERS PRESENT WERE: LTS.\nGEN.\nSIR ARTHUR PERCIVAL AND JONATHAN WAINWRIGHT, MAJS.\nGEN.\nDENNIS P.\nSWIFT, WOOD DECHER, ROBERTS BEIGHTLER, WILLIAM H.\nGILL, F.A.\nIRVING, COL.\nRUSSEL R.\nVOLCKMANN, ETC.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/signing-of-the-japanese-capitulation-document/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "title": "Church of San Agustin",
  "content": "Historical marker \"Church of San Agustin\" in Intramuros, Manila, installed by the Historical Research and Markers Committee in 1934. Marker text:\nCHURCH OF SAN AGUSTIN\nOLDEST IN THE PHILIPPINES.\nCORNERSTONE LAID IN 1599, CHURCH COMPLETED IN 1606 UNDER SUPERVISION OF THE LAY BROTHER ANTONIO HER RERA, OF THE CHURCH IN MANILA, THIS ONE ALONE WITHSTOOD THE EARTHQUAKE OF 1645, 1754, 1852 AND 1880.\nTHE CHOIR HAS 68 CARVED MOLAVE SEATS.\nAN ARTISTIC LECTERN AND PARCHMENT CANTORALS OF THE 16TH AND 17TH CENTURIES.\nTHIS CHURCH AND ITS GRAVES WERE PROFANED DURING THE BRITISH OCCUPATION OF MANILA IN 1762, AND THE ASHES OF LEGASPI, SALCEDO, LAVEZARES AND OTHERS NOW REST IN THE EASTERN MOST CHAPEL OF THE TRANSEPT.\nTERMS FOR THE AMERICAN OCCUPATION OF MANILA WERE SIGNED IN THE VESTRY OF THIS CHURCH IN AUGUST, 1898.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/church-of-san-agustin/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Smith, Bell & Co., Inc.\" in Manila Polo Club, Makati City, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in March 19, 1996. Marker text:\nSMITH, BELL & CO., INC.\nFOUNDED AS A TRADING FIRM NAMED CONSTABLE, WOOD & COMPANY BY HENRY CONSTABLE AND ROBERT WOOD IN 1846.\nA SUBSIDIARY FIRM OF SMITH, CONSTABLE AND COMPANY OF LIVERPOOL, ENGLAND.\nBECAME SMITH, BELL & COMPANY WITH THE ENTRANCE INTO THE FIRM OF JOHN KNOX SMITH AND LAWRENCE R.\nBELL IN 1853.\nWITH THE RAPID GROWTH OF ITS BUSINESS, IT PRACTICALLY ENGAGED IN EVERY BUSINESS ENDEAVOR AND BRANCHES WERE ESTABLISHED IN SAN FRANCISCO AND SINGAPORE IN 1859 AND IN OTHER PARTS OF THE WORLD.\nLATER, COLLABORATED WITH FILIPINO CAPITALISTS SPECIALLY IN THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE FIRST MECHANICAL RICE MILLS AND FIRST SUGAR REFINERY IN THE ISLANDS.\nSUPPORTED THE CAUSE OF THE PHILIPPINE REVOLUTIONARY BY SENDING FOOD PROVISIONS AND RIVER VESSELS TO FILIPINO REBELS.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/smith-bell-co-inc/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Ospital ng San Juan de Dios\" in Roxas Boulevard, Pasay City, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 15 August 1979. Marker text:\nOSPITAL NG SAN JUAN DE DIOS\nITINATAG NU FRAY JUAN CLEMENTE NOONG 1578 SA INTRAMUROS, MANILA, SA ILALIM NG PAMAMAHALA NG MGA PRAYLE NG SAN FRANCISCO, PARA SA KAPAKANAN NG MGA MAHIHIRAP NA PILIPINO.\nPINAMAHALAAN NG SANTA HERMANDAD DE LA MISERICORDIA NOONG 1596-1656, AT NG MGA RELIHIYOSO NG SAN JUAN DE DIOS NOONG 1656-1865.\nIPINAGKATIWALA SA MGA HIJAS DE LA CARIDAD (DAUGHTER SOF CHARITY) NG SAN VICENTE DE PAUL NOONG 1868 HANGGANG KASALUKUYAN.\nANG OSPITAL AY NASUNOG NOONG 1583 AT 1603, AT NASIRA NG LINDOL NOONG 1645, 1863 AT 1880 NGUNIT MULING ITINAYO SA PAGPUPUNYAGI NG SIMBAHAN AT PAMAHALAAN, NANG NAGIBA NOONG 1945 DAHIL SA PANGALAWANG DIGMAANG PANDAIGDIG, AY INILIPAT SA LUNGSOD NG PASAY AT PINASINAYAAN AT BINUKSAN MULI NA MAGSILBI SA PUBLIKO NOONG 1952.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/ospital-ng-san-juan-de-dios/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Cannon at the South Side, National Library – Legislative Building\" in Ermita, Manila in Unknown. Marker text:\nCANNON AT THE SOUTH SIDE,\nNATIONAL LIBRARY – LEGISLATIVE BUILDING\nTHIS CANNON CAST AT TRUBIA, SPAIN, IN 1859 WAS PART OF THE ARMAMENT OF THE SPANISH ARSENAL AT CAVITE IN 1898.\nAFTER DEWEY’S FORCES OCCUPIED THE ARSENAL, MAJOR LADISLAO JOSE OF THE PHILIPPINE REVOLUTIONARY FORCES PROCURED AND USED IT AT MAYTUBIG TO BOM-BARD THE SPANIARDS’ MUNITION DEPOT AT FORT SAN ANTONIO ABAD DEFENDED BY A GARRISON UNDER THE COMMAND OF GENERAL ARIZMENDI.AFTER THE CAPTURE OF MANILA, GENERAL MARIANO NORIEL OF THE PHILIPPINE REVOLUTIONARY FORCES USED IT AT THE BATTLE OF ZA-POTE WHERE IT WAS CAPTURED AND BROKEN BY THE AMERICANS.\nIN 1936, IT WAS BROUGHT TO THE NATIONAL LIBRARY FOR PRESERVATION.\nIN 1938, THE PHILIPPINES HISTORICAL COMMITTEE MOUNTED IT HERE.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/cannon-at-the-south-side-national-library-legislative-building/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nMARINQUDUE REVOLUTIONARY FORCE\nAFTER THE OUTBREAK OF THE HOSTILITIES BETWEEN THE FILIPINOS AND AMERICANS ON FEBRUARY 4, 1899, THE MARINDUQUE REVOLUTIONARY FORCE, COMPOSED OF INFANTRY AND MILITIA BATTALIONS, WAS ORGANIZED BY GOV.\nMARTIN LARDIZABAL PURSUANT TO THE ORDER OF GEN.\nMARIANO TRIAS OF THE SOUTHERN COMMAND ON MAY 6 1900, THE INFANTRY BATALLION WAS CONVERTED INTO FOUR GUERILLA UNITS.\nWHEN GOV.\nLARDIZABAL BECAME ILL, HE APPOINTED CAPT.\nMAXIMO ABAD AS CHIEF OF THE MARINDUQUE REVOLUTIONARY FORCE.\nTHEY DEFEATED THE AMERICAN FORCES IN THE BATTLE OF PAYE IN BOAC ON JULY 31, 1900 AND IN THE BATTLE OF PULANG LUPA IN TORRIJOS ON SEPTEMBER 13, 1900.\nON MARCH 1901, GOV.\nLARDIZABAL, CAPT.\nPEDRO MADRIGAL AND LT.\nGUMERSINDO DELA SANTA WERE CAPTURED AND TAKEN TO MANILA WHERE THEY WERE INCARCERATED AT FORT SANTIAGO.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/marinduque-revolutionary-force/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Town of Cagsaua\" in Barangay Busay, Daraga, Albay, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1940. Marker text:\nTOWN OF CAGSAUA\nTHIS SITE WAS FORMERLY OCCUPIED BY THE TOWN OF CAGSAUA WHICH WAS DESTROYED BY THE ERUPTION OF MAYON VOLCANO FEBRUARY 1, 1814.\nTOWN WAS BURIED UNDER ROCKS, LAVA AND VOLCANIC ASH.\nABOUT 1,200 PERSONS PERISHED.\nON JULY 16, 1814.\nTHE AUTHORITIES OF CAGSAUA ASSEMBLED AT LIGAO AND DECIDED TO TRANSFER THE TOWN TO DARAGA.\nTHE FIRST CENTENARY OF THIS ERUPTION WAS SOLEMNLY COMMEMORATED BY THE INHABITANTS OF THE BICOL REGION, FEBRUARY 1, 1914 WITH A PILGRIMAGE TO CAGSAUA.\nA HIGH MASS WAS CELEBRATED OVER THE RUINS OF THE CHURCH IN MEMORY OF THOSE WHO LOST THEIR LIVES.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/town-of-cagsaua/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nSITE OF THE FORMER CHURCH OF SAN JUAN DE DIOS\nON TAKING POSSESSION OF THE HOSPITAL DE LA MISERICORDIA ON MARCH 31, 1656, THE HOSPITALARIOS DE SAN JUAN DE DIOS, A RELIGIOUS, CHARITABLE SOCIETY, BUILT A SMALL CHURCH HERE WITH ADJOINING LODGINGS.\nTHIS CHURCH WAS DAMAGED BY THE EARTHQUAKE OF JULY 19, 1664.\nTHE SECOND AND LARGER CHURCH WAS WRECKED BY AN EARTHQUAKE IN 1674.\nTHE NEXT CHURCH AND ITS CONVENT WEAKENED BY REPEATED SEISMIC SHOCKS HAD TO BE DEMOLISHED IN 1727.\nA NEW CHURCH SOLEMNLY BLESSED MAY 10, 1732, WAS LEVELLED TO THE GROUND BY THE EARTHQUAKE OF JUNE 3, 1863.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/site-of-the-former-church-of-san-juan-de-dios/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Birthplace of Mabini\" in Talaga, Tanauan, Batangas, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1939. Marker text:\nBIRTHPLACE OF APOLINARIO MABINI\nAT THIS PLACE, BARRIO TALAGA, TANAUAN, BATANGAS, APOLINARIO MABINI, AUTHOR OF VARIOUS IMPORTANT DECREES AND POLITICAL DOCUMENTS, PRIME MINISTER OF THE PHILIPPINE REPUBLIC, AND PATRIOT, WAS BORN JULY 23, 1864.\nHIS PARENTS WERE INOCENCIO MABINI AND DIONISIA MARANAN.\nHAVING ATTENDED THE SCHOOL OF REV.\nVALERIO MALABANAN IN TANAUAN AND COLEGIO DE SAN JUAN DE LETRAN IN MANILA, MABINI WAS GRADUATED IN LAW FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF SANTO TOMAS IN 1894, IN THE CRITICAL PERIOD OF HIS COUNTRY’S HISTORY WHEN HIS SERVICES WERE NEEDED MOST.\nHE WAS STRUCK BY PARALYSIS IN JANUARY 1896.\nIN THE FOLLOWING OCTOBER HE WAS MADE PRISONER BY THE SPANIARDS, AND AGAIN BY THE AMERICANS WHO DEPORTED HIM TO GUAM ON JANUARY 15, 1901.\nMABINI RETURNED TO THE PHILIPPINES ON FEBRUARY 26, 1903, AND DIED IN MANILA ON MAY 13, 1903.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/birthplace-of-mabini/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "title": "Ateneo De Manila",
  "content": "Historical marker \"Ateneo De Manila\" in Intramuros, Manila, installed by the Historical Research and Markers Committee in 30 November 1935. Marker text:\nBIRTHPLACE OF JUAN LUNA Y NOVICIO\nPATRIOT AND FOREMOST FILIPINO PAINTER.\nBORN IN BADOC, ILOCOS NORTE, 24 OCTOBER 1857;\nSON OF JOAQUIN LUNA DE SAN PEDRO AND LAUREANA NOVICIO.\nSTUDIED IN THE ATENEO MUNICIPAL, ESCUELA DE BELLAS ARTES AND ESCUELA NAUTICA IN MANILA;\nBECAME A LICENSED PILOT AT 17.\nPUPIL OF LORENZO GUERRERO, NOTED FILIPINO PAINTER.\nWENT TO SPAIN, 1877, STUDIED IN THE ACADEMIA DE BELLAS ARTES DE SAN FERNANDO, MADRID.\nPAINTED IN ROME HIS FIRST FAMOUS WORK, “THE DEATH OF CLEOPATRA”.\nWON GOLD MEDAL FOR HIS SPOLIARIUM AT THE INTERNATIONAL PAINTING EXPOSITION, 1884, IN MADRID.\nWON OTHER MEDALS AND HONORS IN EUROPE.\nAMONG HIS OTHER NOTABLE PAINTINGS WERE “THE BATTLE OF LEPANTO”, “THE BLOOD COMPACT”, “PEOPLE AND KINGS”.\nCO-WORKER OF RIZAL, LOPEZ–JAENA, DEL PILAR AND OTHER FILIPINO REFORMERS IN EUROPE;\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/birthplace-of-juan-luna-y-novicio/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Philippine Columbian Association\" in Philippine Columbian Association, Plaza Dilao Road, Paco, Manila, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1960. Marker text:\nPHILIPPINE COLUMBIAN ASSOCIATION\nORGANIZED IN 1907 BY FILIPINOS WHO HAD STUDIED IN THE UNITED STATES AND DEDICATED TO THE PROMOTION OF FRIENDLY RELATIONS BETWEEN FILIPINOS AND FOREIGN NATIONALS.\nPONCIANO REYES, FIRST PRESIDENT.\nITS CLUBHOUSE BECAME THE HEADQUARTERS OF THE FIRST INDEPENDENCE CONGRESS, 22 TO 26 FEBRUARY 1930.\nFAVORITE MEETING PLACE OF NATIONAL LEADERS HEADED BY PRESIDENT QUEZON AND SPEAKER ROXAS.\nFIRST BUILDING CONSTRUCTED DURING INCUMBENCY OF ANTONIO DE LAS ALAS, 1923.\nDESTROYED IN THE BATTLE OF LIBERATION, 1945.\nRECONSTRUCTED DURING THE TERM OF RAMON C.\nORDOVEZA, 1953.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/philippine-columbian-association/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Philippine Expeditionary Force to Korea (PEFTOK)\" in Philippine–Korea Friendship Center, Bayani Road, Taguig City, installed by the National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) in June 25, 2015. Marker text:\nPHILIPPINE EXPEDITIONARY FORCE TO KOREA (PEFTOK)\nIPINADALA NG PAMAHALAANG PILIPINAS SA TIMOG KOREA BILANG TUGON SA PANAWAGAN NG UNITED NATIONS NA PIGILAN ANG PAG-ABANTE NG HUKBO NG HILAGANG KOREA, 1950–1955.\nBINUO NG 2ND, 10TH, 14TH, 19TH, AT 20TH BATTALION COMBAT TEAMS NG MGA BETERANONG SUNDALO NG IKALAWANG DIGMAANG PANDAIGDIG AT BIHASA SA LABANANG GERILYA.\nDUMATING ANG UNANG GRUPO SA PUSAN, 19 SETYEMBRE 1950.\nSUMABAK SA MGA LABANAN SA MIUDONG AT SINGYE (1950), YULDONG (1951), HILL EERIE (1951–1952), AT CHRISTMAS HILL (1953).\nMAHIGIT SANDAANG PILIPINO ANG NASAWI, 300 ANG SUGATAN AT 40 ANG NAGING BILANGGO NG DIGMAAN.\nMATAGUMPAY NA BUMALIK SA PILIPINAS ANG HULING GRUPO 17 MAYO 1955.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/philippine-expeditionary-force-to-korea-peftok/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Memorary (Naval Battle on the Coastline of Cavite of Manila)\" in Philippine Navy Headquarters, Roxas Bolulevard, Malate, Manila, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 12 February 1998. Marker text:\nMEMORARE\nTHIS HISTORICAL MARKER IS DEDICATED TO ALL THE SPANISH AND FILIPINO SAILORS WHO DIED AND PERISHED IN ACTION DURING THE NAVAL BATTLE OF THE COASTLINE OF CAVITE IN MANILA BAY ON MAY 1, 1898, ESPECIALLY THOSE WHO FOUGHT TO THE END UNDER ADMIRAL PATRIRIO MONTOJO AND, THOUGH DEFEATED, WON THE ADMIRATION OF THE SPANIARDS AND ADVERSARIES FOR THEIR HEROIC STAND AGAINST THE SUPERIOR AMERICAN NAVAL FORCE.\nUNVEILED ON THE OCCASION OF THE CENTENNIAL CELEBRATION OF PHILIPPINE INDEPENDENCE BY HIS EXCELLENCY FIDEL VALDEZ RAMOS PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES AND HIS MAJESTY KING JUAN CARLOS OF SPAIN, THIS 12 FEBRUARY 1998, TO FOSTER THE FRIENDSHIP AND CLOSE COOPERATION BETWEEN SPAIN AND THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/memorary-naval-battle-on-the-coastline-of-cavite-of-manila/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Dambana ni Mabini Pandakan, Maynila\" in Pandacan, Manila, installed by the National Historical Commission (NHC) in 1970. Marker text:\nDAMBANA NI MABINI\nPANDAKA, MAYNILA\nABUGADO, MANUNULAT AT BAYANI NG HIMAGSIKAN, SI APOLINARIO MABINI AY ISINILANG SA TALAGA, TANAWAN, BATANGAS NOONG 22 HULYO 1864.\nNANIRAHAN SYA SA BAHAY NA ITO NA ARI NINA CECILIO DEL ROSARIO AT MAXIMA CASTANEDA, MULA NOONG 1888 HANGGANG 1896, NANG DAKPIN SIYA NG MGA MAYKAPANGYARIHAN SA HINALANG MAY KINALAMAN SIYA SA KATIPUNAN NANG PALAYAIN SIYA NOONG HULYO 1897 AY IPINAGPATULOY NIYA ANG KANYANG GAWAIN SA HIMAGSIKAN.\nNAGING PUNONG TAGAPAYO NI HENERAL EMILIO AGUINALDO NOONG 12 HUNYO 1898 AT PINAKAMATAAS NA MINISTRO NG PAMAHALAANG MAPANGHIMAGSIK MULA NOONG 2 ENERO HANGGANG 7 MAYO 1899, NANAG MAGBITIW SIYA SA GABINETE.\nIBINILANGGO NG HUKBONG AMERIKANO MULA NOONG DISYEMBRE 1899 HANGGANG OKTUBRE 1900.\nMULING IBINILANGGO NOONG ENERO 1901 DAHIL SA KANYANG MGA ARTIKULONG MAPANGHIMAGSIK.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/dambana-ni-mabini-pandakan-maynila/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nANG GUSALING PAMPAMAHALAAN NG NAGCARLAN\n(NAGCARLAN PRESIDENCIA)\nSA ILALIM NG BAGONG REHIMENG AMERIKANO, ANG DATING ‘CASA REAL’ O BAHAY PAMAHALAAN NA IPINATAYO NG REHIMENG KASTILA NOONG 1845 SA PANULUKAN NG CALLE SAN DIGEO AT CALLE SAN RAFAEL AY TULUYAN NANG NAIPASARA.\nTAONG 1914, IPINATAYO ANG BAGONG ‘GUSALING PAMPAMAHALAAN’ SA GITNA NG ISANG MALAWAK NA LUPAIN MALAPIT SA LIBINGAN NG LUPA SA PANUNUNGKULAN NI G.\nLEONARDO LUCIDO.\nNAGING DALAWANG PALAPAG ANG GUSALI TAONG 1926 SA PANAHON NG PANUNUNGKULAN NI G.\nNEMESIO F.\nESMILLA.\nMAYROON ITONG DALAWAMPU’T ISANG SILID NA ANG KABUUANG ‘FACHADA’, SA DISENYO AT YARIG ‘NEO-CLASSICAL’ AY KAPANSIN-PANSIN ANG IMPLUWENSIYANG DAYUHAN.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/ang-gusaling-pampamahalaan-ng-nagcarlan-nagcarlan-presidencia/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nESCUADRO AEREA DE PELEA 201\n(AGUILAS AZTECAS)\nNATATANGING PUWERSANG MEHIKANONG NAKIPAGLABAN SA LABAS NG MEHIKO NOONG IKALAWANG DIGMAANG PANDAIGDIG.\nBINUO NG PAMAHALAANG MEHIKO AT IPINADALA SA PILIPINAS BILANG BAHAGI NG PUWERSANG ALYANSA.\nITINALAGA BILANG OPERASYONG PANGHIMPAPAWID, 1 ENERO 1945.\nDUMATING SA MAYNILA, 30 ABRIL 1945, AT NAGKAMPO SA PORAC, PAMPANGA, MAYO 1945, SUMUPORTA SA MGA MISYON SA HILAGANG LUZON, 4 HUNYO-4 HULYO 1945.\nNILISAN ANG PILIPINAS, 22 OKTUBRE 1945, AT BUMALIK SA MEHIKO BILANG MGA BAYANI, 18 NOBYEMBRE 1945.\nITINAYO AT PINASINAYAAN NG MGA MIYEMBRO NG ESCUADRO 201 ANG BANTAYOG NITO BILANG PAGKILALA SA KANILANG PANGKAT, AT BILANG PAG-ALALA SA MGA NAMATAY NILANG KASAPI, 25 SETYEMBRE 1945.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/escuadro-aerea-de-pelea-201-aguilas-aztecas/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Samahang Pang-hukbong Katihan at Pandagat ng Maynila\" in Roxas Boulevard, Manila, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 6 January 1979. Marker text:\nSAMAHANG PANG-HUKBONG KATIHAN AT\nPANDAGAT NG MAYNILA\nITINATAG NOONG 1898.\nINILIPAT MULA SA DATING POOK NG SPANISH ARMY ENGINEERS SA INTRAMUROS NOONG 1911.\nSA KANYANG KINALALAGYAN NGAYON NA BAHAGI NG PINALAKING LUNETA.\nAYON SA PLANO NG ARKITEKTONG SI DANIEL BURNHAM, NA ITINAYO SA DAKONG TIMOG, KATAPAT NG MANILA HOTEL.\nITINALAGA PARA SA MGA OPISYAL MILITAR NA AMERIKANO HANGGANG SA IKALAWANG DIGMAANG PANDAIGDIG.\nSINAKOP NG MGA GERILYANG PILIPINO AT HUKBONG AMERIKANO NOONG PEBRERO, 1945.\nNAPAILALIM SA PAMAHALAANG SIBILYAN, 1951.\nSI HENERAL L.V.\nMEIM B NG PC, AFP, ANG UNANG PANGULONG PILIPINONG NAHALAL, ENERO 20, 1976.\nANG KAUNAN-UNAHANG PANGULO AY SI ALMIRANTE GORGE DEWEY AT IBA PANG NAGING PANGULO AY KABILANG SINA HENERAL ARTHUR MACARTHUR AT ANAK NIYANG SI DOUGLAS MACARTHUR, HENERAL LEONARD WOOD, AT IBA PA.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/samahang-pang-hukbong-katihan-at-pandagat-ng-maynila/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nHANTIQUE IGCABUHI\nITINATAG NG MGA PARING AGUSTINO SA NAYON NG HAMTIC NOONG 1581.\nANG SIMBAHANG PAMPAROKYA AY IPINAGAWA SA ILALIM NG PAGTANGKILIK NG PATRONANG SI SANTA MONICA.ITO AY NAGING VISITA NG IBAHAY, AKLAN.\nNOONG 1596, NANG ITO AY IWAN NG MGA MISYONERO.SA PAGSISIMULA NG IKA-17 DAANTAON, ITO AY MULING NAGING PAROKYA AT NAGING VISITA NITO ANG BUGASONG.\nPAGKARAAN ITO AY NAGING HIMPILAN PARA SA EBANGHELISASYON.\nBUHAT SA MGA BAHAGI NG ILOILO AT CAPIZ, ANG ANTIQUEAY NAGING LALAWIGANG PAMPULITIKA-MILITAR NOONG 1790.\nUNANG KABISERA NITO ANG HAMTIC.\nNOONG 1802 ITO AY INILIPAT SA SAN JOSE DE BUENAVISTA.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/hantique-igcabuhi/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Guindulman\" in Guindulman, Bohol, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 7 September 1985.   "content": "Historical marker \"Trece Martires de Bagumbayan\" in Japanese Garden, Rizal Park, Ermita, Manila, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 1999. Marker text:\nTRECE MARTIRES DE BAGUMBAYAN\nHERE 13 PATRIOTS WERE EXECUTED BY THE SPANISH AUTHORITIES ON JANUARY 11, 1897.\nTEN WERE MASONS, NAMELY: NUMERIANO ADRIANO, JOSE DIZON, DOMINGO FRANCO, EUSTACIO MAÑALAC, GERONIMO CRISTOBAL MEDINA, RAMON PADILLA, ANTONIO SALAZAR, MOISES SALVADOR, LUIS ENCISO VILLAREAL, AND FAUSTINO VILLARUEL.\nBENEDICTO NIJAGA, BRAULIO RIVERA AND FRANCISCO L.\nROXAS DIED WITH THEM.\nALL WERE PATRIOTS.\nTHE 13 PAID THE HIGHEST PRICE POSSIBLE FOR THE FREEDOM AND INDEPENDENCE OF THEIR COUNTRY HAVING PERISHED FOR SO GREAT A CAUSE.\nTHEY DESERVE TO LIVE ON IN THE HEARTS OF THEIR GRATEFUL COUNTRYMEN.\nTO THEIR MEMORY THIS MARKER IS RAISED.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/trece-martires-de-bagumbayan/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nCAGAYAN (MAPUN)\nRUTA NG EKSPEDISYONG MAGALLANES–ELCANO SA PILIPINAS\nPANSAMANTALANG NAGPAHINGA ANG EKSPEDISYON SA CAGAYAN (NGAYO’Y MAPUN, TAWI-TAWI), HABANG TINATAWID NILA ANG DAGAT SULU UPANG HANAPIN ANG MALUKU, NOO’Y KILALANG PINAGMUMULAN NG MGA PAMPALASA (BAHAGI NGAYON NG INDONESYA), MAYO 1521.\nINILARAWAN ANG MGA TAGA-RITO BILANG MGA MUSLIM AT BILANG MATATAPANG NA MANDIRIGMA.\nPINAYUHAN SILANG TUMUNGO SA PALAWAN UPANG DOON MAKIPAGKALAKALAN NG MGA PANGANGAILANGAN.\nANG PANANDANG PANGKASAYSAYANG ITO AY PINASINAYAAN BILANG AMBAG SA PAGGUNITA SA IKA-500 ANIBERSARYO NG UNANG PAG-IKOT SA DAIGDIG.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/cagayan-mapun-ruta-ng-ekspedisyon-magallanes-elcano-sa-pilipinas/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nPALAWAN\nRUTA NG EKSPEDISYON MAGALLANES-ELCANO SA PILIPINAS\nMULA SA CAGAYAN (NGAYO’Y MAPUN, TAWI-TAWI), TUMUNGO ANG EKSPEDISYON SA PALAWAN (TINATAYA NGAYONG ABORLAN, PALAWAN).\nSA UNANG TANGKA NILANG DUMAONG DITO, ITINABOY SILA NG MGA TAGA-RITO.\nTINANGGAP NAMAN SILA NG MAAYOS SA DAUNGAN NG DYGUAZAM (TEGOZZAO SA MAPA NI ANTONIO PIGAFETTA AT SAOCAO SA TALA NI FRANCISCO ALBO), TINATAYANG SITIO TAGUSAO, BARONG-BARONG, BROOKE’S POINT, PALAWAN.\nINANYAYAHAN SILA NG MGA KATUTUBO NA TUMUNGO SA VAY PALAY CUCARA CAUBAM UPANG MAKIPAGKAIBIGAN SA PINUNO NITO SI JUAN CARVALHO, PINUNO NG EKSPEDISYON.\nDAHIL SA MAGAGANDANG KARANASAN, INILARAWAN NI PIGAFETTA ANG PALAWAN BILANG TERRA DE PMISSIONE (LUPANG PANGAKO).\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/palawan-ruta-ng-ekspedisyon-magallanes-elcano-sa-pilipinas/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Daughters of Charity\" in CBCP Headquarters, Gen. Luna Street, Intramuros, Manila, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 22 July 1987. Marker text:\nDAUGTERS OF CHARITY\nBATONG BATAYAN NG KAWANGGAWA NG MGA VINCENTIANS BILANG TUGON SA UTOS NI REYNA ISABELLA II NG ESPANYA NOONG IKA-19 NG OKTUBRE 1852, NANIRAHAN SA KOLEHIYO NG STA.\nISABEL, DATING NAKATAYO DITO, ANG UNANG MINSYON NG 15 DAUGHTERS OF CHARITY NU SAN VICENTE DE PAUL NA DUMATING SA PILIPINAS NOONG IKA-22 NG HULYO 1862.\nNARAGDAGAN NG 59 MISYONG BINUBUO NG 447 MADRENG KASTILA NA KUMALAT SA 22 NA BAHAY PANGMISYON SA LOOB NG 93 TAON, PAGKARAAN, SUMAPI ANG 1,278 FILIPINOS, 1 ITALIAN, 1 BRITISH, 1 FRENCH, 2 AMERICANS, 3 CHINESE, 1 VIETNAMESE, 10 THAIS, 7 INDIANS, 3 INDONESIANS, 1 FIJIAN AT 1 KOREAN.\nSA PAGDIRIWANG NG IKA-125 TAONG PAGKAKATATAG SA IKA-22 NG HULYO 1987, ANG KOMPANYA AT NAGLILINGKOD SA 56 BAHAY PANGMISYON, 6 SA MGA ITO ANG NASA TAHILAND AT PULONG FIJI.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/daughters-of-charity/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "title": "Hospicio de San Jose",
  "content": "Historical marker \"Hospicio de San Jose\" in Ayala Boulevard, San Miguel, Manila, installed by the Historical Research and Markers Committee in 17 October 1939. Marker text:\nHOSPICIO DE SAN JOSE\nFRANCISCO GOMEZ ENRIQUEZ AND HIS WIFE, BARBARA VERZOSA, FOUNDED THIS INSTITUTION IN 1782 FOR THE POOR AND FEEBLE-MINDED.\nA LIST OF ITS PATRONS IN THE ENTRANCE HALL INCLUDES NAMES OF SOME OF THE MOST NOBLE FAMILIES IN MANILA.\nTHE INSTITUTION CARES FOR THE NEEDY, FROM FOUNDLINGS TO THE MOST AGED AND HELPLESS, AND GIVEN CHILDREN PRACTICAL AND RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.\nORIGINALLY LOCATED IN PANDACAN, IT WAS FIRST MOVED TO INTRAMUROS AND THEN TO BINONDO;\nTHENCE TO THIS ISLET IN 1835-1840.\nTHE SISTERS OF CHARITY HAVE BEEN ADMINISTERING IT SINCE 1865;\nITS FOUNDLING ASYLUM DATES 1903;\nFROM 1905 TO 1917 THE PHILIPPINE GOVERNMENT SENT JUVENILE DELINQUENTS TO THIS INSTITUTION.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/hospicio-de-san-jose/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"The Signing of the Terms of Capitulation\" in Luzurriaga Residence, Bacolod City, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in November 6, 1998. Marker text:\nTHE SIGNING OF THE TERMS OF CAPITULATION\nIN THIS HOUSE, AT 5:00 O’CLOCK IN THE AFTERNOON OF NOVEMBER 6, 1898, THE TERMS OF CAPITULATION WAS SIGNED BETWEEN THE SPANISH AND FILIPINO REPRESENTATIVES SIGNIFYING THE END OF SPANISH RULE IN THE ISLAND OF NEGROS.\nTHE SPANISH GOVERNMENT WAS REPRESENTED BY ISIDRO DE CASTRO, POLITICO-MILITARY GOVERNOR OF NEGROS, PROVINCIAL FISCAL MANUEL ABENZA, ADMINISTRATOR OF PUBLIC LANDS RAMON ARMANDO, PROVINCIAL REGISTRAR EMILIO MONASTERIO AND NOTARY PUBLIC DOMINGO URETA.\nTHE FILIPINO SIGNERS WERE GENERAL ANICETO LACSON, GENERAL JUAN ARANETA, JOSE MONTILLA AND SIMEON LIZARES.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/the-signing-of-the-terms-of-capitulation/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Ambrosio Rianzares Bautista (1830-1903)\" in Biñan, Laguna, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 1980. Marker text:\nAMBROSIO RIANZARES BAUTISTA\n(1830-1903)\nUNANG TAGAPAYO NI HENERAL EMILIO AGUINALDO NOONG 1898.\nMAY-AKDA NG PAGPAPAHAYAG NG KALAYAAN NG PILIPINAS (IKA-12 NG HUNYO 1898), AT MASAGISAG NA MAKABAYAN AT TAGPAGPALAGANAP.\nSIYA AY IPINANGANAK SA BIÑAN, LAGUNA NOONG IKA-7 DISYEMBRE 1830 KINA GREGORIO ENRIQUEZ BAUTISTA AT SILVESTRA ALTAMIRA.\nNAGTAPOS SIYA NG PANIMULANG PAG-AARAL SA BIÑAN AT NG PAG-AARAL SA BATAS SA PAMANTASAN NG SANTO TOMAS NOONG 1865.\nNAGSANAY SIYA SA PAGKAMANANANGGOL SA MAYNILA AT NAGING KILALA SA PAGKAKALOOB NG WALANG BAYAD NA PAGLILINGKOD SA MAHIHIRAP NA MAY USAPIN.\nISANG MASIGASIG NA KAGAWAD NG LA LIGA FILIPINA, CUERPO DE COMPROMISARIOS, AT LA PROPAGANDA.\nSIYA AY DINAKIP NG MGA MAYKAPANGYARIHANG KASTILA AT IPINIIT SA KUTANG SANTIAGO NANG MAGSIKLAB ANG HIMAGSIKAN NOONG 1896.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/ambrosio-rianzares-bautista-1830-1903/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Homonhon\" in Homonhon, Guiuan, Eastern Samar, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1952. Marker text:\nHOMONHON\nON THIS ISLAND FERDINAND MAGELLAN’S EXPEDITION TO THE SPICE ISLANDS LANDED, 17 MARCH 1521, THE DAY OF SAINT LAZARUS WHOSE NAME WAS GIVEN TO THE WHOLE ARCHIPELAGO.\nNEARBY ISLANDERS CAME THE NEXT DAY TO MEET THE VISITORS WITH MAGELLAN’S SERVANT ENRIQUE FROM MALACCA AS INTERPRETER.\nTHE GREAT NAVIGATOR EXTENDED TO THEM THE MESSAGE OF GOODWILL FROM THE KING OF SPAIN, WHICH WAS RECIPROCATED.\nA FEAST WAS HELD AND GIFTS EXCHANGED.\nEIGHT DAYS LATER, ON MARCH 25, THE CREW SAILED TO LIMASAWA, WHERE THE FIRST MASS IN THE PHILIPPINES WAS HELD, 31 MARCH 1521.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/homonhon-2/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Paliparang Zablan, P.A.A.C.\" in Fort Emilio Aguinaldo, Quezon City, installed by the National Historical Commission (NHC) in 1 May 1968. Marker text:\nPALIPARANG ZABLAN, P.A.A.C.\nSA POOK NA ITO, NOONG IKA-2 NG MAYO, 1936, SINUBUKAN NI TENYENTE WILLIAM A.\nLEE ANG KAUNAUNAHANG EROPLANO NG LAKAS-PANGHIMPAPAWID NG HUKBONG PILIPINO, NA NAG URI AY STEARMAN 731-3.\nNOONG 1935, ANG PALIPARNG ITO’Y IPINANGALAN SA KARANGALAN NI KOMANDANTE PORFIRIO ZABLAN NG KAPAMPANGAN.\nANG BAHAGING ITO NG KAMPO AGUINALDO AY PUNONG HIMPILAN NOONG 1935 NG TACTICAL COMPANY AT NG SERVICE COMPANY NG LAKAS NG PANGHIMPAPAWID NG KONSTABULARYA NG PILIPINAS, MULA NOONG 1936 HANGGANG 1941 AY PUNONG HIMPILAN NG 1ST SCHOOL SQUADRON, 2ND SERVICE AND DEPOT SQUADRON, 3RD DEPOT SQUADRON, 4TH AIR BASE SQUADRON, AT NG 5TH PHOTO SQUADRON NG LAKAS-PANGHIMPAPAWID NG HUKBO NG PILIPINAS.\nSI KOMANDANTE EDWIN ANDREWS ANG PUNO NANG SUMIKLAB ANG IKALAWANG DIGMAANG PANDAIGDIG.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/paliparang-zablan-p-a-a-c/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Philippine National Red Cross\" in Taft Avenue corner U.N. Avenue, Ermita, Manila, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1955. Marker text:\nPHILIPPINE NATIONAL RED CROSS\nORGANIZED AS A BRANCH OF THE AMERICAN RED CROSS 30 AUGUST 1905, AT THE INITIATIVE OF MABEL T.\nBOARDMAN.\nMADE INTO A FULL-FLEDGED CHAPTER OF THE AMERICAN RED CROSS, 1917;\nINTEGRATED AS A UNIT OF THE CIVILIAN EMERGENCY ADMINISTRATION IN 1941 AND OPERATED AS A SOCIETY SEPARATE FROM THE AMERICAN RED CROSS DURING THE WORLD WAR II.\nON 14 FEBRUARY 1947, THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES ACCEDED TO THE GENEVA CONVENTION.\nON 22 MARCH 1947, THE CONGRESS OF THE PHILIPPINES APPROVED REPUBLIC ACT NO.\n95 WHICH GRANTED A CHARTER TO AN INDEPENDENT PHILIPPINE NATIONAL RED CROSS, WHICH WAS FORMALLY ESTABLISHED AT CEREMONIES HELD AT MALACAÑANG, 15 APRIL 1947, WITH MRS.\nAURORA ARAGON-QUEZON AS FIRST CHAIRMAN.\nTHIS BUILDING WAS ERECTED 1932.\nBURNED DURING THE LAST WAR, AND RECONSTRUCTED IN 1948.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/philippine-national-red-cross/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Diocese of Nueva Segovia\" in Lal-loc, Cagayan, installed by the Historical Research and Markers Committee in 1939. Marker text:\nDIOCESE OF NUEVA SEGOVIA\nTHE DIOCESE OF NUEVA SEGOVIA, WHICH WAS FOUNDED ON 14 AUGUST 1599 THROUGH THE EFFORTS OF BISHOP DOMINGO DE SALAZAR IN MADRID AND BY VIRTUE OF A BRIEF ISSUED BY POPE CLEMENT VII HAD ITS FIRST SEAT IN LAL-LOC, CAGAYAN.\nWHEN IT WAS TRANSFERRED TO VIGAN IT OCCUPIED A BUILDING, WHICH ESCAPED CAPTURE BY THE REBELS WHEN DIEGO SILANG, WHO HAD DEFEATED THE BISHOP’S FORCES WAS KILLED BY VICOS IN 1763.\nTHE PRESENT BUILDING, WHICH WAS BUILT IN 1783-1790, ALSO HOUSED THE ECCLESIASTICAL COURT UNTIL 1890, WAS OCCUPIED BY THE REVOLUTIONISTS, WHO IMPRISONED BISHOP JOSE HEVIA CAMPOMANES IN IT, FROM 1896 until 1899;\nAND WAS USED AS A GARRISON BY THE AMERICAN FORCES UNDER LT.\nCOL.\nJAMES PARK, 45TH INFANTRY, U.S.A.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/diocese-of-nueva-segovia/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nEMILIO JACINTO\nKINILALANG “UTAK NG KATIPUNAN,” SI JACINTO AY ISINILANG SA POOK NA ITO NOONG IKA-15 NG DISYEMBRE, 1875.\nANAK NINA MARIANO JACINTO AT JOSEFA DIZON.\nUNANG NAG-AARAL SA PAARALAN NI MAESTRO PASCUAL FERRER;\nNAGTAPOS NG BATSILYER SA SINING SA KOLEHIYO NG SAN JUAN DE LETRAN AT NAG-ARAL NG BATAS SA UNIBERSIDAD NG STO.\nTOMAS.\nUMANIB SA KATIPUNAN NOONG 1894 NA ANG SINASAGISAG AY “PINGKIAN.” NAGING KALIHIM NG K.K.K., AT KANANG-KAMAY NI ANDRES BONIFACIO.\nMAY AKDA NG “KARTILYA,” “LIWANAG AT DILIM” ATBP.\nKASAMANG NAGTATAG NG KALAYAAN, ANG PAHAYAGANG TAMBULI NG KKK, AT NAGSULAT DOON SA ILALIM NG SAGISAG NG “DIMAS-ILAW.”\nNAMATAY NOONG IKA-16 NG ABRIL, 1899 SA MAHAYHAY, LAGUNA.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/emilio-jacinto/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Hospital de San Lazaro\" in Naga, Camarines Sur in Unknown. Marker text:\nHOSPITAL DE SAN LAZARO\nTHIS IS THE SITE OF THE FORMER HOSPITAL DE SAN LAZARO FOUNDED BY THE FRANCISCANS IN 1586.\nIN 1625 THE PATRONATO REAL (CROWN) ASSUMED THE TEMPORAL ADMINISTRATION OF THE HOSPITAL, WHILE THE FRANCISCANS RETAINED THE SPIRITUAL MINISTRATION.\nA TYPHOON DESTROYED THE HOSPITAL IN 1663 AND A BUILDING OF LIGHT MATERIALS WAS CONSTRUCTED IN 1664 WHICH WAS TURNED OVER TO THE BISHOP OF NUEVA CACERES IN 1691.\nBISHOP FRANCISCO C.\nGAINZA, O.P.\nERECTED IN 1873 A NEW AND STRONGER HOSPITAL, BUT THIS WAS DESTROYED BY THE EARTHQUAKE OF APRIL 19, 1907.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/hospital-de-san-lazaro/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "title": "Jagna Martyrs",
  "content": "Historical marker \"Jagna Martyrs\" in Brgy. Lonoy, Jagna, Bohol, installed by the Philippines Historical Committee (PHC) in 1958. Marker text:\nJAGNA MARTYRS\nSITE OF A BLOODY ENCOUNTER BETWEEN FILIPINOS AND AMERICANS IN WHICH 406 DIE-HARD REVOLUTIONISTS LED BY CAPITAN GOYO (GREGORIO) CASEÑAS, PERISHED ON EASTER SUNDAY, 1901.\nTHE INTREPID BAND DUG INTO GRASSY TRENCHES INTENDING TO AMBUSH THE AMERICANS, BUT THE TREACHERY OF FRANCISCO (ISKO) ACALA, WHO REVEALED THE PLAN TO THE AMERICANS, RESULTED INSTEAD IN THE WHOLESALE DEATH OF CAPITAN GOYO AND HIS MEN.\nTHE AMERICANS ENTERED JAGNA AND BURNED THE WHOLE TOWN, SPARING ONLY THE CHURCH, THE CONVENT AND A FEW HOUSES.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/jagna-martyrs/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nBATULAKI\nRUTA NG EKSPEDISYONG MAGALLANES–ELCANO SA PILIPINAS\nMULA SA BENAIAN (TINATAYANG TANGOS NG KAMANGA, MAASIM, LALAWIGAN NG SARANGANI), BINAYBAY NG EKSPEDISYON ANG BIRAHAM BATOLACH (BATULAKI, GLAN, LALAWIGAN NG SARANGANI) 26 OCTUBRE 1521.\nNAKALIGTAS ANG EKSPEDISYON MULA SA MALAKAS NA BAGYO, ISINULAT NI ANTONIO PIGAFETTA, TAGAPAGTALA NG EKSPEDISYON, NA INILIGTAS SILA NINA SAN ELMO, SANTA CLARA AT SAN NICOLAS DE TOLENTINO SA SAKUNANG ITO.\nNILISAN ANG BATULAKI, 27 OKTUBRE 1521.\nANG PANANDANG PANGKASAYSAYANG ITO AY PINASINAYAAN BILANG AMBAG SA PAGGUNITA SA IKA-500 ANIBERSARYO NG UNANG PAG-IKOT SA DAIGDIG.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/batulaki-ruta-ng-ekspedisyong-magallanes-elcano-sa-pilipinas/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Sarangani – Ruta ng Ekspedisyong Magallanes-Elcano sa Pilipinas\" in Sarangani Island, Sarangani, Davao Occidental, installed by the National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) in 2021. Marker text:\nSARANGANI\nRUTA NG EKSPEDISYONG MAGALLANES–ELCANO SA PILIPINAS\nHULING BAHAGI NG KAPULUAN NA DINAUNGAN NG EKSPEDISYON NASA KATIMUGANG DAKO NITO ANG MALUKU, NOO’Y KILALANG PINAGMUMULAN NG MGA PAMPALASA (BAHAGI NGAYON NG INDONESYA) MATAPOS ANG UNOS SA BIRAHAM BATOLACH (BATULAKI, GLAN, LALAWIGAN NG SARANGANI), NOONG 26 OKTUBRE 1521.\nTINUNGO NG EKSPEDISYON ANG DAKO NG PULO NG CANDIGHAR (TINATAYA NGAYONG BALOT, BAYAN NG SARANGANI, DAVAO OCCIDENTAL), AT DUMAONG SA PULO NG SARANGANI, 27 OKTUBRE 1521.\nDALAWANG MAMAMAYAN NG SARANGANI ANG SAPILITANG GINAWANG PILOTO NG EKSPEDISYON SA PAGTUNTON SA MALUKU.\nNILISAN ANG SARANGANI PATUNGONG MALUKU, 28 OKTUBRE 1521.\nANG PANANDANG PANGKASAYSAYANG ITO AY PINASINAYAAN BILANG AMBAG SA PAGGUNITA SA IKA-500 ANIBERSARYO NG UNANG PAG-IKOT SA DAIGDIG.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/sarangani-ruta-ng-ekspedisyong-magallanes-elcano-sa-pilipinas/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Jose Rizal (Tuy, Batangas)\" in Tuy Municipal Plaza, Tuy, Batangas, installed by the National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) in 28 December 2021. Marker text:\nJOSE RIZAL\n(1861–1896)\nPAMBANSANG BAYANI NG PILIPINAS.\nDOKTOR, AGRIMENSOR, DALUBWIKA, MANUNULAT, MAKATA, ESKULTOR AT PINTOR.\nISINILANG SA CALAMBA, LAGUNA, 19 HUNYO 1861.\nMAY-AKDA NG NOLI ME TANGERE (1887) AT EL FILIBUSTERISMO (1891), MGA NOBELANG HIGIT PANG NAGPAALAB SA MGA FILIPINO NA MAGHIMAGSIK LABAN SA ESPANYA.\nDINAKIP AT IPINATAPON SA DAPITAN, MINDANAO, 6 HULYO 1892.\nNAGBOLUNTARYO BILANG MANGGAGAMOT NG PUWERSANG ESPANYOL SA CUBA, 1896, NGUNI’T MULING DINAKIP HABANG PATUNGONG ESPANYA SA BINTANG REBELYON.\nBINARIL SA BAGUMBAYAN (NGAYO’Y RIZAL PARK), MAYNILA, 30 DISYEMBRE 1896.\nPATULOY NA INSPIRASYON PARA SA KALAYAN AT PAGKABANSANG FILIPINO.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/jose-rizal-tuy-batangas/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nSAMAR\nRUTA DE LA EXPEDICION MAGALLANES–ELCANO EN LAS ISLAS FILIPINAS\nEL OBJETIVO DE LA EXPEDICION ERA BUSCAR UNA RUTA ALTERNATIVA A LAS ISLAS MOLUCAS, LUGAR CONOCIDO POR SUS ESPECIAS (HOY PARTE DE INDONESIA).\nDESDE GUAM, LA EXPEDICION NAVEGO HACIA OCCIDENTE, EL 9 DE MARZO DE 1521.\nALCANZARON LA ZONA DE SAMAR QUE EVITARON POR SU TERRENO ROGOSO (CORRESPONDE APROXIDAMENTE A LA PENINSULA DE GUIUAN Y A LAS ISLA DE CALICOAN, GUIUAN, SAMAR ORIENTAL).\nCONTINUARON HACIA LAS AGUAS DE SULUAN (HOY PARTE DE GUIUAN, SAMAR ORIENTAL), EL 16 DE MARZO DE 1521.\nMUCHAS ISLAS, INCUIDA, HOMONHON, FUERON DENOMIDAS ARCHIPIELAGO DE SAN LAZARO POR FERNANDO DE MAGALLANES, CAPITAN GENERAL DE LA EXPEDICION, EL 17, DE MARZO DE 1521.\nLA EXPEDECION ARRIBO A FILIPINAS EN LA BUSQUEDA DE LAS MOLUCAS.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/samar-ruta-de-la-expedicion-magallanes-elcano-en-las-islas-filipinas/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Palasyo ng Malakanyang\" in Lobby of the Malacañang Palace, Jose P. Laurel Street, San Miguel, Manila, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 2004. Marker text:\nPALASYO NG MALAKANYANG\nBINILI NI KORONEL MIGUEL JOSE FOMENTO BUHAT KAY LUIS ROCHA, 1802.\nIPINAGBILI SA PAMAHALAANG KASTILA, 1825, ITINALAGA BILANG TIRAHANG PANTAG-ARAW NG GOBERNADOR HENERAL NA KINILALA BILANG POSESION DE MALACANANG MATAPOS GUMUHO SA LINDOL ANG PALASYO DEL GOBERNADOR SA INTRAMUROS 3 HUNYO 1863.\nPINALAKI, PINATAAS ANG LUPA, PINAREGRADO AT PINAGAWAN NG LIWASAN NOONG PANAHON NG PAMAHALAANG KOLONYAL NG AMERIKA SA ILALIM NG PANUNUNGKULAN NINA GOBERNADOR-HENERAL FRANCIS BURTON HARRISON AR DWIGHT DAVIS.\nGUMAWA NG MGA PAGBABAGO SA PANAHON NG PANUNUNGKULAN NG IBA’T IBANG PANGULONG MANUEL L.\nQUEZON NG KOMONWELT.\nANG UNANG PILIPINONG PUNONG TAGAPAGPAGANAP NA NANIRAHAN DITO.\nANG KARATIG NA GUSALING EHEKUTIBO AY NATAPOS NOONG 1939.\nANG PREMIERE GUESTHOUSE, 1975.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/palasyo-ng-malakanyang/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Marker text:\nTOMAS GUILLERMO T.\nDEL ROSARIO\nMASIGASIG NA TAGAPAGTAGUYOD NG KARAPATAN SA MALAYANG PAGSAMBA AT NG PAGKAKAHIWALAY NG SIMBAHAN AT ESTADO.\nISINILANG KINA CIPRIANO DEL ROSARIO AT SEVERINA TONGCO SA BINONDO, MAYNILA, 10 PEBRERO 1857.\nNAGTAPOS NG BACHILLER EN ARTES SA ATENEO MUNICIPAL, 1875;\nAT LICENCIADO EN DERECHO SA UNIBERSIDAD NG SANTOS TOMAS, 1886.\nNAGLINGKOD BILANG JUEZ DE PAZ, PROMOTOR FISCAL, AT JUEZ DE PRIMERA INSTANCIA NG MAYNILA, 1888–1896.\nIPINATAPON SA CUETA, APRIKA SA PAGKAKASANGKOT SA HIMAGSIKAN 1896–1897.\nNAGBALIK SA PILIPINAS AT NAHIRANG SA DELEGADO SA KONGRESO NG MALOLOS BILANG KINATAWAN NG SURIGAO, 1898.\nNAHALAL NA GOBERNADOR NG BATAAN, 1904–1906;\nAT KINATAWAN SA PHILIPPINE ASSEMBLY, 1909–1912.\nYUMAO, 4 HULYO 1913.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/tomas-guillermo-t-del-rosario/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Manuel Acuña Roxas (1892–1948)\" in Hughes Street cor. Rizal Street, Roxas, Capiz, installed by the National Historical Institute (NHI) in 2011. Marker text:\nMANUEL ACUÑA ROXAS\n(1892–1948)\nPATRIOT, STATESMAN AND SOLDIER.\nFIFTH PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES, 1946–1948.\nBORN IN CAPIZ, CAPIZ (NOW ROXAS CITY), 1 JANUARY 1892.\nOBTAINED BACHELOR OF LAWS, UNIVERSITY OF THE PHILIPPINES;\nBAR TOPNOTCHER, 1913.\nGOVERNOR OF CAPIZ, 1919–1922.\nREPRESENTATIVE OF CAPIZ AND SPEAKER OF THE HOUSE, 1922–1934;\nHEADED THE PHILIPPINE INDEPENDENCE MISSION TO THE UNITED STATES WITH SERGIO OSMEÑA KNOWN AS OS–ROX MISSION, 1931–1933.\nDELEGATE TO THE CONSTITUTIONAL CONVENTION, 1935;\nSECRETARY OF FINANCE, 1938;\nSENATOR, 1941;\nPRESIDENT OF THE SENATE, 1945–1946.\nBECAME MAJOR DURING WORLD WAR II, 1941;\nAND BRIGADIER–GENERAL, 1945.\nDIED, 15 APRIL 1948.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/manuel-acuna-roxas-1892-1948/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Alejo Santos 1911-1984\" in Bustos Heritage Park, Bustos, Bulacan, installed by the National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) in 17 July 2022. Marker text:\nALEJO SANTOS\n1911-1984\nGURO, HENERAL, LINGKOD BAYAN, BAYANI NG IKALAWANG DIGMAANG PANDAIGDIG, AT TAGAPAGSULONG NG KULTURA AT KASAYSAYAN.\nISINILANG SA BONGA MENOR, BUSTOS, BULACAN, 17 HULYO 1911.\nLUMABAN SA MGA HAPON SA BATAAN AT NAKARANAS NG DEATH MARCH.\nITINATAG AT PINAMUNUAN ANG GRUPO NG MGA BULAKENYONG GERILYANG PHILIPPINE LEGION, HUNYO 1942.\nKUMANDER, BULACAN MILITARY DISTRICT NG EAST CENTRAL LUZON GUERILLA AREA, 14 SETYEMBRE 1943, NA NAGING BULACAN MILITARY AREA NG USAFFE LUZON GUERILLA ARMY FORCES, 12 OKTUBRE 1943.\nTUMULONG SA USAPING PANGKAPAYAPAAN SA PAGITAN NG PAMAHALAAN AT NG HUKBONG MAPAGPALAYA SA BAYAN.\nGOBERNADOR NG BULACAN, 1945, 1951-1957.\nKINATAWAN NG IKALAWANG DISTRITO NG BULACAN, 1946, 1949-1951.\nKALIHIM NG TANGGULANG PAMBANSA, 1959-1961.\nTUMAKBO SA PAGKAPANGULO, 1981.\nPUMANAW, 18 PEBRERO 1984.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/alejo-santos-1911-1984/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

Kalaw Street, Ermita, Manila, installed by the National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) in 11 August 2022. Marker text:\nPAMBANSANG AKLATAN NG PILIPINAS\nANG DIWA NG PAMBANSANG AKLATAN AY NAGSIMULA NANG ITATAG ANG MUSEO-BIBLIOTECA DE FILIPINAS SA BISA NG ISANG REAL DECRETO NI REYNA MARIA CRISTINA NG ESPANYA, 12 AGOSTO 1887.\nPINASINAYAAN, 25 OKTUBRE 1891.\nUNANG NAGBUKAS SA CALLE GUNAO, QUIAPO, MAYNILA AT KALAUNA’Y LUMIPAT SA CASA DE MONEDA, INTRAMUROS, MAYNILA.\nITINULOY SA PANAHON NG MGA AMERIKANO ANG PAGBUBUO NG PAMBANSANG AKLATAN NANG PAG-ISAHIN ANG MGA AKLATANG PAMPUBLIKO BILANG THE PHILIPPINE LIBRARY, 20 MAYO 1909, AT NAKILALA SA IBA’T IBANG PANGALAN.\nLUBHANG NAPINSALA NOONG IKALAWANG DIGMAANG PANDAIGDIG, LIBAN SA ILANG KOLEKSYONG NAKALIGTAS SA PAMBOBOMBA NOONG 1945 SA MAYNILA.\nNAKILALA BILANG PAMBANSANG AKLATAN NG PILIPINAS SA BISA NG BATAS REPUBLIKA BLG.\n10087, 13 MAYO 2010.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/pambansang-aklatan-ng-pilipinas/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Timoteo Paez (1861-1939)\" in Balut, Tondo, Manila, installed by the National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) in 1 September 2022. Marker text:\nTIMOTEO PAEZ\n(1861-1939)\nREPORMISTA AT REBOLUSYONARYO.\nISINILANG SA TONDO, MAYNILA, 22 AGOSTO 1861.\nKABILANG SA MGA NAGTATAG NG LOGIA NILAD, 6 ENERO 1892;\nAT LA LIGA FILIPINA, 3 HULYO 1892.\nSUMAPI SA CUERPO DE COMPROMISARIOS AT TUMULONG MANGALAP NG PONDO PARA SA KILUSANG REPORMISTA SA EUROPA, 1894.\nIBINILANGGO NG MGA ESPANYOL DAHIL SA PAGKASANGKOT SA HIMAGSIKAN, 1896.\nHINIRANG NI HEN.\nEMILIO AGUINALDO BILANG KOMISARYO NG DIGMAAN SA ILALIM NG PAMAHALAANG REBOLUSYONARYO.\nKINATAWAN NG SURIGAO SA KONGRESO NG PAMAHALAANG REBOLUSYONARYO, 1898-1899.\nKASAMA NI AGUINALDO SA PAGTANGGOL NG REPUBLIKA NG PILIPINAS LABAN SA PAG-ABANTE NG MGA AMERIKANO.\nINATASAN NI AGUINALDO NA SAMAHAN ANG MGA KABABAIHANG BAHAGI NG KANILANG PANGKAT NA SUMUKO SA MGA AMERIKANO, BONTOC, IFUGAO, 25 DISYEMBRE 1899.\nINIHALAL NA KONSEHAL NG MAYNILA, 1909.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/timoteo-paez-1861-1939/ (checked 2026-11-26).",

  "content": "Historical marker \"Ang Pagdaong ng USS Crevalle\" in Basay, Negros Oriental, installed by the National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP) in 21 September 2022. Marker text:\nANG PAGDAONG NG USS CREVALLE\nSA DALAMPASIGANG ITO NG BASAY, NEGROS ORIENTAL DUMAONG ANG USS CREVALLE, SUBMARINO NG HUKBONG DAGAT NG ESTADOS UNIDOS, 11 MAYO 1944.\nINILIKAS NITO ANG 40 AMERIKANONG SIBILYAN, MISYONERO, AT SUNDALO MULA NEGROS PATUNGONG AUSTRALIA.\nNAIHATID DIN SA HIMPILAN NG SOUTHWEST PACIFIC AREA COMMAND SA AUSTRALIA ANG Z PLAN NI ADMIRAL MINEICHI KOGA HINGGIL SA GALAW NG HUKBONG HAPON SA PILIPINAS AT PALAU.\nNATAGPUAN ANG MGA DOKUMENTO NG MGA MANGINGISDANG SINA PEDRO GANTUANGKO AT RUFU WAMAR SA KATUBIGAN NG CEBU AT IBINIGAY SA MGA GERILYA NG CEBU AT NEGROS.\nNAKATULONG ANG Z PLAN SA ESTRATEHIYA NG PAGPAPALAYA SA PILIPINAS MULA SA MGA HAPON.\nNAKARATING ANG SUBMARINO SA IBA’T IBANG BAHAGI NG PILIPINAS AT NAKASAGUPA ANG HUKBONG DAGAT NG HAPON.\nSource: https://philhistoricsites.nhcp.gov.ph/registry_database/ang-pagdaong-ng-uss-crevalle/ (checked 2026-11-26).",
